title: Senior Journey Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Journey Architect on GitLab's Digital Customer Outcomes team, you'll design journeys that turn meaningful customer actions into retention, consumption and revenue outcomes. You'll own journey design and service blueprints for assigned customer cohorts, products or coverage models, leading cross-functional work from design through launch. Digital Orchestration builds and runs the journeys day to day; you'll remain accountable for their outcomes and ongoing improvement. You'll add design capacity to help priority journeys, including artificial intelligence (AI) and consumption journeys, launch in fiscal year 2028 (FY28).</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design journeys backward from business outcomes to meaningful customer actions, audiences and engagement tactics. Map each cohort's intended path, timing, signals that customers need help and interventions to get them back on track.</li> <li value="2">Decide which steps are self-serve, AI-assisted or human-led, and define the handoffs between them. Design across in-product guidance, email, events and community, choosing the right channel for each moment.</li> <li value="3">Build service blueprints with Customer Experience (CX) Operations, documenting the people, systems, data, content and handoffs behind each touchpoint. Give every step a trigger, a response, an owner and a metric.</li> <li value="4">Write journey specifications covering steps, triggers, audiences, channels, content, handoffs and metrics. Set build plans, coordinate partner teams and clear dependencies to launch on time and to specification.</li> <li value="5">Specify the content and self-service resources each step needs, and work with content teams to create and govern them. Partner with Lifecycle Marketing on audience, sequencing and delivery so customers experience one coordinated journey.</li> <li value="6">Hand live journeys to Digital Orchestration to run, remain accountable for their outcomes and build in regular optimization cycles with the Digital Outcomes team's Data/Insights partner.</li> <li value="7">Measure journey coverage, step conversion, lift against comparison groups, meaningful actions, recovery after interventions, time to value and influence on retention. Track partner adoption of the shared journeys and blueprints.</li> <li value="8">Apply the framework and standards set by the Lead Journey Architect, and help improve them based on what your journeys teach the team.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience in customer journey design, service design or digital customer success.</li> <li value="2">A track record of turning journey designs into launched programs with measurable outcomes.</li> <li value="3">Hands-on experience building service blueprints and designing handoffs between digital and human teams.</li> <li value="4">Working knowledge of journey orchestration, in-app guidance and marketing automation platforms.</li> <li value="5">Comfort defining customer signals and success metrics, and interpreting funnel conversion and test results.</li> <li value="6">Experience leading cross-functional work through launch without direct authority.</li> <li value="7">Experience in business-to-business software as a service is helpful, as is domain knowledge of development and operations (DevOps) or development, security and operations (DevSecOps).</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Digital Customer Outcomes team brings digital experiences and human support together around customer outcomes. You'll work day to day with the Lead Journey Architect, Digital Orchestration and the Digital Outcomes team's Data/Insights partner, alongside CX Operations, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Engineering and Operations, Content, Product, CX Engineering, Customer Success, Renewals and CX Services. You'll bring these partners together around shared journeys and blueprints so customer touchpoints line up rather than compete.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. title: People Partner Engineering & Product
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About The Role We're scaling from 1,000 → 4,000 employees across 50+ countries, and the complexity of our teams, hubs, and workflows is growing quickly. Our People Partners play a critical role in enabling leads, supporting peeps, and protecting performance and culture as we grow. As a People Partner at ElevenLabs, you'll sit at the intersection of leadership coaching, performance, and day-to-day people guidance. You'll support Engineering and Product leaders across our international teams, getting to know their rhythms, challenges, and talent needs. Much of the role is coaching: helping leads handle feedback, performance, growth, and change well, and surfacing people issues early. You'll work as part of the wider People team, with Employee Relations and People Ops alongside you on more complex cases. This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys coaching, can context-switch quickly, builds trust easily, and brings clarity and calm to fast-moving environments. You will Partner with Engineering and Product leaders across our international teams to support team health, performance, and talent density. Coach leads and managers through people challenges, including feedback, performance, conflict, growth conversations, and team change. Run proactive 1:1 sessions mainly with leads, and with peeps where needed, surfacing issues early. Contribute to organisational design work, advising on team structures, spans and layers, and capability gaps. Support leaders and teams through change, such as team moves and new ways of working. Support key People programs (performance reviews, engagement, recognition, and lead enablement) for Engineering and Product. Work with Employee Relations and, where required, Legal Counsel on early-stage ER issues, escalating complex cases. Spot patterns across teams and share them with the wider People team to shape new People initiatives. Work with People Ops & Compliance teams to support terminations, mobility, and local requirements in each country where needed. Requirements Experience supporting leaders and teams through people topics such as performance, coaching, growth, and team change. Strong coaching skills, with the confidence to guide managers through difficult conversations. Strong judgment and the ability to handle sensitive issues with discretion, clarity, and fairness. Ability to thrive in a high-velocity, ambiguous environment and make decisions with incomplete information. Comfortable with both partnership and hands-on execution when needed. Comfortable working with leaders across different timezones and cultures; experience supporting globally distributed or multi-jurisdiction teams is a strong plus. Experience supporting Engineering or Product teams. title: Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence agents. Agents can generate code and tests in seconds, but they can also produce passing test suites for software that doesn't work as intended. As a Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll own the technical thesis for closing that validation gap and build the early proof yourself. You'll rethink what validation means when the author is an agent and make the feedback loop fast, automatic, and trustworthy enough that teams choose to adopt it.</p> <ul> <li value="1">Validation that confirms agent-generated code does what was intended, so a passing suite means a working feature and not just a satisfied proxy.</li> <li value="2">Mid-loop feedback that helps an agent self-correct toward working software instead of green assertions.</li> <li value="3">Language-aware approaches under one shared model of what "trusted" means, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, while allowing the right technique to differ by language.</li> <li value="4">Real measurement of whether engineers trust and adopt the path, fed straight back into the platform.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Own the technical thesis for how GitLab validates software when an agent is the author, and turn it into an architecture the team can build against.</li> <li value="2">Prototype the hard parts by building early versions of feedback mechanisms that catch the gap between passing tests and working software, proving what works before the team scales it.</li> <li value="3">Develop approaches for GitLab's primary stacks, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, under one shared definition of "trusted," while allowing the right technique to differ by language.</li> <li value="4">Design the mid-loop feedback an agent needs to self-correct toward working software rather than green assertions, and build the systems that deliver it.</li> <li value="5">Collaborate with engineering teams to adopt these approaches, measure adoption, engineer trust, and validation quality, and use those findings to improve the platform.</li> <li value="6">Set technical direction the team can build on, review designs, and help teammates grow their technical judgment.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Deep, current, hands-on experience building real software with artificial intelligence agents, ideally across more than one language, and a clear understanding of why agent output can pass tests yet fail in production.</li> <li value="2">A strong point of view on the validation gap and concrete ideas for closing it, backed by approaches you've built or tried.</li> <li value="3">Experience designing distributed systems designed to run on Kubernetes first.</li> <li value="3">The technical range to design systems rather than tune a single framework, and the judgment to know when a solution should be general or language-specific.</li> <li value="4">You prototype to learn, and you ship.</li> <li value="5">The ability to influence engineers across an organization without formal authority through working code and sound reasoning.</li> <li value="6">Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li value="7">Alignment with GitLab's values, especially collaboration, iteration, and transparency.</li> </ul> <p>This isn't a quality assurance or test automation role. We aren't looking for depth in a particular testing framework. We're looking for someone who has built with agents, experienced the validation gap firsthand, and wants to solve it.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Trusted Agentic Development team is part of GitLab's Developer Experience group. We build platforms and practices that help GitLab engineers validate agent-generated software with confidence. We work across engineering teams and programming languages to understand how people use agents, test new approaches in real workflows, and create a shared model of trusted agentic development that teams choose to adopt.</p> <p><strong><em>Poland base salary range:</em></strong><em> </em><strong><em>272,000 PLN – 408,000 PLN</em></strong><strong><em><br></em></strong><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. title: Intermediate Fullstack Engineer (Ruby/Vue.js), Growth
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an Intermediate Fullstack Engineer (Ruby/Vue.js), Growth at GitLab, you'll help turn GitLab's self-serve funnel into a reliable source of new paying customers. You'll work on the in-product journey from a user's first visit through sign-up, trial, and first purchase, on both GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Data Analysts, with a particular focus on backend development in Ruby on Rails and frontend work in Vue.js. This role gives you the opportunity to combine your fullstack engineering skills with product thinking and experimentation, shipping small changes quickly and measuring their impact on real customer outcomes.</p> <p><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/growth/">Some examples of our projects:</a></p> <ul> <li value="1">Making it easier for self-managed users to try and buy GitLab</li> <li value="2">Building upgrade prompts where users run into paid features</li> <li value="3">Improving the trial experience, including trials of GitLab Duo</li> <li value="4">Improving the tooling the team uses to run and read out experiments</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design, build, and iterate on A/B tests and experiments that increase first purchases on GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab.</li> <li value="2">Build and improve registration, trial, onboarding, and in-product upgrade and purchase experiences to increase completion of these steps.</li> <li value="3">Implement backend features and services in Ruby on Rails and frontend experiences using Vue.js.</li> <li value="4">Analyze experiment results and product usage data with Data Analysts to decide which changes to keep, iterate on, or roll back based on first-purchase outcomes.</li> <li value="5">Collaborate with Product Managers and UX Designers to define hypotheses and success metrics before shipping experiments, then compare results against those metrics.</li> <li value="6">Maintain and improve our experimentation framework and tooling to increase experiment throughput and reduce the time from setup to results.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate with other Engineering teams, including Fulfillment, to remove purchase barriers across GitLab’s codebase.</li> <li value="8">Document decisions, review code, and share experiment results asynchronously so distributed teammates can track shipped changes and their measured outcomes.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience developing with Ruby on Rails and modern JavaScript, along with solid Git, feature development, and deployment workflows.</li> <li value="2">Experience working with relational databases and a solid understanding of web performance optimization.</li> <li value="3">A track record of shipping features to production and owning them after release.</li> <li value="4">Ability to use product data to decide what to build, keep, or roll back.</li> <li value="5">Ability to document decisions and share updates asynchronously with distributed Product Management, UX, and Data teammates.</li> <li value="6">Ability to organize your work, seek and apply feedback, and collaborate inclusively with teammates from diverse backgrounds, in line with GitLab’s values.</li> <li value="7">Preferred, not required: experience with Vue.js, PostgreSQL, A/B testing, feature flags, experimentation frameworks, or SaaS sign-up, trial, billing, or checkout flows. We'll help you learn our tooling.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We’re GitLab’s Growth team: one team with one roadmap, prioritizing work by how directly it helps people buy. We work fully remotely and asynchronously across multiple regions, guided by GitLab’s values of transparency and iteration. Our challenge is running more high-impact experiments, faster, while coordinating changes with teams like Fulfillment and Pricing across the parts of the product they own. For more on how we work, see the <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/growth/">Growth</a> and <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/product/">Product</a> sections of the GitLab handbook.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Poland base salary range:</em></strong><em> zł 248,000 - zł 372,000</em></p> <p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location and having regard to any applicable collective agreements. The base salary range does not include bonuses, equity, or benefits.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. title: Senior Strategic Sales Manager (m/w/d)
description: Jobbeschreibung Als Senior Strategic Sales Manager (m/w/d) gewinnst du neue strategische Kunden und entwickelst ausgewählte Bestandskunden im DACH-Raum gezielt weiter. Du verantwortest komplexe Verkaufsprozesse vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Abschluss und positionierst unser gesamtes Portfolio – von Cloud Consulting und Engineering über Managed Services und Managed Security bis hin zu AWS Reselling. Dein Ziel sind langfristige Kundenbeziehungen, strategisches Wachstum und der Aufbau wiederkehrender Umsätze . Opportunities in weiteren europäischen Märkten kannst du bei Bedarf ebenfalls entwickeln, der klare Schwerpunkt liegt jedoch auf DACH. Dein Arbeitsort ist Hamburg oder Hannover. Hybrides Arbeiten und Remote Work innerhalb Deutschlands sind möglich . Gleichzeitig legen wir Wert auf eine regelmäßige persönliche Zusammenarbeit im Team, weshalb eine entsprechende Präsenz an einem unserer Standorte dazugehört. Für Kunden- und Partnertermine bringst du außerdem eine Reisebereitschaft von etwa 20–30 % mit. Deine Aufgaben Du i dentifizierst und gewinnst neue strategische Kunden im DACH-Raum durch gezielte Akquise sowie in Zusammenarbeit mit AWS und unserem Partnernetzwerk. Du entwickelst ausgewählte Bestandskunden anhand konkreter Account-Pläne weiter und erschließt Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale. Du steuerst komplexe Sales Cycles end-to-end – von der Qualifizierung über Angebot und Verhandlung bis zum Vertragsabschluss. Du baust belastbare Beziehungen zu Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung, Fachbereichen, Einkauf sowie C-Level- und IT-Entscheidern auf. Du entwickelst mit Pre-Sales, Delivery und technischen Expert:innen Angebote , die Beratung, Managed Services, Managed Security und AWS Reselling verbinden. Du denkst Deals vom Projekt bis zum Betrieb weiter und erkennst Potenziale für langfristige Managed Services und wiederkehrenden Umsatz. Du verantwortest deine Vertriebsziele inklusive wiederkehrender Umsätze aus Managed Services und Reselling sowie Account-Entwicklung, Pipeline, Forecasts und CRM-Pflege. Stellenanforderungen Das solltest du mitbringen 8 - 10 Jahre Erfahrung im beratungsintensiven B2B-Vertrieb komplexer IT-Services, Cloud-Lösungen oder vergleichbarer Technologieangebote. Nachweisbare Erfolge in Neukundengewinnung, strategischer Account-Entwicklung und dem Abschluss komplexer, mehrjähriger Deals. Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Projektleistungen und wiederkehrenden Serviceverträgen , z. B. Managed Services, Cloud-Betrieb, Managed Security, AWS Reselling oder SaaS. Gutes Verständnis von Cloud Services , kommerziellen Cloud-Modellen und deren geschäftlichem Nutzen; AWS-Erfahrung ist ein besonderer Vorteil. Stärke im Consultative Selling, in kommerziellen Verhandlungen und im Umgang mit Senior- und C-Level-Stakeholdern. Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Sicherheit im Umgang mit CRM, Pipeline Management und Forecasting. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie Bereitschaft zu ca. 20–30 % Reisetätigkeit. Das wäre schön, ist aber kein Muss Erfahrung bei einem AWS-Partner, Managed Service Provider, Hyperscaler oder Cloud-/IT-Services-Anbieter. Kenntnisse der AWS-Partnerprogramme, z. B. Co-Sell über ACE, AWS Marketplace oder Funding-Programme. Netzwerk zu IT-Entscheidern im Mittelstand, Enterprise-Segment oder DACH-Markt. Erfahrung mit Kunden aus regulierten Branchen wie Finanzdienstleistung, Gesundheit oder öffentlichem Sektor. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Developer Relations, Twitter Brand Rep
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers: Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search, all deeply integrated. ABOUT THE ROLE Developers decide what to build with by listening to people they trust, much of it on Twitter, where Supabase's community, launches, and competitors are all discussed in public. We want a senior DevRel leader who is already a known, trusted voice there, to be a brand ambassador for Supabase. You'll work alongside our New Media and DevRel teams and help shape how Supabase shows up in these conversations. We hire for the voice and following you already have. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Be a visible, trusted voice for Supabase on Twitter: post, reply, and join developer conversations daily. - Share sharp, useful content, from launches and tips to opinions on where building is going. - Represent Supabase at events, on podcasts, and in the wider developer community. - Bring developer feedback to engineering and product, and work with New Media, DevRel, and PMM on launches. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF - You have an existing, engaged Twitter following. We'll look at who you talk to and how people respond, as well as follower count. - You have senior experience in DevRel, developer advocacy, or a similar developer-facing role. - You're credible with a technical audience and a strong writer with a distinctive voice. - You're comfortable representing a company publicly, on camera, on stage, and online. - High agency and self-directed. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: English to Lao Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
description: About Welo Global Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com The Role We are seeking an experienced English into Lao Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. Project Details - Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below) - Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month - Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract - Task type: Language Lead Support - Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support - Language pair: English into Lao What You Will Do -Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down. -Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes. -Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data. -Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager. -Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time. What You Will Own -The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance -The community’s shared understanding of quality -The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced -The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking Requirements - Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles - Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution - Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping - Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI) - Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting - Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements - Language: Native-level Lao and professional-level English - Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools Additional Key Information - Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work. - A background check is required as part of onboarding. - Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries. Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam. Why Join Us This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing upskilling, and access to established linguistic resources. If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you. Compensation Additional Information Job Reference: #LI-JC1

title: Senior Marketing Manager - Japan (Contract)
description: Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. The Opportunity Project duration: 6 months Over the past 12–15 months, Mozilla has expanded its marketing strategy in Japan, launching multiple campaigns across a growing mix of channels to drive Firefox mobile growth. As we look to expand our footprint in 2027, we are seeking an experienced marketer who recognizes the opportunity ahead and brings the local insight, ambition and hands-on execution skills to help deliver our next phase of growth. Join Mozilla’s Global Marketing team as Senior Marketing Manager, Japan, to lead local execution and optimization of Firefox’s integrated marketing program in Japan. This six-month contract builds on campaigns already underway, connecting brand awareness and consideration with user acquisition and engagement across paid media, creators, owned channels and local activations. This will be a 6 month contract opportunity. Working closely with the Japan workstream lead, you will translate agreed priorities into effective local campaigns, coordinate agency delivery and use market insights and performance data to recommend improvements. Overall Japan strategy and investment accountability remain with the Japan workstream lead; you will lead day-to-day local marketing delivery within the agreed plan and budget. You will partner with Global Integrated Marketing, Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Analytics, Product, Policy, Communications and Business Development, as well as local creative, media and creator agencies. Key Responsibilities Lead local campaign execution across awareness, consideration, acquisition and engagement, coordinating channels and activities against shared objectives and the Japan campaign calendar. Manage local agency delivery across creative production, media and creators, with clear briefs, timelines, feedback, approvals and quality standards. Manage creator and UGC campaigns from briefing and content review through launch, paid amplification and performance evaluation, in partnership with agencies and channel owners. Partner with Product Marketing to adapt product positioning and feature messaging for Japanese audiences, ensuring cultural relevance, accuracy and alignment with brand and legal guidance. Coordinate with Performance Marketing on localized acquisition creative, campaign timing and testing; use shared results to connect awareness and consideration activity with acquisition outcomes. Work with Analytics and agencies to consolidate reporting, monitor agreed KPIs and budget pacing, and recommend changes to creative, channel mix and spend for approval. Translate consumer research, competitor activity and cultural trends into practical campaign recommendations; assess local advertising platforms and marketing or distribution opportunities with relevant internal teams. Maintain clear delivery updates, flag risks and dependencies early, and document learnings to support the next phase of Japan marketing. Success During the Contract: Priorities and targets will be agreed with the Japan workstream lead at the start of the contract. Expected deliverables include: An integrated six-month delivery calendar covering agreed campaigns, creator activity, creative assets and agency milestones, with clear owners and dependencies. Timely launch and optimization of agreed activity within approved budgets, with appropriate localization and stakeholder approvals. Regular consolidated performance updates and actionable recommendations, developed with Analytics and channel owners, covering brand and consideration signals, acquisition and engagement where measurable. A final learning and handover document summarizing results, effective creative and channels, outstanding actions and recommendations for the next phase. Professional Profile [MANDATORY] Bilingual proficiency in Japanese and English , with the ability to brief agencies, review Japanese creative and communicate clearly with global stakeholders. 8-10 years of consumer marketing experience in Japan , including delivery of integrated marketing or go-to-market programs for global brands. Experience marketing consumer apps or digital products , or demonstrably transferable experience driving consumer acquisition and engagement. Proven ability to manage multiple agencies and coordinate creative development, media delivery and creator or UGC programs. A strong understanding of paid and owned channels, how awareness and consideration support acquisition, and how to evaluate campaign effectiveness. Confidence interpreting marketing data, monitoring budgets and turning results into practical optimization recommendations. Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to manage concurrent activities and deliver across a six-month contract. Sound judgment in Japanese localization, consumer insights and cultural relevance, balancing creative quality with measurable outcomes. Excellent collaboration skills and a track record of leading through influence across functions, time zones and cultures. A proactive, hands-on approach, with the ability to identify issues early and move work forward independently within agreed priorities. title: Fraud Prevention Analyst
description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world. About the Role Binance is seeking a Fraud Prevention Analyst to join our Brazil fraud team, focused on transactional monitoring, investigation, and fraud prevention within the Pix ecosystem. This role is central to our fiat operating channel, this is a high-volume, high-accountability function where timeliness and attention to detail are needed. Key Responsibilities: Monitor and action alerts generated by anti-fraud rules and tooling. Investigate suspicious accounts and transactions, including beneficiary chains traced by MED 2.0 (up to 5 layers). Execute, within delegated authority, precautionary blocks, account blocks, and relationship terminations. Handle MED (Mecanismo Especial de Devolução) requests — both received and sent — within the deadlines set by the Pix Regulation, including the 7-day merit-analysis clock (weekends and Brazilian holidays included). Record and query fraud markings in DICT and comply with all applicable regulatory flows. Request information and documents from customers and track responses through to resolution. Prepare analysis dossiers with clear, objective, well-founded reasoning. Escalate cases with indications of money laundering (AML/TF) to the Compliance/PLD-FTP area for assessment of reporting to COAF. Identify false positives and propose parameter adjustments and new detection rules. Track key indicators: alert volume, response time, false-positive rate, and amounts blocked and recovered. Essential Requirements Minimum 2 years of experience in fraud prevention or transaction monitoring within a financial institution or payment institution. Hands-on experience with Pix : MED, precautionary blocking, DICT, and fraud markings. Knowledge of the main fraud typologies affecting banking and payment rails. Working knowledge of AML/CFT (PLD/FTP), banking secrecy, and LGPD. Strong writing skills for producing opinions, dossiers, and formal communications. Bilingual English/Portuguese is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage. Education: Bachelor's degree (Ensino Superior) minimum. Nice to Have Experience parameterizing or calibrating anti-fraud rules. Familiarity with high-value vs. low-value case triage workflows. Why Binance Shape the future of finance Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning Competitive salary and company benefits Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success. By submitting a job application, you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Notice . Manages the maintenance of training records and files records in the Trial Master File. title: Mid-Market Account Executive, Americas
description: Hello, I’m Steve, Director of Sales at Customer.io ! We're expanding our sales team in the United States and seeking motivated and successful Account Executives at the Mid-Market level to join us! This role offers a unique opportunity to take your sales career to the next level, with potential for upward mobility. As an Account Executive, you’ll represent Customer.io to prospective customers and drive growth within key market segments. This is a full-cycle sales role (prospect, demo, close), where you'll be fielding both inbound and outbound demand. About Customer.io Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Responsibilities : Pipeline Development and Management : Build and manage a pipeline through self-sourced leads and SDR-supported leads to drive new customer acquisition. Full-Cycle Sales Execution : Lead the entire sales process from prospecting and discovery through demo and closing, focusing on new business acquisition within targeted accounts. Customer Needs Analysis and Solution Alignment : Conduct discovery calls to understand customer business challenges and goals. Position Customer.io 's solutions to meet these needs effectively. Collaboration and Cross-Functional Feedback : Work closely with the SDR team for lead quality feedback and collaborate with Customer Success and Technical Support for a smooth hand-off post-sale. Performance Tracking and Reporting : Own and report on individual sales metrics, including pipeline status and progress towards targets, to support informed decision-making. Qualifications : Experience: 2+ years of experience in full-cycle B2B SaaS or MarTech sales, handling mid-market accounts Location: We are currently hiring for positions based in the United States. Candidates must be located in one of these regions to be considered for the role. B2B SaaS or MarTech Experience : Proven success in new customer acquisition and closing deals within the B2B SaaS space, preferably MarTech Sales Methodology : Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar framework that supports consultative selling and discovery to close. Communication Skills : Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and engaging presence to build rapport with new prospects. Problem Solving : Strong ability to identify customer business needs and position relevant solutions effectively to drive acquisition Deal Focus : Primarily handles mid-market accounts with shorter sales cycles and lower ACV deals Support : Works closely with our SDR team for lead generation, with a balance between inbound and self-sourced opportunities Responsibilities : Engage in high-volume prospecting, cold and warm outreach Manage the full sales cycle for deals typically under $50,000 ACV Drive growth within mid-sized clients, nurturing relationships and uncovering business needs Compensation & Benefits We believe in transparency. We are offering a compensation package of $95,000 base + $95,000 variable for a total $190,000 OTE USD (or equivalent in local currency), subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build. We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more. See full benefits here → Our Process No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision. 30-minute video call with Recruiter 45-minute video call with Manager 30-minute video call with Bar Raiser 60-minute Case Study and Discovery Call w/ the Hiring Team All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process. Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact. Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io . Join us! Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We are passionate about our core values of Empathy, Transparency, Responsibility, and Awkwardness and are looking for new coworkers to share and build that passion!

title: Business Solutions Partner - Enterprise AI
description: Our Mission: 6sense 's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our People: People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner Business Solutions Partner — GTM & Finance Systems Location Costa Rica Function / Dept Business Technology — Enterprise Applications Reports to Director, Enterprise Applications Position Summary 6sense is seeking an Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner to help transform how business functions leverage AI, automation, and enterprise technology to achieve their goals. This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, AI solution design, automation engineering, and value realization. You will partner with teams across Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Legal, Finance, and Partner Operations to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify work, improve user experiences, reduce costs, and accelerate business outcomes. Unlike a traditional Business Systems Analyst or Business Solution Partner, this role is expected to move beyond requirements gathering. You will evaluate business processes, build proof-of-concepts, create AI agents, develop low-code automations, and validate business value before solutions are scaled into production. Working closely with the Enterprise AI Engineering team, you will translate complex business challenges into technical requirements and implementation plans while independently delivering design prototypes and lightweight solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Workato, and other approved enterprise AI technologies. A successful candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on technical aptitude. They can engage stakeholders, map workflows, build basic automations, create AI-powered solutions, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations to both business and technical audiences. This is a growth role within a new Enterprise AI career track. You will work under the guidance of the Lead Enterprise AI Business Solutions Engineer and will be measured on business outcomes, including adoption, productivity gains, automation impact, cost avoidance, and process improvements. As you progress, you will take increasing ownership of a portfolio of business capabilities, including identifying, developing, delivering and maturing measurable AI-driven value. Responsibilities Tool Inventory & AI Efficiency Discovery Build and maintain the AI and tool inventory for your assigned function: owner, use case, active users, annual cost, renewal date, AI features in use, contract exit terms and replacement feasibility. Find where AI features we already pay for are unused, duplicated or overlap with other tools, and document the findings. Track renewal dates and flag every contract at least 120 days before the notice date so a build-vs-buy decision can be made in time. Run discovery interviews and working sessions with stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done, and surface the business problem behind the requested feature. Map current processes and estimate the time spent, the number of people involved and the frequency, so every opportunity has a baseline. Build-vs-Buy Analysis & Business Cases Prepare the inputs for build-vs-buy analysis: what the tool does, how deeply it is integrated, compliance burden, usage compared with cost, and realistic replacement scope. Contribute to business cases that compare three-year build, run and support cost with vendor cost, working with the Lead and with Enterprise AI Engineers on the build side. Agree baselines with business owners before work starts and record their sign-off, so savings and hours returned can be validated later. Recommend which candidates to pursue first, using renewal timing, savings potential and build feasibility. Prototyping & Applied AI Build prototypes and simple agents with Claude and Copilot to test whether a tool, or part of a workflow, can be replaced or improved. Write clear, build-ready context for Enterprise AI Engineers: the process, the data involved, example inputs and outputs, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Help define evaluation criteria, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and escalation paths before anything reaches production. Design the process around the AI: what changes for the seller, agent or analyst, what training is needed and how exceptions are handled. Bring AI fluency to stakeholders: help non-technical teams understand what these tools can and cannot reliably do, and set realistic expectations. Stakeholder Partnership Serve as the named Business Solutions Partner for your assigned function, and the point of contact for intake, priorities and status. Translate business needs into clear, buildable stories and acceptance criteria, and translate technical trade-offs back into language stakeholders can act on. Keep stakeholders informed on what is changing, what is being built and what may move more slowly during the transition. Escalate misalignment, scope drift and risk early to the Lead before they become executive issues. Hands-On Salesforce & Delivery Configure and deliver declarative Salesforce solutions (flows, validation rules, record types, page layouts, permission sets, reports and dashboards) for small requests, with guidance on larger ones. Understand Apex, integrations and data model implications well enough to scope work accurately and hold a credible technical conversation with engineers. Own UAT for your function: define test scenarios, coordinate stakeholder testing and support release sign-off. Maintain accurate documentation of processes, solution designs and system dependencies. Measurement & Ways of Working Track adoption (percent of target users active) for anything shipped in your function, and report what is working and what should be retired. Report hours returned and spend avoided using the agreed baseline, and flag figures that are not yet validated. Work in the team’s agentic delivery model: use the intake agent, async standups and automated sprint summaries instead of status meetings, and give feedback on what to improve. Contribute to team standards for the inventory, business case template and requirements. Skills & Experience Required 2–4 years of relevant experience as a business analyst, business solution partner, business systems analyst, Salesforce administrator or operations analyst supporting business stakeholders, preferably at a SaaS company. Hands-on Salesforce administration experience (Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud), including Flow Builder, validation rules, permission sets and reporting. Salesforce Certified Administrator, or obtained within the first six months in the role. Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or similar, with solid prompt design and an understanding of their limits. Strong spreadsheet and data fluency: cleaning data, building summaries and sizing a problem. Process mapping and structured interviewing skills. Clear written and spoken English; able to present findings to U.S.-based stakeholders. Must be located in Costa Rica and able to maintain consistent working overlap with U.S. business hours. Preferred Experience putting an AI or automation solution into a live business process, even a small one, and measuring the result. Familiarity with GTM processes (lead to cash, pipeline, forecasting) or Support operations (case management, routing, knowledge), or with Finance, Legal or Partner operations. Basic financial literacy: reading a vendor cost, comparing build and run cost, and calculating a payback period. Exposure to SQL, APIs or low-code tools; interest in using Claude Code under guidance. Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst or Agentforce Specialist. Experience in an Agile team; familiarity with Jira, Asana or similar. Bilingual English/Spanish. What we value Curiosity and a bias to build and test, not just to document. Honesty about what is validated and what is an estimate. Comfort with change, since this track is new and will keep evolving. How This Role Is Measured Accuracy and completeness of the tool inventory for your function. Percent of renewals in scope identified and reviewed at least 120 days before the notice date. Prototype quality, as rated by the stakeholder and the engineering lead. Hours returned and spend avoided on initiatives you support, validated by the business owner. Adoption of anything shipped in your function. What Success Looks Like First 90 days Inventory for your function is complete and reviewed with business owners. Renewal calendar for your tools is documented, with the next three renewals ranked by savings potential. Two or more stakeholder discovery sessions completed, with baselines drafted for the top opportunities. First prototype built with Claude or Copilot and reviewed with the Lead and an engineer. First year Your stakeholder group treats you as its partner for systems and AI work and routes requests to you rather than escalating. At least two prototypes evaluated end to end, and at least one taken to production with Enterprise AI Engineers, with measured impact. At least one initiative with a documented baseline, business-owner sign-off and a validated hours-returned or spend-avoided number. Renewals for your function reviewed before notice dates, with a documented decision on each. You are operating toward IC4: leading a build-vs-buy analysis from discovery to recommendation with little guidance. Our Benefits: Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. Equal Opportunity Employer: 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com . We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
description: Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners . We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners. Since launching publicly in September 2023 , Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue , with a clear path to profitability by late 2026 . We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue) —the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt. - Mission-critical problems : We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. - High bar, low ego : Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. - Speed over comfort : We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. - Enduring impact : What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. Team & Locations We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. Flex Fuels Ambition. The Role We are looking for engineers who are excited to be part of our early story and help us build a diverse and vibrant company. As a senior software engineer you will have the opportunity to work across the entire stack with a focus on the back-end. You will have the opportunity to learn and drive the creation of financial products and experiences to help our customers reach their full potential. You should have a strong sense of ownership and enjoy taking projects from inception to release. As an early employee, you’ll be working with a nimble team of committed and talented engineers and having a large, long-term impact on technical design and engineering culture. We are open to candidates from Canada, the United States, and Colombia. What You’ll Do Ownership over large domains and features related to card processing/issuing, and core ledgering of financial transactions Play a critical role in the development, design, and maintenance of Flex's platform and services. Architect well thought-out services and data models that ensure Flex's continued growth Own problems end-to-end, thinking through everything from api contracts, data, scalability, security, observability, and metrics. Lead by example and mentor engineers in all aspects of planning, development and testing. Be a catalyst for driving best-in-class technology frameworks and tooling while staying engaged with the latest technology trends. Be on call, with the expectation to ability to solve problems and find solutions for the servicing team What You Need Proficiency in NodeJS+Typescript and server design principles. An understanding and interest in architectural patterns for highly available, scalable, low-latency, asynchronous systems Ability to hold yourself and the team to high standards. Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills. Ability to provide in-depth evaluation of multiple technical directions and determine tradeoffs of each. Strong propensity to make data-driven decisions on technical architecture and project prioritization. Exposure to modular monoliths and micro-services along with the benefits and challenges they bring. Experience with any cloud based provider like Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure. Four or more years of relevant industry experience with a track record of shipping high-quality products and features at scale. A strong work ethic and are ready to grind Have built and shipped a working project or product, ideally something complex Compensation Additional Information Interested? We'd love to hear from you At Flex, we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don't fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success. Join us at jobs@flex.one Why Join Us Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners. Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale. Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles. True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability. Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors. High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners. Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists. Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

title: Vertical Sales Strategy and Operations
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re looking for someone to join our Sales Strategy & Operations team and own how ElevenLabs goes to market by vertical. As we shift from a horizontal motion to a vertical-led one, you will go deep on each of our top verticals — the buyer, the use cases, the competitive landscape, and what it takes to win — and turn that into a repeatable playbook for launching and scaling each one. As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll sit at the center of the vertical GTM motion, working with Product Marketing, Forward Deployed Engineering, Product, and Sales leadership to define each vertical's strategy, surface product gaps, and drive cross-functional alignment until every vertical is launched and performing. This is a role for someone who wants to shape a new market from the ground up, not maintain an existing one. In this role, you will be responsible for: Vertical Deep Dives - Own the research and strategy for each top vertical: market sizing, ICP and persona definition, buying process, priority use cases, competitive positioning, and where ElevenLabs wins. Vertical Launches - Run the end-to-end launch of each vertical, from strategy and segmentation through enablement, pipeline targets, and post-launch performance reviews. Cross-Functional Alignment - Drive alignment across PMM, FDE, Product, Sales, and Marketing on vertical priorities, owners, and timelines. Be the single thread that keeps every function moving in the same direction. Product Needs - Dig deep into what each vertical requires from the product — integrations, compliance, features, workflows, and translate field signal into prioritized, evidence-backed requirements for Product. Data-Driven Strategy - Define the metrics that matter for each vertical (pipeline, win rate, ACV, sales cycle, product adoption), build the dashboards, and use the insights to decide where to double down or pull back. Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales and GTM leadership on where to invest by vertical, with clear recommendations and regular performance reporting. Who you are We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you: Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech. Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead. Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset. Consistently strive for excellence , delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations. Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside. What you bring 4+ years in Sales Strategy & Operations or GTM strategy, ideally with experience building or launching a vertical GTM motion Proven track record of taking an ambiguous strategic question to a structured answer, then driving execution across teams. Deep curiosity about industries — you enjoy learning how a healthcare, financial services, or retail buyer actually operates and what they need Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma) Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to align Product, Marketing, and Sales leaders without direct authority. Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and comfort operating in a fast-moving, undefined space. Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
