The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. Canonical’s product management team are technologists who have a passion for delivering products and solutions that help shape market demands while elevating open source software everywhere. This is a general application track for the product management positions at Canonical. You will set a clear vision, prioritize work effectively, and ensure the team delivers high-quality products that meet business and user needs. Apply here if you excel at leadership, communication, and technical vision, and believe you can drive product strategy for the business needs of tomorrow. During the interview process we will identify specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests. We believe that open source is transforming the way that enterprises solve their business needs. Although open source has been around for thirty years, it is only now fundamental to every corner of the software landscape. Going forward we believe open source will have an even bigger impact as it moves into specialised vertical markets. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. To deliver on that ambition, we select product managers for their intellect and strong drive to advance the open source community. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. They push the boundaries of the technology landscape to identify and deliver products into new and existing market opportunities. Our product managers are technology professionals with a software engineering background who strive to become business executives and entrepreneurs. We discuss strategy, plan product development, drive engagement, and promote the open source way. title: Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Leaning) - Payments Engineering
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role The Payments team owns how ElevenLabs charges customers: billing, usage tracking, pricing and payments across self-serve and enterprise. Everything we do has to be correct, because it underpins the company's revenue and is immediately visible to every customer and team. We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) to expand and evolve our payments systems. Your responsibilities might include: Building and maintaining usage tracking so that requests are metered accurately without impacting latency. Leading our migration of enterprise pricing and usage processing, including new stream-processing services for usage events. Making it easy for customers to upgrade and pay, including paying through different entities and supporting new payment providers. Working with Finance and Tax teams to meet compliance, audit and reporting requirements. Enabling pricing and Growth experiments with Growth and product teams. Debugging complex customer billing scenarios: piecing together what happened from the customer's experience, logs and code, and fixing the cause. Collaborating with Sales, FDEs, Finance and engineers across the company. Much of this work extends or replaces systems that already exist, so you will scope carefully, plan migrations, and roll changes out without disrupting customers. Requirements We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require: Expertise in Python. A strong background in backend development. Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures. Strong test design and security fundamentals. Care and attention to detail when changing live systems that handle money. The ability to learn a large existing system quickly and to debug complex production issues. Bonus: Experience with payment processing providers, or with billing and usage-based pricing systems Experience with stream processing or high-throughput event pipelines. Experience working with finance, tax or audit requirements. Experience with Kubernetes. Location Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Our People Partners play a critical role in enabling leads, supporting peeps, and protecting performance and culture as we grow. As a People Partner at ElevenLabs, you'll sit at the intersection of leadership coaching, performance, and day-to-day people guidance. You'll support Engineering and Product leaders across our international teams, getting to know their rhythms, challenges, and talent needs. Much of the role is coaching: helping leads handle feedback, performance, growth, and change well, and surfacing people issues early. You'll work as part of the wider People team, with Employee Relations and People Ops alongside you on more complex cases. This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys coaching, can context-switch quickly, builds trust easily, and brings clarity and calm to fast-moving environments. You will Partner with Engineering and Product leaders across our international teams to support team health, performance, and talent density. Coach leads and managers through people challenges, including feedback, performance, conflict, growth conversations, and team change. Spot patterns across teams and share them with the wider People team to shape new People initiatives. Work with People Ops & Compliance teams to support terminations, mobility, and local requirements in each country where needed. Requirements Experience supporting leaders and teams through people topics such as performance, coaching, growth, and team change. Strong coaching skills, with the confidence to guide managers through difficult conversations. Strong judgment and the ability to handle sensitive issues with discretion, clarity, and fairness. Ability to thrive in a high-velocity, ambiguous environment and make decisions with incomplete information. Comfortable with both partnership and hands-on execution when needed. Comfortable working with leaders across different timezones and cultures; experience supporting globally distributed or multi-jurisdiction teams is a strong plus. Experience supporting Engineering or Product teams. Running the diagnostics on a team's health and management effectiveness (engagement, 360, direct feedback), and turning the evidence into a clear, honest read. Owning an improvement end to end: a concrete change to how a team works that you design, drive and land, with a senior practitioner alongside you. Supporting managers in delivering effective 360 performance feedback to individuals and helping them turn it into two or three real commitments they follow through on. Helping build the playbook: the standards, tools and shared language the whole function runs on. You are building the system others use, not producing filler. Learning coaching and organisational development directly from senior practitioners, on a fast, visible path to running this work yourself. What we are looking for in you A track record of leading and organising early. You have run things, built things, won people over and made change happen, in a startup, a student society, the military, a team, anywhere. People around you already see you as a driver. title: Employee Relations Partner
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're scaling from 1,000 → 4,000 employees across 50+ countries, and the complexity of how we support our people through performance, conflict, and change is growing quickly. Our Employee Relations (ER) Partners protect fairness, consistency, and trust as we grow. You'll own our most sensitive and complex People cases, so that leads can act early. As an ER Partner at ElevenLabs, you'll lead formal performance processes, investigations, grievances, and disciplinary matters from start to finish, working closely with Legal and outside counsel across many jurisdictions. You'll also coach leads through difficult conversations before they become formal cases, and turn what you see into playbooks, frameworks, and training that reduce risk and case volume over time. This is our first ER hire. We're building a dedicated ER function, and we want someone who can help shape and build it out: how cases are triaged and escalated, how we work with counsel, and how we measure what's working. This is a high-impact role for someone who can handle sensitive situations with discretion, make sound judgment calls, and bring clarity and calm to fast-moving environments. You will Lead formal performance processes, including back on track plans, end to end, in partnership with Leads and People Partners. Run fair, well-documented investigations into misconduct allegations, grievances, and complaints, from fact-finding through to outcome. Manage disciplinary, dismissal, and exit matters, drafting outcomes and communications with Legal. Partner with in-house employment counsel and, when necessary, outside counsel to assess risk. Triage incoming cases with People Partners using clear escalation criteria, so the right cases reach ER at the right time. Keep the case log and report on patterns, risks, and trends by team, region, and case type. Build playbooks, templates, and training that raise lead capability and cut avoidable cases. Build out a self-serve ER flow for leads, so that common ER cases become scalable. Partner with People Ops & Compliance teams to ensure smooth execution of terminations, local requirements, and compliance-heavy workflows. Requirements Hands-on experience leading employee relations cases, including performance management, investigations, grievances, and disciplinaries, ideally in a fast-growing company. Strong judgment and the ability to handle sensitive issues with discretion, clarity, and fairness. Solid working knowledge of employment law principles and comfort working alongside in-house and outside counsel. Skilled in writing clear, defensible documentation and coaching leads through hard conversations. Comfortable moving fast and staying agile, shifting priorities quickly as cases and the business change, without losing rigour. Comfortable building process as well as running cases, as the ER function is still being built. Experience supporting globally distributed teams or multi-jurisdiction environments is a strong plus. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in on the East Coast USA or Europe. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - SAP Connectors
description: From Fivetran ’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role Fivetran and dbt Labs are building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. Fivetran's SAP connectors move enterprise data out of SAP and into modern data platforms. We're looking for an all-round SAP specialist who combines strong ABAP skills with deep knowledge of SAP outbound interfacing. You'll work on the interfaces and data extraction mechanisms that let Fivetran reliably pull data from SAP ECC and S/4HANA systems, and you'll help customers and internal teams get the most out of them. You will be the SAP specialist within a team of Java developers. Your knowledge and input is crucial to the success of this team. Technologies You’ll Use ABAP programming using traditional SAPGUI as well as Eclipse (or other IDE). Databases (HANA/Oracle/etc) Cloud environments (AWS/GCP/MS) AI tools Claude/Codex/ What You’ll Do Design, build, and maintain high-performance ABAP components (function modules, classes, CDS views, and enhancements) to drive scalable outbound data extraction from SAP systems. Own and modernize internal SAP test environments to accelerate feature development for current connectors and upcoming public cloud / BTP integrations. Architect robust outbound interfaces leveraging OData, standard and generic DataSources, ODP/ODQ delta frameworks, and RFC connections. Optimize data throughput and reliability across ECC and S/4HANA landscapes by diagnosing and resolving extraction performance bottlenecks and delta synchronization issues. Analyze underlying SAP database structures (HANA and traditional DBs) to unlock efficiency gains and streamline data pipeline performance. Partner closely with engineering, support, and customers to translate complex business requirements into elegant technical architectures. Deliver end-to-end support for enterprise clients by troubleshooting complex connectivity, authorization, and configuration challenges in customer SAP environments. Establish technical design standards, interface specifications, and best practice documentation for internal and external knowledge sharing. Evaluate and integrate emerging SAP technologies—including SAP Datasphere and BTP—to keep Fivetran’s connectors at the forefront of modern data integration. Skills We’re Looking For 10+ years of hands-on SAP development experience, with strong ABAP skills (classic and modern ABAP, ABAP OO, ABAP for HANA) Deep knowledge of SAP outbound interfacing: OData (v2 and v4): service design, SEGW, performance, and security SAP extractors: standard and generic DataSources, delta handling, ODP/ODQ, CDS-based extraction RFC: function modules, BAPIs, destinations, and tRFC/qRFC Solid working knowledge of both SAP ECC and S/4HANA, including the differences in data models and extraction options between them Good knowledge of databases: SQL, query performance and tuning, SAP HANA, and relational database concepts Understanding of SAP data models and key modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD) Experience with SAP authorizations and technical user/role setup for interfaces Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills Good communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders Fluent in English Experience in code reviews, design, troubleshooting and testing Ability to use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, and internal chatbots) to support researching, authoring, reviewing, and synthesizing various SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, Postmortems, Test Plans, and Proposals Bonus Skills​ Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including connecting SAP to cloud data platforms Java development experience Familiarity with data integration/ELT tools and data warehousing concepts Knowledge of SLT, SAP Datasphere, BW and SAP BTP. title: Freelance Software Tester for Payments testing (Remote in Germany & the Netherlands)
description: Hi there! We are Testlio , a global software testing company with its own freelance network. Our freelancers test apps from companies across the globe. Payment: You are paid by the hour, not by the bug. This means you get paid even if you did not uncover any bugs. Requirements Age: You have to be at least 18 years old. Location: Must be physically located in Germany or the Netherlands. The use of a VPN is prohibited. Language: Must at least be comfortable speaking English . Some knowledge of German and Dutch is also ideal. Availability: 1.5 hours needed for the study. Devices: Laptop/ PC + iPhone/ Android Phone. Experience: Digitally sending money to people in India/Indian bank accounts. App Usage: Have never used the Wise app before. What does testing look like? Type of testing: Moderated Usability study. Type of work: One time study. This is not a recurring project. Type of test: You will meet 1:1 with a Testlio UX Researcher at a specified time for a live remote video call with your camera on and share your device's screen to complete your testing . Task Description: During the live testing session, you will be asked about how you currently send money from your country to India, including the services and methods you typically use. Then, you will make a real money transfer of about $20 using the application we are testing and share your thoughts and feedback as you go. We are interested in understanding what feels clear or unclear, what you expect throughout the experience, and your overall impressions. About the Money Transfer: The $20 you will send will during the test will be to one of our trusted Test Leads. They will send the money back to you within ~1 business day to your paypal account. Recording: Please note we will be recording this live testing session for research and analysis purposes. We will redact any sensitive PII information. Pay rate: $100 USD. Payment: Payment will be made via PayPal or Payoneer. How to start? Fill out the questionnaire. A member of our Recruitment Team will contact you with the next steps via email. If you are not a match with our requirements visit our Community page instead to find out more about how you can participate in other projects. If you have any questions or need help, please contact Opportunities@testlio.com using the code INDIAPAYMENTS in the Subject line/email body so we can quickly identify your request. Once you are ready, please fill out the initial application below. Those who meet the requirements will receive further information to participate in this paid testing opportunity.

title: Director, Sales & Operations Planning
description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. About the Role: We are seeking a strategic, process-driven Director of Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) with a strong focus on operations planning, resource management, and labor modeling. This role owns the integrated planning function responsible for translating business strategy into executable operational plans that balance capacity and labor against service and cost targets. This is a highly visible leadership role, setting the operations planning strategy and partnering directly with senior leadership across the organization to shape network-wide decisions. Additionally this role will be responsible for evolving the department - partnering with cross functional teams to create newer and more accurate models that leverage industry best practices and expertise. You Will: Own the Operations Planning Strategy: Set the vision and governance for the S&OP process, chairing the weekly S&OP meeting and driving alignment between demand signals and executable operations plans across the network. Define the KPI framework and accountability structure that governs plan execution across sites and functions. Fulfillment Capacity Strategy: Own medium- to long-range capacity planning across the network, setting the strategy for personnel, equipment, and material capabilities, and making the call on when network routing or footprint changes are needed. Labor & Resource Planning Leadership: Own the translation of volume plans into required hours by role and process path, and the labor models that drive it. Serve as the primary executive partner to HR, Finance, and Operations leadership in aligning staffing strategy with operational demand across the network. Develop and recommend the long-range workforce strategy by anticipating volume trends, seasonal spikes, and the labor impact of strategic initiatives. Provide recommendations on cross-training, temporary staffing, and overtime strategy based on network-wide capacity constraints. Operational Scenario Modeling: Direct scenario planning to simulate the impact of volume changes, labor availability, or supply disruptions, and translate the results into leadership recommendations and contingency plans. Cross-Functional & Executive Alignment: Serve as the primary point of accountability across compounding, dispense and fulfillment, planning, and finance to ensure operational readiness, resolving cross-functional trade-offs and escalations. Process Optimization: Set the roadmap for continuous improvement in planning processes and models, driving initiatives that improve modeling accuracy, increase efficiency or increase visibility. Performance Management & Reporting: Own the dashboard and KPI strategy for plan adherence, resource utilization, labor efficiency, and production performance, and use it to drive decisions at the leadership level. Executive Communication & Influence: Present operational insights and capacity trade-offs to executive leadership as needed, shaping strategic decisions on network investment, staffing, and capacity. Team Leadership & Development: Build, lead, and develop a team of planners and analysts, establishing career paths and elevating planning capability across the organization. Proven track record setting operations planning strategy at a multi-site or network level. Expertise in workforce planning, labor forecasting, and operational planning, with deep fluency in translating data into executive-level strategy. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with advanced skills using tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or labor planning software. Excellent executive presence and communication skills, with a demonstrated track record of influencing C-suite/senior leadership decisions. Experience leading the implementation or selection of labor planning tools or workforce management systems at scale. description: Nash is the autonomic logistics platform. Self-optimizing, self-healing AI Agents unify decisioning and execution across fleets, carriers, and fulfillment networks. Shows you owned outright. You picked them, ran them, and answered for what came back. You have run an event people wanted to come to and talked about afterward. One you were proud of, and that became a flagship part of the company. A team you built and led across time zones, employees or contractors, including the hiring. Super self-starter. You find the person who can unblock you, and you can put something good together on budget and with days' notice, then build the system that makes the next one easier to run. Taste and polish. You know the difference between a booth people stop at and one they walk past, and the details guests notice are right, from the invite through the run of show. Pipeline and the big picture. You can walk through the pipeline your events produced and how it moved, and you plan a year of events as one program rather than a series of one-offs. AI already in your workflow, and something you built or improved that you can show us. Command of budget and logistics at scale, and steadiness in the week of a show. Willingness to travel 30 to 40% of the year. How to Apply Send us your resume, links or photos of events you have run, and a short note on the one you are proudest of and why. If you would rather skip the cover letter and send a Loom walking us through that event, the invite that filled the room, or the run of show behind it, that is very much encouraged. Want to grab our attention and bypass the Recruiting platform? Record a video introducing yourself at testimonials.nash.ai with code JOIN-NASH. Your application pings us in Slack the moment it lands. If you are show ready at 8am on the first morning of a conference, this is nothing. More about Nash Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics. Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line. Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion. We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it. Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. title: Head of Legal
description: About Dojo Dojo started as a simple way for teachers to show parents what happened in class. Today it's used in 95% of US K-8 schools and by 1 in 4 American families, and reaches about 50 million kids in 180 countries. We got here with around 220 people and have never paid for a user. Families trust us with their kids, and we're now building on that trust. On Dojo Islands, kids explore a shared world with their friends after school. Dojo Tutor connects families with tutors. Sparks is an AI tutor for every kid, and Login with Dojo will let children sign in safely anywhere online. Our mission is to give every child on Earth an education they love. We hire for talent density, and many of our people came from Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber and Y Combinator. The job Every product above lives in a category whose rules haven't been written yet. State legislatures, the FTC and the EU are writing them right now. What should a shared online world for eight-year-olds allow? How should an AI talk to a child? Who verifies a kid's identity, and what happens to that data? Some company will answer these questions well, in public, and earn the trust of parents and schools for a generation. We want that company to be Dojo, and we want you to lead it. As Head of Legal you'll sit on the leadership team and work directly with our co-founders. You'll own all of legal: product, privacy, commercial, corporate, employment, IP, regulatory and litigation. You'll inherit good foundations, including a small in-house team, trusted outside counsel and working commercial and privacy processes. Your job is to make them great. We have strong views on how this should work. Trust is our moat, and the right Head of Legal makes it deeper every quarter while teams ship faster. The best legal answer is usually a version of yes with sensible guardrails, reached early, before anyone has spent months building the wrong thing. We also think AI now lets a small team of exceptional lawyers do what used to take fifteen. You'll get to prove it. Your first 18 months Make Dojo the company parents trust most with their kids. Decide where Dojo stands on the hardest questions in kids' tech, and say it publicly before regulators decide for us: AI that talks to children, kids playing together online, and how products for kids should make money. Figure out which seals and certifications actually change a parent's or a district's mind, then win them. Make privacy one of the reasons districts pick Dojo. When a regulator calls, handle it so well that the product and our reputation come out unharmed. Make legal the reason things ship faster. Get pulled into the room early by product, engineering and partnerships, because you make their plans better. Find the version that can ship, name the one or two real showstoppers, and tell the team what to do this week. Turn standard contracts in hours and product questions in two days. Write the playbooks that let district data agreements, partnerships and vendor deals close without starting from zero each time. Build a legal team that outperforms teams five times its size. Lead and grow a small, very good in-house team, and hold outside counsel to budget and to your standard. Put AI into the daily work on contracts, data agreements and privacy reviews. Decide what comes in-house and what stays with specialists, so outside spend falls while quality rises. Own M&A, financing and board matters with our CFO, and keep the company ready to do a deal or a raise on short notice. You will be a match if: You've led legal at a consumer tech company of 100 to 1,000 people, where product and engineering create most of the value. Product and business leaders who've worked with you say, unprompted, that you made them faster and found answers they hadn't seen. You end your advice with what you'd do, and once the call is made you own it. You've owned privacy for a consumer product, ideally one for kids, across COPPA, FERPA, state student privacy laws, CCPA/CPRA, GDPR and the new rules on AI. If your depth is narrower, you learn fast and already think about it clearly. You're comfortable running M&A, financings and board work alongside a CFO. You've led talent-dense teams and managed several outside firms to budget. You know the right specialist for almost any problem and can get them on the phone today. You've rebuilt legal work with AI yourself, and can explain concretely how three lawyers plus specialists can match fifteen. You turn a messy problem into the two or three decisions that matter, and you write short. You hold a position without starting a war, and you change your mind when the facts change, and you move decisions on trust rather than title. You move fast enough to make people slightly nervous, and you raise the bar on ambition as much as on rigor. Bonus: 10+ years in law, ideally including child-directed products or student data. Time spent in strategy consulting, operating, finance or engineering. You've stepped into an existing legal function and made it markedly better, or led a distributed team. You can tell Dojo's story to a regulator, a reporter or a partner and leave them on our side. You won't match every line here. If these problems make you want to start tomorrow, apply anyway. The questions are new, the stakes are real, and the answers you reach here will set norms far beyond Dojo. title: Senior Manager, Recruiting, Claude Corps
description: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI. We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work. We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it. About the Role Location: Remote (U.S.) Role Type: Full-Time Reports To: Director, Early Talent, Claude Corps Manages: Claude Corps screeners Compensation: $110,000 to $150,000 About Claude Corps Claude Corps is a fellowship that places early-career talent in nonprofits, government agencies, and public-interest organizations to build AI solutions those organizations can continue using after the fellowship ends. It is a partnership between Anthropic, CodePath, and Social Finance. Fellows are full-time employees for a one-year term. Each cohort is larger than the last, and every candidate deserves a process that feels organized, responsive, and human. That’s where you come in. You’ll lead the Claude Corps screener team day to day. You make sure applications are reviewed, screens are completed, and every candidate decision is documented on time. The Director sets recruiting strategy and cohort hiring goals. You turn those goals into weekly targets, plan staffing, and manage the team’s work. This is a hands-on management role. You train and coach screeners, review their work, and keep selection standards consistent as volume grows. You work closely with the Director, the recruiting coordinator, and the Claude Corps program team. Key Activities Run screening delivery Turn cohort hiring goals into weekly review and screening targets with the Director Assign work based on volume, deadlines, and screener availability Track outstanding reviews, screens, and decisions, and flag staffing gaps early Deliver a steady pipeline of qualified candidates to final-round interviews Maintain clear selection standards Train screeners on the program’s eligibility requirements, interview questions, and evaluation criteria Make sure every decision has a completed scorecard with clear evidence Review decisions regularly for consistency across screeners, and resolve unclear guidance Use candidate and final-round results to sharpen screening guidance and questions Build and lead the screener team Hire and train screeners as cohort needs grow Set clear expectations for output, decision quality, documentation, and candidate communication Coach screeners with regular feedback and address performance issues directly Run weekly team meetings and keep the screener guide and process instructions current Run the operation Keep Greenhouse reviews, stages, and scorecards complete and accurate Give the Director weekly results, explain what’s driving changes, and recommend actions Plan screening capacity ahead of application surges and share what results show about where more qualified applicants are needed Use AI and automation to cut repetitive administrative work, and train screeners to check the quality of what it produces Keep people responsible for evaluating candidates and making selection decisions Key Success Metrics Weekly delivery: Application reviews and screens meet agreed targets, and delays and staffing gaps are flagged early Selection quality: Screeners apply criteria consistently, with clear evidence in every scorecard Screener readiness: New screeners are trained in time for cohort needs and meet the team’s standards Accurate reporting: The Director gets reliable weekly numbers with context and recommended actions Team performance: Screeners get regular feedback, and performance issues are addressed promptly Qualifications You have at least five (5) years of recruiting experience, including managing recruiters or screeners in a high-volume or early-talent hiring program You have managed a team’s workload, output, and quality using weekly targets and reporting You have trained people to apply consistent selection standards and can explain how you checked their decisions You have coached team members and addressed performance issues directly You have personally reviewed applications and conducted structured candidate screens at volume You can manage candidate stages, scorecards, and reports in an applicant tracking system (Greenhouse experience is preferred) You use AI in your work and can describe a process you improved or automated You can build clear processes while a program is still developing and adjust them as needed Full-Time Employee Benefits title: Senior Manager, Global Procurement (Soft Home - Bedding)
description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. THE ROLE Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Soft Home - Bedding) We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Soft Home - Bedding) to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption,C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners. Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business, contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy. Responsibilities Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth. Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement. Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools. Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months. RFP Ownership & Execution: Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award. Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage. Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses. Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories. Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished GoodsManufacturers Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) New categories / new products Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing) Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale) Upstream Sourcing: Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions. Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays. e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)? Qualifications Required: 12-15 years of experience in global procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in a consumer goods or retail environment Proven track record running competitive RFP processes with international manufacturing partners Hands-on experience building and leveraging clean sheets for cost negotiation Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, materials, and production teams All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles. Pay Range $164,000—$240,000 USD WHY QUINCE? Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form . We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. title: Paid Media Influencer Analyst
description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role: Influencer content is one of the highest-performing creative sources across our Meta and TikTok conversion programs, and we're investing further in it. We're hiring a Paid Media Influencer Analyst to sit at the intersection of our Influencer and Paid Media teams — sourcing, editing, launching, and measuring influencer-driven ads across multiple hims & hers product categories. You'll work hand-in-hand with our influencer/creator team to help shape content that's built to convert, then take that content live through Meta Partnership Ads (allowlisting) and TikTok Spark Ads, and manage it like any other high-performing ad in the account. This role is ideal for someone who loves creator content but also wants to own the performance side — testing, optimizing, and scaling what works. You Will: Partner with the Influencer/Creator team to source and vet creators whose content and audience fit Hims & Hers paid media conversion goals across all product categories. Write and guide all paid media influencer briefs and edits to ensure influencer content is optimized for conversion-focused paid ads, not just organic engagement. Set up and launch influencer ads via Meta Partnership Ads (branded content allowlisting) and TikTok Spark Ads, ensuring proper permissions, tagging, and boosting are in place. Manage and optimize live influencer ad campaigns, budget pacing, audience testing, and creative refresh to hit conversion and efficiency targets across categories. Measure and report on influencer ad performance separately from and alongside brand/creative-led paid social, surfacing which influencers, formats, and hooks are driving results. Build a repeatable system for tracking creator relationships, whitelisting status, content rights, and performance history. Apply paid media amplification best practices to influencer content, including format, cropping, captions, and CTA placement by platform. Feed performance learnings back to the Influencer team to inform which creators and content styles to prioritize for future partnerships. Partner with Legal and Medical to ensure influencer content and disclosures meet healthcare marketing compliance requirements. You Have: Experience working directly with an influencer team, guiding content creation and editing toward conversion-focused paid outcomes (not just organic reach). Hands-on experience with Meta Partnership Ads/branded content tools (allowlisting), including permissions setup and troubleshooting. Hands-on experience running TikTok Spark Ads off creator organic posts. Working knowledge of paid media amplification best practices for influencer and creator content across Meta and TikTok. Experience in ecommerce or direct-to-consumer paid social, with the analytical skills to manage budget, measure performance, and optimize toward efficiency targets. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — you can work fluidly between creative/influencer partners and performance media teams. Comfort with lightweight content editing/review to keep creator content on-brand and platform-ready ahead of launch. Nice to Have: Experience in telehealth, healthcare, wellness, or another regulated or highly-compliant advertising category. Familiarity with influencer/creator management platforms (e.g., Grin, Aspire, CreatorIQ). Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar) to guide or make quick creative tweaks. Experience testing and scaling UGC or creator content beyond influencer-specific programs. What We're Looking For: An Automation Engineer with a focus on Agentic Orchestration focuses on seamlessly connecting AI capabilities, including orchestrated agent systems, with existing business processes and enterprise applications. This role will leverage modern AI tools and frameworks to build sophisticated automation solutions and create and configure AI agents to handle complex, non-repetitive tasks that require reasoning, context-awareness, and interaction with multiple systems. Our ultimate goal is to design and deploy autonomous agentic systems that can independently manage and execute complex business processes with a high degree of accuracy and efficiency. title: Enterprise Solutions Consultant/Regional Launcher, LATAM
description: ABOUT NASH Nash is last-mile delivery infrastructure. We help the world's largest retailers and commerce companies orchestrate, optimize, and manage their delivery operations. Founded in San Francisco in 2021, backed by Andreessen Horowitz and Y Combinator, Nash works with enterprise customers across North America, Europe, APAC, and the Middle East. Our platform sits at the center of complex delivery operations: connecting carriers, optimizing routes, managing fleets, and giving operators the visibility and control they need to run delivery at scale. We're not a marketplace. We're the infrastructure layer that makes the whole system work. Every enterprise customer presents a different operational reality. A grocery chain running same-day delivery from hundreds of stores has different constraints than a retailer consolidating three carrier networks into one. Nash doesn't sell a fixed product off a price sheet. We design and configure the system around how each customer actually operates, then deploy with dedicated engineering and product support. THE OPPORTUNITY Nash expands into new regions when its customers do. Latin America is opening on that basis: enterprise customers we already serve are extending their delivery operations into the region, and Nash is deploying alongside them. This role is Nash's first customer success and solutions hire in Latin America. In International, those two functions are one seat: the person who designs the technical approach in a deal runs the launch that follows, then manages the account through adoption, performance, and renewal. You'll hold that seat for the region from its first deployment, and you'll establish how customer success operates in Latin America: the onboarding sequence, the health metrics, the review cadence, the escalation model. It's a rare combination: enterprise customers from day one, ownership of the full post-sale lifecycle, and the mandate to define how a region runs before it scales. WHAT YOU'LL DO LEAD TECHNICAL DISCOVERY AND DESIGN Own the technical and operational half of every enterprise sales cycle in the LATAM region. Run discovery with the customer's engineering and operations teams, define the integration approach, build the demonstrations and pilots that validate it, and resolve questions on architecture, data, and scale before they reach contract. The designs you produce become the launches you run, so they need to be correct at the point of proposal. RUN LAUNCHES FROM SIGNATURE TO STEADY STATE Own every implementation in the region: requirements, configuration, integration, operator training, go-live, and the stabilization period that follows. Coordinate the customer's stakeholders and Nash's central engineering and specialist teams where a build requires them, and remain accountable for delivery performance until the operation runs without intervention. MANAGE THE BOOK Build relationships from the dispatch desk to the executive sponsor and run the operating rhythm across every regional account: business reviews, success plans, escalation paths. Track adoption, delivery performance, and platform health, and use them to identify what is underused, what is underperforming, and where the next workstream should be. This role carries no quota. Commercial expansion is owned by sales; this role owns the relationship, the adoption that justifies expansion, and the renewal. ESTABLISH HOW THE REGION OPERATES Define the customer success model for Latin America: onboarding sequences, health metrics, review formats, escalation protocols. Adapt Nash's global approach to how enterprises operate in the region, including local carrier ecosystems, payment and addressing conventions, and delivery expectations, and document it so that subsequent hires ramp in weeks rather than months. REPRESENT THE REGION INSIDE NASH Be the primary source of regional knowledge for product and engineering: which carriers to integrate, which workflows need adaptation, where the product assumes conditions that don't hold in the region. Turn field observations into specific, prioritized product requests. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 6 months: First regional launches live and performing, with customer stakeholders willing to act as references A technical design of yours in every open enterprise deal in the region An operating rhythm running across every regional account The first version of the Latin America customer success model documented and in use First 12 months: Regional accounts renewed and expanding, with adoption and delivery performance metrics ready to put in front of any executive A tested view of what Nash must build or adapt for the region A documented operating model and a clear case for the next hire WHO YOU ARE You have 5+ years across customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, or operations roles in SaaS, logistics, or marketplaces. You have delivered complex enterprise implementations or managed large accounts with commercial outcomes attached: renewals, expansions, or major deployments. You are technically capable of running the design half of this role. You can lead discovery with an engineering team, define an integration approach, write basic SQL, and troubleshoot a configuration issue in production before escalating it with the relevant detail gathered. You understand delivery operations, in this region specifically or well enough to learn it fast: carrier ecosystems, addressing and payment conventions, and the operational conditions that make last mile in Latin America different from the US. Professional fluency in Spanish and English is a hard requirement. Portuguese is a plus as the region grows. You have built process in environments that didn't have any. Priorities in a new region change quickly, and the operating model will be what you write down. You communicate quickly, clearly, and concisely, and you're as comfortable with an engineering team as with a C-suite. This role is probably not right for: Customer success managers who want an established account base and a defined process to run. Both will exist in the region within a year, and building them is the job. HOW THIS ROLE WORKS You'll be Nash's first customer success and solutions hire in Latin America, reporting into international leadership, with Nash's central product and engineering teams behind you. Nash is a startup. The team is lean. You'll have significant autonomy and direct access to Nash's founders, product leaders, and engineering team, and you'll be in product discussions regularly, shaping what Nash builds for the region based on what you learn in the field. We expect the role is based in Mexico City but are open to excellent candidates across the region, with regular travel to customer sites and, over time, across the region. The first 90 days are weighted toward the first launches and establishing the operating rhythm with the initial accounts. The regional operating model is built in parallel and formalized as the account base grows. More about Nash Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics. Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line. Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion. We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it. Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco. What You’ll Love About Us ✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career! ✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates ✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity ✅ Flexible paid time off ✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

title: Frontend Architect
description: Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production. Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first. We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien! The Mission We're looking for an experienced and passionate Frontend Architect to join our Cloud Native Applications team. In this role, you will own the architecture of modern, high-performance, real-time web applications built on AWS, from the first customer discovery conversation through production launch. You will design how the browser, the edge, and the API layer fit together, using technologies such as React, Next.js, GraphQL, AWS AppSync, Amazon CloudFront, and AWS WAF, and codify it all in Terraform. You'll partner with Design, Backend, DevOps, and Project Management to turn ambiguous business needs into scalable, secure, and delightful user experiences, and you'll raise the bar for the engineers around you. If you thrive on being both a hands-on technologist and a trusted advisor to customers, we want to hear from you. Your Assignment You will be a mission specialist, rocketing Customers forward as you lead technical discovery, define frontend and edge architecture, and guide delivery teams through standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and more. You will demonstrate Caylent's commitment to being an Exceptional Partner by authoring clear architecture decisions, solution designs, and diagrams, and by presenting trade-offs and recommendations to technical and executive stakeholders. You will Lead By Example, staying hands-on in the code, setting frontend standards, conducting design and code reviews, and mentoring Senior and Mid-level engineers as your team builds together. You will demonstrate a passion to Stay Curious as you evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-assisted development and AI-powered user experiences, and bring proven patterns back to Caylent and our customers. You will partner with the Design team, Backend Architects, and Cloud/DevOps engineers to ensure the frontend architecture aligns with data models, API contracts, security requirements, and infrastructure. Your Qualifications Core Consulting Qualifications Customer Experience Deliver exceptional client experiences, act as a trusted technical advisor, respond professionally to customer inquiries, communicate project status and risk, and provide solutions aligned to client business outcomes. Collaboration Demonstrate strong collaboration with internal teams and customer stakeholders, proactively aligning on priorities and incorporating feedback. Lead and coordinate technical work across engineers, designers, and project managers. Communication Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, actively listen to clients and team members, and document decisions so that teams can execute with confidence. Technical Qualifications 5+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 3 years focused on frontend engineering and 1+ years in a technical lead, architect, or equivalent role. Expert-level experience building production applications with React.js and TypeScript, including state management, rendering performance, component architecture, and design systems. Deep experience with Next.js, including the App Router, server components, SSR, SSG, ISR, route handlers, middleware, and caching strategies. Able to advise on rendering and hosting trade-offs on AWS (e.g., containers, Lambda, AWS Amplify, OpenNext). Strong experience designing and consuming GraphQL APIs, including schema design, queries and mutations, fragments, pagination, caching, and client libraries such as Apollo Client, Relay, or urql. Hands-on experience implementing GraphQL Subscriptions for real-time experiences (WebSockets), including connection lifecycle, reconnection, filtering, authorization, and scale considerations. Practical experience with AWS AppSync, including resolvers (JavaScript/VTL), data sources (DynamoDB, Lambda, OpenSearch, HTTP), authorization modes (Amazon Cognito, IAM, OIDC, Lambda authorizers), and real-time/Events APIs. Practical experience with Amazon CloudFront for content delivery, including cache policies, origin configuration, CloudFront Functions and Lambda@Edge, and performance and cost tuning. Working knowledge of AWS WAF, including managed and custom rule groups, rate limiting, bot control, and protecting CloudFront and AppSync endpoints, plus a solid understanding of web security fundamentals (OWASP Top 10, CSP, CORS, XSS/CSRF, secure authentication flows). Experience designing CI/CD pipelines for frontend applications, including automated builds, preview environments, and safe deployment strategies. Deep understanding of web performance (Core Web Vitals, bundle optimization, code splitting, caching), accessibility (WCAG), and observability for the frontend (RUM, logging, error tracking). Experience with frontend testing strategies, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing (e.g., Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, Cypress). Experience collaborating closely with UX/UI designers to turn wireframes and design systems into accessible, performant experiences, and the ability to contribute to early design conversations to ensure designs are feasible and scalable. Experience with Generative AI technologies, both for personal productivity (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, etc.) and for integrating AI features (e.g., streaming responses, chat interfaces) into a frontend. Experience contributing to and delivering on client-facing customer engagements. Preferred Qualifications AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) or AWS Certified Developer. Experience with micro-frontends, monorepos (Nx, Turborepo), and design system / component library strategy. Experience with Amazon Cognito or other identity providers, and with API gateways and BFF (Backend for Frontend) patterns. Experience with AWS CDK, CloudFormation Terraform, or other IaC tools Experience with Large Language Models (LLM), Amazon Bedrock, and building AI-first user experiences. Experience with consulting or professional services environments. Benefits 100% remote work Equitable Life - Hybrid Plan 100% Premium Coverage for the employee and dependents Competitive phantom equity Long-Term Disability 4% Pension match (employer contribution) Unlimited Vacations Sick Leave Paid Holidays Parental Leave Paid for exams and certifications Peer bonus awards State of the art laptop and tools Equipment & Office Stipend Individual professional development plan Annual stipend for Learning and Development Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture Vacancy Status: This posting is for an existing vacancy. Base Salary Range: The expected base salary range for this position is CAD $152,000- $171,000 per year, commensurate with experience and qualifications. Additional Compensation Components: In addition to the base salary, the compensation package may include bonuses, commissions, equity, and other incentives. The specific components will vary depending on the role and individual and/or company performance.
