title: Senior Financial Control Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Senior Financial Control Analyst</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Financial Control Team:</strong></p> <p>Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!</p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£56,000 - £75,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Initial HM Interview </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TP1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Senior HR Business Partner, Claude Corps
description: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI. We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work. We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it. Role Type: Full-time Location: Remote (U.S.) Reports To: Head of People Comp : $110,000 - $150,000 About Claude Corps Claude Corps is a fellowship that places early-career talent in nonprofits, government agencies, and public-interest organizations to build AI solutions those organizations can continue using after the fellowship ends. It is a partnership between Anthropic, CodePath, and Social Finance. Fellows are full-time employees for a one-year term. Cohorts now run in the hundreds, and new fellows onboard while earlier cohorts are still placed. We need an HR partner who can support fellows and their managers year-round and run onboarding at that scale. About the role You are the HR partner to Claude Corps program leaders and the AI Practice Leads who manage fellows day to day. You will own onboarding quality and deadlines for each cohort while Sr People Operations Coordinator, reporting to you, runs the day-to-day execution. Your focus shifts throughout the year. As a cohort prepares to start, you spend more time running onboarding and completing the work alongside the Sr. People Operations Coordinator. Once fellows are placed, you spend more time advising managers, addressing employee concerns, and supporting performance. New cohorts will onboard while earlier cohorts are still working, so you will need to balance both responsibilities. This is a senior, hands-on role. You bring sound judgment to employee situations, help managers address issues early, and build clear processes as the program grows. You work closely with the Head of People, the recruiting team, program leaders, Finance, and our HR service providers. As onboarding volume grows, you identify when additional support is needed, define that work, and train and oversee the people helping deliver it. You remain accountable for onboarding quality and deadlines. What you’ll do Partner with program leaders and managers Advise program leaders and AI Practice Leads on performance, employee concerns, role expectations, and team needs, and help managers set clear expectations and address problems early Clarify who owns what between fellow managers, host organizations, and the program team when employee questions arise Identify recurring issues and recommend changes to manager guidance, policies, or how the program operates Manage employee relations and performance issues Handle employee concerns with care and consistency: gather the facts, document clearly, and bring significant issues and recommended actions to the Head of People Guide managers through performance conversations, improvement plans, and conduct issues Manage leave and accommodation requests with the appropriate providers and advisors Own fellow onboarding Run onboarding for each cohort, from signed offer through the employment steps needed to start: background checks, I-9 and work authorization, employee records, payroll setup, and benefits enrollment Confirm work locations and coordinate state notices and employment documents Send clear instructions, track each fellow’s progress, and work with recruiting and program teams to resolve missing information, changes, and delays Complete onboarding tasks directly, check that records and setup are accurate, and keep employment onboarding aligned with orientation and cohort start dates Plan and oversee onboarding support Manage the Senior People Operations Coordinator: set priorities by cohort, review their work, and keep sensitive questions and decisions with the right HR owner Plan onboarding workload against cohort size, deadlines, and support needed for current fellows, and flag when volume requires surge help Build checklists and repeatable processes so larger cohorts onboard with less manual work Support fellows throughout the year Be an HR contact for questions about benefits, leave, workplace concerns, and employment policies Help managers and fellows resolve timekeeping issues and coordinate payroll corrections with Finance and our providers Maintain accurate employee records as work locations or employment details change Coordinate fellowship completion, early departures, and offboarding Track recurring questions and improve guidance so fellows and managers know what to do Maintain policies and employment practices Keep the Fellow Handbook, manager guidance, and state supplements current with the Head of People and appropriate advisors Coordinate multistate employment requirements and help managers understand the rules for hourly, nonexempt employees Apply policies consistently and seek legal or specialized advice when a situation calls for it Improve HR processes and reporting Track onboarding readiness, open tasks, and employee issues, and give the Head of People clear updates on risks, workload, and recommended actions Use approved AI tools and automation to cut repetitive work in communications, tracking, and reporting, while checking accuracy and protecting employee information Requirements At least seven years of progressive HR experience, including time as an HR business partner advising managers on performance, conduct, and sensitive employee situations You have personally run onboarding at volume and can move between advising leaders and doing the operational work You have supported employees across multiple states, including hourly, nonexempt employees You understand how HR records, payroll, benefits, leave, and onboarding connect. PEO experience is a strong plus You have managed or trained staff doing HR or onboarding work You can build structure in a growing program while handling overlapping deadlines and day-to-day employee needs You communicate clearly, document well, and know when to involve the Head of People or a specialist You have improved HR processes using technology, AI, or automation Key success metrics Onboarding readiness: Fellows complete required employment steps on time, with accurate records and payroll and benefits setup Manager support: Managers receive practical guidance and address performance and employee concerns promptly Employee relations: Issues are handled consistently, documented clearly, and escalated at the right time Balanced delivery: New cohorts onboard on schedule while current fellows and managers continue receiving timely HR support Onboarding capacity: Support needs are identified early, assignments are clear, and work is checked for quality Employment practices: Policies, records, and state requirements stay current, with gaps addressed promptly Process improvement: Manual work and recurring errors decrease as cohort size grows Compensation CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re hiring for a Senior level position at an annual salary of $110,000 to $150,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process. Full-Time Employee Benefits This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2) Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings Pay range $110,000—$150,000 USD

title: Senior Manager, Global Procurement (Hard Home)
description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. THE ROLE Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Hard Home) We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Hard Home) to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption, C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners. Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business,contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy. Responsibilities Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth. Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement. Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools. Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months. RFP Ownership & Execution: Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award. Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage. Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses. Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories. Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished GoodsManufacturers Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) New categories / new products Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing) Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale) Upstream Sourcing: Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions. Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays. e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)? Qualifications Required: 12-15 years of experience in global procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in a consumer goods or retail environment Proven track record running competitive RFP processes with international manufacturing partners Hands-on experience building and leveraging clean sheets for cost negotiation Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, materials, and production teams All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles. Pay Range $164,000—$240,000 USD WHY QUINCE? Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form . We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Global Total Rewards Lead
description: Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance. The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog , LinkedIn , X , and YouTube . We're ~1,300 builders across 18 countries. We share context openly, including how pay works. We work across functions and borders, question defaults, and own our outcomes. Our People team runs on Dataiku too, with AI agents and automated workflows. The role Location: US, East Coast remote · Reports to: VP, People Foundations You'll own Dataiku's global compensation, equity and benefits strategy. The goal: programs that win in AI talent markets, are fair inside the company, scale across 18 countries, and stay financially sustainable. Our People function is lean and decentralized. You'll work directly with executives, Finance, Legal and the Compensation Committee, lead a small Total Rewards team, and have real autonomy. This is a builder role: you'll challenge how things are done today and use AI to reinvent how rewards work. What you'll do Set the strategy. Own and evolve our global compensation philosophy, balancing market competitiveness, internal equity and financial discipline. Lead pay transparency. Define our global approach and get the company ready for new rules, including the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Build the foundations. Evolve our job architecture, leveling and salary ranges, with rigor but without bureaucracy, and give managers simple tools to make good pay decisions. Partner on equity. Design grant guidelines, new-hire and refresh awards, and partner with Finance and Legal on modeling, dilution and international tax. Advise the top. Bring clear recommendations to executives and present equity and executive comp to the Compensation Committee and Board. Run the cycles. Lead merit, promotion and incentive cycles from modeling to execution, with scalable governance and AI-enabled workflows. Own global benefits. Set strategy across entities and EOR countries, and lead the benefits team that runs day-to-day operations. What we're looking for Extensive Total Rewards or compensation experience (typically 10+ years), ideally in a global, high-growth tech or enterprise software company. Deep expertise in global comp strategy: salary structures, benchmarking, incentive design and job architecture. Strong equity experience across countries; late-stage private company experience is a big plus. Hands-on knowledge of pay transparency in Europe and North America. A track record of building or transforming rewards programs, not just running them. Experience leading teams and influencing senior executives in lean, fast-moving environments. Strong analytical and modeling skills, and real curiosity for AI and automation (Workday a plus). Bonus points: knowledge of UK and French benefits and pension programs. Why join us Real impact: shape Total Rewards for a global AI company helping the world's largest enterprises make AI work. Ownership: the autonomy to build, with direct access to executive decision-makers. Growth: help reinvent how People programs are delivered, with AI-powered workflows. #LI-Remote #LI-FR1 Compensation and Benefits The final compensation package for this role will be determined during the interview process and is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, geographic location, internal equity, education, skill set, experience and training. Eligible roles may also be entitled to receive commission or other variable compensation through Dataiku's incentive compensation program. Dataiku also offers comprehensive benefits, including stock options, medical, dental, and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, pre-tax commuter benefits, a 401k company match, paid vacations and sick leave, paid parental leave, employer paid disability coverage, and additional health and wellbeing perks and benefits. Dataiku reserves the right to amend or modify employee perks and benefits at any time. US only national base pay ranges $230,000—$260,000 USD What are you waiting for! At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page . Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. If you experience something out of the ordinary or suspect fraudulent activity, please review our page on identifying and reporting fraudulent activity here.

title: Account Executive, Financial Services
description: Our Mission Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve. About Brain Co. Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model. Why Now Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services. Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact. You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now. Why Brain Co. You'll help build the financial-services business alongside the people developing and deploying the products. Your judgment will help determine which opportunities we pursue, how we win them and which recurring customer needs should shape the product. Brain Co. builds AI systems that help large, regulated institutions carry out complex work. Our mission is to rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve. About the Role Build Brain Co.'s financial services business, from the first buyer conversation to a signed engagement. You'll originate opportunities and lead consultative sales through close, working with the GM of Financial Services, product, engineering and deployment teams. Our priority markets are banking & lending, asset & wealth management, and real estate investors. The work spans complex investment and core operational processes where agentic orchestration of people and data can dramatically improve speed, quality and business outcomes. What you'll own Create demand. Help shape our pitch and narrative, open doors and build a pipeline through targeted outreach, executive and industry relationships, partners, conferences and events. Choose the right accounts, earn substantive meetings and turn follow-up into sales qualified opportunities. Discover and qualify. Convert marketing-generated and self-sourced leads into sales-qualified opportunities. Test the problem, economics, buyer, funding path and timing; know when to pursue, nurture or decline. Bring technical partners in early on data, security and implementation constraints. Build the value case. Establish the customer's baseline and agree what improvement matters. Build clear briefs and proposals, partner with product and deployment on tailored demonstrations, and test the economic assumptions. Lead the deal through close. Coordinate buyer and internal teams through scoping, pricing, security and legal review, procurement and negotiation. Validate commitments with product and deployment owners, then carry agreed scope, success measures and assumptions into a clear delivery handoff. Inform what gets built. Distill recurring prospect needs, buying signals, objections and product gaps into recommendations for product strategy and roadmap priorities. Build a repeatable sales motion. Keep account plans and forecasts accurate, learn from wins and losses, and create materials and practices that improve the next pursuit. What you'll bring 10+ years of relevant experience. You bring experience in enterprise sales, business development or management consulting, with direct accountability for originating opportunities and independently driving complex commercial engagements through close. Complex multimillion-dollar closes. You've personally sold and closed custom technology deployments or tailored technology engagements, shaping bespoke solution scope, navigating implementation tradeoffs, building a quantified value case, negotiating contracts and aligning delivery commitments. Financial-services sales and domain depth. You've sold into financial services and can speak credibly about banking & lending, asset & wealth management, and real estate investing. You bring deep expertise in at least one of these markets. Practical AI and technical fluency. You use AI in your own work, verify its outputs and can discuss data, integrations, evaluation and human oversight with buyers and technical partners. Commercial judgment and execution. You create access, write clearly, put compelling materials together and keep several pursuits moving. You lead across teams without formal authority and do the detailed work yourself. Bonus Points for Experience selling AI products. You've won business for AI products or solutions and understand how customers evaluate, buy and deploy them. Entrepreneurship . Experience building commercial motion and trusted relationships in a 0->1 startup environment. Location and Travel San Francisco, New York, or Remote. Remote candidates should be comfortable traveling to our San Francisco office 1–2 times per month.

title: Strategic Account Executive, Financial Institutions, Brazil
description: About CertiK Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia and Yale, CertiK has grown to become the largest Web3 security platform, combining proprietary models with comprehensive security solutions and end-to-end toolkits to support the full lifecycle of Web3 development. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides a wide range of services including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance solutions for some of the largest projects and institutions in the digital asset ecosystem. Responsibilities Build, deepen and manage relationships with banks, brokers, asset managers, payment institutions and fintechs entering digital assets in Brazil and LATAM Map each institution's digital asset roadmap and regulatory obligations, and position CertiK's solutions accordingly. These include security assessments, custody and infrastructure audits, penetration testing, monitoring, and compliance tooling Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with CISOs, CTOs, compliance, risk, innovation and legal teams through to close Represent CertiK at industry events, associations (e.g. Febraban, ABBC, ABFintechs, ABToken, ANBIMA) and executive forums; speak on panels when relevant Navigate institutional politics: understand who decides, who influences and how procurement actually works Work with CertiK's technical, advisory and product teams to shape proposals that fit institutional requirements Share market intelligence to inform CertiK's regional strategy and product roadmap Requirements 10+ years in financial services, fintech, consulting, technology or infrastructure sales, serving financial institutions in Brazil An established, active network at C-level and senior management in Brazilian banks and financial institutions. You can get a meeting in weeks, not months A track record of closing and expanding enterprise relationships with long cycles and multiple stakeholders Executive presence: comfortable in boardrooms, with regulators and on stage Political acumen and the patience to build relationships over time Solid understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape (BCB, CVM) and how institutions handle compliance Fluent Portuguese and professional English; Spanish is a plus Web3 or cybersecurity experience is not required. Curiosity and willingness to learn are. title: Director, Technology Communications, Hims & Hers
description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role: The Communications team at Hims & Hers shapes how the world understands our role in advancing modern health, building strategies that raise awareness, foster brand love, trust, and loyalty, protect our reputation, and drive adoption of our products and services. As technology becomes an increasingly central part of our story, from AI-native care to the platform innovations behind our consumer experience, we're looking for a communications leader to shape how we tell that story to the world. You'll lead high-priority work spanning technology and product storytelling, AI and innovation narrative, engineering culture and talent communications, and technical thought leadership, building a comms strategy that positions Hims & Hers as a technology company as much as a healthcare company. Reporting to the VP of Corporate Communications, you'll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Data Science, AI, Security, Investor Relations, Policy, and Marketing teams, plus our global Product Communications team, to translate complex technical work into stories that build trust, credibility, and excitement, both with the public and within the tech industry. We're a team of intellectually curious, creative storytellers and problem solvers who love making the complex simple and the abstract resonate. This role calls for strong communications judgment, fluency in the technology and AI media landscape, and the ability to move easily between strategy and execution, translating deep technical work into narratives that resonate with consumers, trade press, and industry audiences alike. You thrive in the fast pace of a startup while stewarding a public company that serves people's health and well-being, and you know how to spot risk and opportunity in our technology narrative early, especially as AI and health intersect in ways the public is still learning to trust. You Will: Lead communications strategy for technology and AI in partnership with the broader comms team to build awareness, foster trust, and shape understanding of the engineering and innovation behind our products. Drive communications for major technological product launches, shaping positioning, media strategy, and launch plans from day one. Partner with leaders across Engineering, Product, Data Science, AI, and Security to build strategies grounded in the technical realities, roadmap, and priorities of what we're building. Translate complex technical work, from AI models to platform infrastructure, into narratives that resonate with investors, consumers, media, and industry audiences without oversimplifying or overhyping. Build and manage relationships with technology, business, and trade media, as well as industry analysts and influencers, to build trust, credibility, and thought leadership for Hims & Hers as a technology company. Develop ongoing campaigns that extend beyond launch moments to grow our reputation as a technology innovator and support the business as it scales. Serve as a strategic advisor and exec communications leader to the Chief Technology Officer and Chief Product Officer on high-profile moments, media opportunities, speaking engagements, and complex communications decisions, including those touching AI, data, and privacy. Partner with the Internal Communications team on technology-focused moments, narratives and initiatives for Hims & Hers employees. Partner with Corporate, Product, and Policy Communications on issues and reputation management, anticipating risk, especially around AI and health, and ensuring responses are clear, credible, and timely. Use data and media insights to understand what's working and continually sharpen our impact and narrative over time. You Have: 10+ years of experience in communications, with direct experience in technology, product, and corporate communications, ideally with experience at a public company. A track record leading communications for major product launches, technical announcements, or other high-profile moments. Deep knowledge of the technology and AI media landscape, with strong relationships across relevant trade, business, and consumer technology press. Experience partnering with engineering, product, data science, and technical stakeholders to translate complex work into clear communications. Experience communicating in a space where technology, regulation, or reputational risk shapes how a company communicates, particularly around AI, data, or privacy. Experience developing narratives that make complex products, technologies, or issues clear, relevant, and compelling to different audiences. Ability to see the big-picture narrative while knowing when a specific announcement, audience, or moment needs a different message or approach to land. Experience advising senior leaders and influencing cross-functional partners across Engineering, Product, Policy, Marketing, and other teams. Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to move from strategy to execution when needed. Ability to operate with speed and sound judgment as priorities shift quickly. A data-driven approach to communications, with the ability to define success and use insights to improve strategy and execution. Genuine curiosity about and fluency in emerging technology and AI, with the judgment to know what's substantive versus hype. Willingness to travel as needed. Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights): Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) 401k benefits with employer matching contribution Offsite team retreats We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match. Craft a compelling executive narrative that articulates the customer context, win themes, proposed solution, and expected outcomes. Build a quantified business case that connects the proposed investment to value, ROI, and measurable impact. Advise senior leaders on skills, talent, learning, workforce capability, and organizational transformation. Strong understanding of enterprise HR, talent, learning, workforce development, leadership, or people transformation initiatives. title: Account Executive, Strategics

title: Vendor Relations Manager
description: Quartzy is seeking a Vendor Relations Manager to build, manage, and grow strategic supplier relationships across our Life Sciences & Chemicals portfolios. You’ll drive growth and profitability by strengthening existing partnerships, identifying new opportunities, and bringing on strategic suppliers that expand and enhance our product portfolio. Quartzy is a 100% distributed team so this role can be done anywhere in the US. About You You’re a relationship builder and problem solver who understands the Life Sciences industry and enjoys finding ways to create value for both suppliers and Quartzy. You’re commercially minded, data-driven, and comfortable navigating everything from supplier negotiations and business reviews to solving day-to-day challenges. You’re proactive, adaptable, and not afraid to roll up your sleeves, take ownership, and proactively find solutions as the business evolves. Why Quartzy At Quartzy, we believe science moves faster when labs spend less time on logistics and more time on discovery. Our platform streamlines how labs order, track, and manage supplies so researchers can focus on scientific breakthroughs that change the world. Quartzy is the world’s #1 lab management platform, trusted by hundreds of thousands of scientists worldwide. By combining SaaS and eCommerce in a unique business model loved by customers, we help researchers spend less time on logistics and more time on discovery. From cancer research and climate change to winemaking and vegan cheese, our impact is broad and meaningful. You’ll have the flexibility of remote work, the security of a profitable business, and the purpose of contributing to discoveries that matter. At Quartzy, your work has an impact - on your life, your career, and on science worldwide. What You’ll Do Build and manage strong, profitable, and lasting supplier partnerships by negotiating pricing, terms, growth targets, incentives, and service expectations. Drive supplier profitability and commercial performance by analyzing cost of goods, margin, sales, and growth trends and identifying opportunities for improvement. Develop and execute supplier growth strategies, including pricing initiatives, promotional programs, incentives, and other opportunities to increase sales and customer engagement. Lead supplier business reviews to evaluate performance, identify opportunities and gaps, establish priorities, and align on actionable plans for growth. Collaborate cross-functionally across Quartzy to identify opportunities, address supplier and operational challenges, improve processes, streamline workflows, and support system and supplier integrations. Own the resolution of escalated supplier issues, coordinating with internal teams and suppliers to drive timely resolution and maintain strong relationships. Ensure data integrity across supplier catalogs and Quartzy systems, including Salesforce, Looker, and the Quartzy application. Own supplier catalog health and optimization, developing and executing strategies to improve product content, data quality, assortment, and performance, including de-duplication and standardized catalog imports. Develop and deliver cross-system performance reporting to provide leadership and key stakeholders with actionable insights into supplier performance, profitability, growth, and opportunities. Identify opportunities to strengthen the supplier portfolio, using customer demand, performance data, market trends, and business priorities to inform supplier strategy. Strategically manage and prioritize a portfolio of suppliers based on business performance, customer demand, strategic importance, and growth potential. What We're Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Science, or a related field. 3–5+ years of relevant professional experience in Vendor Management, Sales, Business Development, Strategic Partnerships, Project Management, or a comparable role. Experience in the Life Sciences industry, specifically in Life Science Sales, Scientific Distribution, Vendor/Supplier Management, or a closely related role. Strong commercial and business acumen, with an understanding of pricing, margin/GP, ROI, profitability, and business performance. Proven experience building and managing strong business relationships, including negotiating pricing, terms, incentives, and growth opportunities. Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to evaluate performance, identify trends and opportunities, and translate data into actionable recommendations. Proficiency with spreadsheets, CRM systems, and BI/reporting tools, with the ability to manage data and develop meaningful performance reporting. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with suppliers, internal stakeholders, and leadership. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, troubleshoot issues, and make sound business decisions. Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain data accuracy, and follow through on commitments. Proactive, self-motivated, and willing to roll up your sleeves, with a demonstrated ability to take ownership and get things done in a fast-moving environment. Collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to work independently, partner effectively across teams, and adjust to changing priorities. What We Offer Meaningful Work - Directly enable scientific discovery across biotech, pharma, and academia. Remote-First Flexibility - Work from almost anywhere with autonomy and accountability. Profitable & Growing - A stable, scaling business with clear long-term opportunity. Support & Benefits - Competitive benefits and flexible time off to recharge. Transparency & Trust - Weekly all company stand ups, monthly town halls, and anytime access to co-founders. Team & Culture - Smart, mission-driven colleagues who value collaboration, accountability, and high performance. Compensation Does this sound like you? We'd love to hear from you. Quartzy takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. The pay scale salary/On-Target Earnings (OTE) range for this position represents the low, middle, and high end of the salary or OTE (sales roles) range for this position based on all US locations. To determine starting pay we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location and an evaluation of a candidate’s skills, experience, market demands, and internal parity. Salary/OTE is just one component of our total rewards package. The pay scale or OTE ranges may be modified in the future. Salary range: USD $100,000 - USD $125,000 + Performance Based Bonus All regular full-time employees are also eligible for excellent Medical, Dental and Vision coverage with generous premium contributions for both employees and their families, the option of a Health Savings Account with Employer Match, Company paid disability and life insurance with opportunity to add additional coverage for you and your family. Additional Information Quartzy provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. As part of this policy and legal compliance, Quartzy will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant or an employee unless undue hardship would result. Quartzy will also accommodate a religious belief or practice (including religious dress and grooming practices, such as religious clothing or hairstyles) if the accommodation is reasonable and will not impose an undue hardship. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. Quartzy, Inc. will comply with any and all applicable local, city, county, state and federal laws, regulations and orders now in effect or which may hereafter be enacted.

title: Product at Nash
description: Product at Nash The Role Join Nash, an autonomic logistics platform helping enterprises plan, execute, and manage deliveries across diverse fleets, partners, and networks. As a Product Manager, you’ll be at the heart of shaping innovative logistics solutions powered by advanced AI models and integrations. You’ll drive the product vision, collaborating closely with engineering, design, solutions, and go-to-market teams to solve real-world operational challenges for large enterprises. Our platform operates in highly complex environments, handling orders, inventory, dispatch decisions, delivery updates, and exception management across customer fleets and third-party systems. As a Product Manager, you will translate these workflow challenges into actionable product development, ensuring our solutions deliver measurable value for enterprise customers. What You’ll Own Define and execute product strategy for core logistics solutions, aligning with business objectives and customer needs. Collaborate with engineering, design, and solutions teams to design, build, and launch features that integrate seamlessly with enterprise OMS, WMS, TMS, and POS systems. Lead product discovery, gathering insights from customers, internal teams, and market research to identify new opportunities and refine existing features. Own the product lifecycle from concept through launch, including scoping, prioritization, requirements definition, and hands-on validation of technical solutions. Work directly with customers and solutions engineers to develop use cases, validate requirements, and ensure each release delivers real workflow improvements. Build and refine product documentation, enablement materials, and value narratives to support sales, customer success, and go-to-market initiatives. Drive analytics and reporting to measure success, understand customer adoption, and identify areas for continuous improvement. Stay hands-on with the latest AI advancements, rapidly testing new models, agent capabilities, and feature prototypes with real-world customer use cases. Serve as a key product evangelist, representing Nash’s vision with customers, partners, and at industry events. What We’re Looking For 6+ years of product management experience, ideally in SaaS, logistics, supply chain, or enterprise software. Strong technical acumen with hands-on experience in system integrations, APIs, and complex enterprise environments. Proactive discovery and analytical skills—you ask the right questions, explore unarticulated pain points, and transform ambiguous needs into clear requirements. Exposure to AI tools and models, with an understanding of how cutting-edge tech can drive value in operational workflows. Experience working cross-functionally to lead collaborative product development with engineering, design, and technical sales or solutions teams. Ability to draft clear requirements, user stories, and comprehensive use cases based on structured discovery and customer feedback. Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting to both technical and executive audiences. Ownership mindset—you thrive in fast-paced environments with evolving requirements and can drive initiatives from 0 to 1. Even better if you have: Previous experience in logistics, delivery, or supply chain technology. Experience shipping AI-native or agent-driven product features. Hands-on data analysis or financial modeling skills to quantify product impact. Flexible PTO and remote-first culture. More about Nash Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics. Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line. Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion. We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it. Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco. What You’ll Love About Us ✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career! ✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates ✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity ✅ Flexible paid time off ✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

title: Forward Deployed Product Manager
description: Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production. Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first. We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien! About This Role Caylent's Anthropic Consulting and Engineering (ACE) practice is a dedicated AI services team built in partnership with Anthropic. We are Anthropic's first pure-play delivery partner. The Agentic SDLC Product Manager owns the Product workstream inside client engagements. On Transformation Blueprint programs, you lead the Product workstream alongside engineering and organizational workstream leads: running current-state assessments with client product teams, designing the future-state PDLC, and coaching product managers through the shift from spec authors to strategic orchestrators of AI-assisted development. On 3-2-1 Build and Enable engagements, you shape the prototype: leading the scoping session, defining the Sprint Charter with the client, and driving the spec generation that feeds Sprint 1 delivery. You are embedded in client product and engineering organizations from kickoff through handoff. Your clients are product managers and engineering leads who need to redesign how products get built, not just which tools their teams adopt. What You'll Do Client Delivery On enterprise transformation programs, lead the product workstream end-to-end: assess how client product teams operate today, design the future-state PDLC, and coach PMs through the shift from spec authors to strategic orchestrators of AI-assisted development On prototype and build-enable engagements, anchor the product side: run discovery with client stakeholders, shape the delivery backlog into a signed Sprint Charter, and write the specs that drive prototype and MVP development Design PM training curricula and lead enablement sessions throughout engagements, using real delivery work as session material Surface expansion opportunities during delivery: by the close of each engagement, you have a clear view of what the client's product org needs next Agentic IP and Tooling Help define and refine the product-facing agents Caylent deploys across engagements: idea consolidation, spec generation, PM workflow automation, and the product side of advanced agent prioritization Provide field feedback that sharpens agent design, prompt configuration, and the scoping frameworks that determine where agentic tooling fits in client environments Co-own the product spec artifacts that define how Caylent's IP gets built and evolved across the practice Internal Contribution Turn PDLC patterns from the field into improvements to product workstream methodology, scoping frameworks, and future-state design templates Support pre-sales conversations where product definition, sprint structure, or PDLC maturity assessment is part of the qualification What We're Looking For Required 7+ years of product management experience, including meaningful time in a client-facing, embedded, or consulting role Experience working directly with product teams on how they work: their discovery processes, PDLC design, and spec practices Experience or demonstrated capability in the use of Agentic AI to facilitate product management activities Strong facilitation: you run working sessions with product and engineering stakeholders, extract useful signal from ambiguous input, and drive toward a signed-off decision Able to write clean, executable specs, both for your own engagement deliverables and as a model for clients you're coaching Technical fluency to scope prototypes with engineers: you can discuss architectural feasibility, participate in spec-to-build handoffs, and hold your own in an architecture lock session Preferred Background in professional services, management consulting, or an embedded advisory role Experience redesigning how a product function works inside another organization, not just producing recommendations Familiarity with AI-native product workflows: spec-driven development, LLM-assisted requirements generation, or agentic product tooling Experience with PE portfolio company environments or enterprise engineering organizations navigating modernization Hands-on familiarity with Claude Code or equivalent AI-assisted development tooling Who Thrives Here Operates inside the client's product function. You're in the roadmap sessions, the scoping workshops, and the spec reviews. Clients let you in because you understand their problems. Makes client PMs better. Your measure of success is whether client product teams can run AI-native workflows after you leave. Owns the diagnosis and the design. You run the assessment, draw the conclusions, and write the future-state design. Can build a sprint with engineers. On prototype engagements, you're defining the Sprint Charter and writing the specs. You can hold a technical conversation about feasibility and push back when scope doesn't fit the architecture. Feeds the methodology. Every engagement teaches you how product organizations respond to AI-native practices. You turn that into the next version of the workstream approach. This is a poor fit if you're most comfortable in a single-product company where your users are internal and your roadmap is yours to own long-term. Engagements close. You hand off and move to the next client. The quality of what you leave behind is the measure. Why This Team The Product workstream is one of the most differentiated parts of the Transformation offering and currently the one with the most room to develop. You shape it from the first engagement Each engagement feeds directly back into the workstream materials: field observations change how the offering runs Your clients are PE portcos, enterprise engineering orgs, and Anthropic-referred customers at the frontier of AI adoption AI-native by default: you build with and through Claude, coaching clients on practices you use yourself Outcomes, not hours: advancement tied to workstream delivery quality, methodology contribution, and account expansion Benefits 100% remote work Equitable Life - Hybrid Plan 100% Premium Coverage for the employee and dependents Competitive phantom equity Long-Term Disability 4% Pension match (employer contribution) Unlimited Vacations Sick Leave Paid Holidays Parental Leave Paid for exams and certifications Peer bonus awards State of the art laptop and tools Equipment & Office Stipend Individual professional development plan Annual stipend for Learning and Development Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture This role may require up to 50% travel, depending on business needs. title: Business Development Representative, BDR
description: At Braze , we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew. We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization. To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success. Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture. If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you. WHAT YOU'LL DO The Enterprise BDR in the LATAM team is the engine behind Braze's large company growth. You'll partner with Account Executives to identify, engage, and qualify prospects at companies with 5,000+ employees, helping leading B2C brands discover how Braze can transform their customer engagement. This is a high-impact role based in Mexico City. While initially remote, this position may transition to a hybrid work model in the future. You'll blend volume-driven outreach with personalized, consultative prospecting, researching strategic accounts, crafting relevant messaging, and creating opportunities that directly fuel Braze's regional pipeline across LATAM. Main responsibilities: Enterprise Outbound Prospecting: Prospect into Enterprise (5,000+ employees) target accounts across key industries such as retail, media, fintech, and travel. Pipeline & Meeting Generation: Generate qualified meetings for the Enterprise AE team through multi-channel outbound outreach (email, phone, LinkedIn, video). Account Research: Research accounts to identify pain points around customer engagement, cross-channel messaging, and data activation. Strategic Collaboration: Partner closely with Account Executives and marketing to develop territory strategies and prioritize high-potential accounts across the region. CRM & Data Hygiene: Maintain accurate activity, prospecting notes, and pipeline data in Salesforce. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Consistently hitting or exceeding monthly qualified meeting and pipeline targets. Building a repeatable outreach motion that balances efficiency, volume, and thoughtful personalization. Developing strong product and industry knowledge to speak credibly about Braze's value proposition to executive prospects. WHO YOU ARE Prospecting & Sales Background: Proven track record in outbound prospecting within sales, business development, or high-activity customer-facing roles. Experience in Enterprise SaaS or complex sales environments is a plus. Location & Work Flexibility: Based in or near Mexico City, comfortable working remotely initially with openness to transitioning to a hybrid setup. Language Proficiency: Fluency in both Spanish and English (written and verbal) is required to engage prospects and collaborate with global stakeholders. Fluency in Portuguese is a plus. Self-Discipline & Autonomy: Highly organized and self-motivated, with the ability to manage high-volume outreach, prioritize tasks, and maintain strong performance across remote/hybrid environments. Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication; ability to craft compelling, concise outreach and articulate value clearly. Coachability & Growth Mindset: Eager to learn, open to feedback, and driven to iterate quickly to improve sales techniques. Resilience: Comfortable with rejection, persistent, and motivated by ambitious targets and healthy competition. Domain & Tool Familiarity: Genuine curiosity in MarTech, SaaS, and customer engagement. Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar sales tech is preferred. WHY JOIN Clear Career Path: Structured progression toward Senior BDR and Account Executive (AE) roles with dedicated leadership coaching and enablement. High Impact & Visibility: Partner directly with regional AEs and GTM leadership; your contribution directly impacts Braze's growth in LATAM. Collaborative Culture: Inclusive, supportive team environment focused on shared wins, continuous learning, and peer development. Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission tied directly to qualified meetings and pipeline generation. Location: Mexico City (Remote with potential future transition to Hybrid) #LI-Remote #LI-Hybrid WHAT WE OFFER Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here . More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment. From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as: Competitive compensation that may include equity Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans Flexible paid time off Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® ABOUT BRAZE Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences. The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025. Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore. The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo. BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization. Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience.
