title: Senior Recruiting Partner (Contract)
description: ClassDojo 's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love. We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. It’s actively used in over 95% of US schools, reaching over 45 million children in 180 countries, with a team of just around 200 people [1]. We are now beginning to use this network to give kids the best learning experiences in the world, far beyond those a standard school can provide. We hire for talent density. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too. What you’ll do: This is a 12-month contract role, approximately 40 hours per week. You’ll work closely with our in-house recruiter and broader People team, jumping in wherever you can create the most leverage across our hiring efforts. Depending on what the team needs in a given week, you might: Build and execute sourcing strategies for technical and non-technical searches, identifying and engaging high-caliber talent Conduct candidate outreach and help nurture promising candidates through the recruiting process Support interview scheduling and coordination, helping keep processes moving quickly and smoothly Step into recruiter screens or other candidate conversations as needed Partner with hiring managers and interview teams on searches, candidate pipelines, and recruiting priorities Help keep candidates informed and deliver a thoughtful, high-touch experience throughout the process Maintain strong data hygiene in our ATS and recruiting tools Pitch in on recruiting projects, research, process improvements, or other priorities as they arise This role is intentionally broad. We’re a small, fast-moving team, and we’re looking for someone who is comfortable moving between strategic recruiting work and the important operational details that keep hiring running smoothly. You will be a match if: You have 7+ years of recruiting experience, ideally in a high-growth technology environment, and can quickly step into a search or recruiting workflow with minimal ramp-up or oversight. You’re an experienced recruiter who is equally comfortable sourcing candidates, talking with hiring managers, engaging candidates, and handling the details that keep a process moving You’re a strong sourcer who enjoys uncovering hard-to-find talent and finding creative ways to build high-quality pipelines You thrive in ambiguous, fast-changing environments and don’t need a narrowly defined lane to do your best work You take a thoughtful, data-informed approach to recruiting and maintain a high bar for accuracy and follow-through You care deeply about candidate experience and communicate with warmth, clarity, and professionalism You have excellent written and verbal communication skills You might be a good fit if: You’ve recruited for both technical and non-technical roles (engineering, product, data, marketing, sales, finance, etc) You have experience in a consumer technology environment You’ve worked at an early- or mid-stage startup and enjoy the variety that comes with a smaller team You have full-cycle recruiting experience but are genuinely happy flexing across sourcing, coordination, candidate management, and other recruiting needs [1] Some more context: (If you are on LinkedIn, you will not be able to access the hyperlinks below. Once you click apply, you will be directed to our career website (if you are not on there already) and will be able to access the hyperlinks) How ClassDojo Connects Parents, Students, and Teachers “ Whats New on ClassDojo 2023 ” TechCrunch Article: Second Act comes with First Profits Click here if you're interested in learning more about what we've been up to. title: Senior Campus Marketing Manager
description: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI. We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work. We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it. About the Role Location: Remote (US), with travel about once a month Role Type: Full-Time Reporting to: Head of Higher Ed Compensation: $110,000 to $150,000 per year More than 50 colleges and universities offer CodePath courses for credit, taught by their own faculty or by CodePath. For a student, a seat in one of those courses means industry-vetted learning and career support built into the degree they're already earning. The courses only change outcomes if students know they exist and sign up. That's your job. Students find us through a professor who mentions the course before registration opens, an advisor who forwards a note, a club event, or a friend who took the course last term. Most of that reach happens through people on campus, so your work is making it easy for faculty, advisors, career services, club leaders, alumni, and Tech Fellows to carry the message for us. You'll build all of it: the toolkits and campaigns they share, the campus presence, and the student community that recruits the next cohort. You'll be measured on how many students enroll and stay through add/drop, because each filled seat is one more student getting the training we exist to provide. You'll be a dedicated partner to our Higher Education partnerships team, who own the relationships with faculty and campus leadership, and you'll own the student side of every partner campus. Some weeks that means building a one-pager a department chair can forward on Monday, tuning an email sequence on a Wednesday, and representing CodePath at a hackathon on Friday. You'll be building this function from the ground up and you need to decide in advance how we show up and what we expect back. What you'll own Partner activation and campaign development Build and run a term playbook for each for-credit partner, from awareness through add/drop Equip faculty, advisors, career services, and club leaders to market CodePath courses with toolkits, talking points, and assets they can forward Turn national for-credit applicants into enrolled students: find where they drop off and test what moves conversion Run virtual info sessions and campus landing pages that end with a clear path to register Own email and SMS to opted-in students: build the list, run the campaigns, and work with our lifecycle contractor so campus and direct touches land as one sequence Student community building Design how alumni, Tech Fellows, and instructors show up on campus and engage students, and build the online side of that community (Discord and similar) Own relationships with student clubs, CS and AI organizations, hackathon organizers, and campus chapters of national organizations like ColorStack, NSBE, and SHPE Plan the event calendar a term ahead, with a clear standard for which events we do and what each should return Measurement Tie every sign-up to a channel and a partner, test timing, message, and channel, and move time and budget to what works Use AI to run the playbook at 50+ campuses without adding headcount: toolkits per campus, calendars and send dates, results in one view What success looks like in your first year Every partner runs a term playbook, and fill rate and melt improve at for-credit partners National for-credit conversion is measurably higher Every new partner launches with a full first section A student advocate network is live at our largest partners The opted-in student list grows, and every sign-up traces to a channel This role may be right for you if You've owned an enrollment, sign-up, or acquisition number and moved it. You set up the tracking and can show which efforts drove the result You've gotten partners to market on your behalf: individuals who carried your message because you made it easy for them, and you can show what it produced You've built a campus, ambassador, or community program from the ground up and can show what it produced You’ve built campaigns from concept to launch, including copy and creative, and run email or SMS to a list you built, changing them based on the numbers You've decided where to spend time and money (events, channels, sponsorships) based on expected return, and cut what didn't deliver You've run a program across many sites at once (campuses, chapters, regions) on a fixed calendar, and kept it on schedule without a team under you You’ve built AI into how you work to automate the repetitive parts, and you can show what it changed You want your growth work to widen who gets into tech careers Bonus Experience in enrollment or admissions marketing in higher education You’ve built or scaled a technical community (a student developer org, hackathon community, Discord, or dev rel program) and can show how it grew Hands-on HubSpot experience You're comfortable speaking at events and on panels on behalf of CodePath Compensation CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position's level, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring for a Senior Manager level position at an annual salary of $110,000 to $150,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process. Full-Time Employee Benefits This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2) Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings Pay range $110,000—$150,000 USD

title: Senior Manager, Global Procurement (Bags and Accessories)
description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. THE ROLE Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Bags and Accessories) We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Bags and Accessories) to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption,C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners. Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business, contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy. Responsibilities Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth. Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement. Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools. Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months. RFP Ownership & Execution: Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award. Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage. Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses. Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories. Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished GoodsManufacturers Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) New categories / new products Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing) Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale) Upstream Sourcing: Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions. Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays. e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)? title: AI Application Security Engineer
description: Our Mission Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve. About Brain Co. Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model. Why Now Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services. Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact. You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now. About the Role As our Security Engineer, Application & AI, you will own the security of our products and application layer — secure development practices, agent security, third-party integration security, and data protection for AI products operating in some of the world's most regulated and sensitive environments. This is a hands-on builder role. You will write code, ship security tooling, and work directly with product and ML engineers to build security in from the start rather than bolt it on after. You are expected to work AI-natively: using AI to write threat models, automate security review, scale code analysis, and build internal tooling. This is not a nice-to-have — it is how the role is designed to operate and how one person can have outsized impact across a fast-moving engineering organization. Brain Co.'s products are built on agentic infrastructure — AI that takes actions, calls tools, and operates inside complex institutional workflows. The degree varies by product, but the underlying security surface is consistent: how agents are authorized, what they can touch, and how that is controlled at the application layer. This role is specifically designed to address that surface, working alongside the Infrastructure Security Engineer who owns the platform layer underneath. What You'll Work On Application Security Own secure development practices across our products: AuthN/AuthZ patterns, secrets management, input handling, and secure-by-default standards that engineers can follow without security becoming a bottleneck. Integrate security into the development lifecycle — code review, CI/CD pipelines, and pre-deployment checks — catching risk before it reaches production. Conduct threat modeling across product features and release cycles, translating risk into concrete controls that ship alongside each product. Build and maintain security tooling and automated checks that scale your reach across the codebase — using AI to move faster and cover more ground than manual review alone could. Agent & Integration Security Own the application-layer security model for Brain Co.'s agentic products — how agents are scoped, what they are authorized to do on behalf of users, and where trust boundaries sit between the agent and the external systems it touches. Define secure patterns for how agents integrate with third-party systems and APIs: how credentials are stored and scoped, how responses are validated before being acted on, and how each product limits what agents can do with what they get back. Work directly with product and ML engineers during feature development to define secure agent design patterns: tool scoping, permission boundaries, output validation, and safe handling of user context across multi-step workflows. Build reusable secure-by-default patterns for agent development — design guidelines, review checklists, and code-level guardrails — so that security standards scale as new agent capabilities are built. Produce security artifacts for agent features and product deployments: threat models, architecture reviews, and documentation that supports delivery into regulated customer environments. Data Protection Define and enforce data protection standards at the application layer — ensuring sensitive customer data (PHI, PII, government records) is handled correctly as it flows through AI pipelines and surfaces in agent outputs. Build safeguards against unauthorized data exposure across our products: access controls, output filtering, and audit logging that make data handling attributable and reviewable. Design secure data handling patterns for AI features operating on regulated data, working with platform and ML teams to ensure the application layer upholds its share of the data protection contract. You Might Be a Great Fit If You... Have 5+ years of experience in application security or product security, with hands-on experience on production systems at scale. Are a builder first — you write code and ship security tooling, and see embedding security into the engineering workflow as the job, not a side effect of it. Have deep fluency in application security fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, AuthN/AuthZ, secure SDLC, secrets management, secure integration patterns, and cryptography basics. Understand the security surface of agentic AI across the product layer — how agents should be designed, scoped, and reviewed for risk — and can work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers to build those standards in. Have experience protecting sensitive data at the application layer: access controls, audit logging, and preventing data exposure through third-party integrations and AI-generated outputs. Work AI-natively — you already use AI to write better code, move faster, and do more with less, and you bring that same instinct to security work. Think in attack surfaces and trust boundaries and can move cleanly from threat model to concrete shipped control. Are comfortable working alongside delivery teams shipping into regulated industries, understanding their constraints and translating them into product-level security requirements. Thrive in high-agency environments and want to own and grow the application security function as the company scales. Bonus Points For Experience with agent security, LLM application security, or building authorization and guardrail systems for agentic pipelines. Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to government and healthcare: FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001. Proficiency in Python, Go, or TypeScript for security tooling and automation. Experience with SAST/DAST tooling or integrating automated security checks into developer workflows at scale. Why Join Us Define what application and AI security looks like at a company building frontier AI for governments, hospitals, and critical industries — from the ground up. Work directly alongside product and ML teams shipping agentic AI into some of the world's most demanding institutional environments. Build the security function AI-natively — using the same technology you're helping secure to scale your own work and impact. Work alongside senior engineers from Tesla, DeepMind, Databricks, and other top engineering organizations. Ship fast, learn constantly, and see your work protect production systems used by millions of people. Earn competitive compensation and meaningful equity in a high-growth company. Benefits Competitive salary plus equity Daily lunches Commuter benefits 401(k) Medical, Dental, and Vision Unlimited PTO

title: Endear - Product Manager
description: Our Story At Endear, we’re building the first modern CRM for retail teams, starting with the frontline. Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth. We work with brands like Gorjana, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work. Position Overview We're looking for a Product Manager to help shape and deliver the next generation of Endear's platform. You'll take ownership of product decisions, priorities, and outcomes, working closely with Design, Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to turn customer needs and business opportunities into impactful product experiences. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who can operate autonomously, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and drive initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration. You'll have meaningful ownership over what gets built, why it matters, and how we measure success, while partnering with product leadership on broader vision and direction. AI fluency is central to how we work. You'll use AI to accelerate discovery, bring ideas to life through prototyping, automate workflows, and help the team deliver value faster. This role is well suited for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of decisions, and knows how to connect great product experiences to meaningful business impact. What You'll Accomplish In your first 6 months, you'll… Take ownership of product initiatives from discovery through launch, making decisions around scope, priorities, and tradeoffs. Build a deep understanding of our customers, their workflows, and the business problems we're solving. Partner closely with Sales, Customer Experience, and Marketing to gather insights, align priorities, and identify opportunities for product improvement. Translate customer needs, business goals, and product data into clear priorities and actionable plans. Work closely with Design and Engineering to evaluate solutions, make product decisions, and deliver high-quality experiences. Define success metrics and take accountability for the customer and business outcomes of the features you ship. Use AI to improve how product work gets done, including rapid prototyping, documentation, research synthesis, and workflow automation. In your first year, you'll… Independently own meaningful areas of the product roadmap, driving decisions and measurable outcomes within the broader product strategy. Deliver product improvements that increase adoption, engagement, customer value, and business performance. Establish strong feedback loops across customers, Sales, CX, Marketing, Design, and Engineering to inform ongoing product decisions. Build repeatable, AI-powered workflows that help the product team operate more efficiently and ship faster. Become a trusted cross-functional partner who brings clarity to complex problems and drives alignment around priorities and decisions. Demonstrate clear business impact through the products you build and the improvements you deliver. You'll Thrive in This Role If… You love owning product decisions and are comfortable being accountable for outcomes, not just execution. You're able to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and make sound decisions without needing constant direction. You think commercially and understand how product decisions connect to customer value, adoption, retention, and business growth. You naturally bring together different perspectives from Sales, CX, Marketing, Design, and Engineering to make better product decisions. You're comfortable challenging assumptions, prioritizing competing needs, and communicating tradeoffs clearly. You're highly fluent in AI and actively look for opportunities to automate work, build prototypes, and improve how teams operate. You move quickly, experiment often, and know when to gather more information versus when to make a decision. You care deeply about understanding customers and solving the right problems. You Have Experience With Approximately 5+ years of product management experience, ideally building customer-facing software or B2B SaaS products. Independently owning product initiatives, including discovery, prioritization, decision-making, execution, and measuring outcomes. Making product decisions that balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints. Demonstrating measurable business impact through products or features you've shipped. Working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Experience, Marketing, Design, and Engineering to align stakeholders and drive initiatives forward. Conducting customer discovery, synthesizing feedback, and using qualitative and quantitative data to inform product decisions. Defining success metrics, evaluating product performance, and using insights to guide prioritization and iteration. Operating effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where priorities evolve. Demonstrating strong AI fluency through practical applications, such as: Building functional prototypes with AI to communicate and validate product ideas. Automating product documentation, requirements, and ongoing updates. Creating AI-powered workflows or systems that streamline product copy, content edits, or repetitive processes. Using AI to accelerate research synthesis, problem framing, and product decision-making. Evaluating AI-generated output critically and understanding when human judgment and validation are needed. Experience with retail technology, e-commerce, CRM, mobile-first products, or AI-powered experiences is a plus, but not required. Align With What We Value At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here's how they translate into what we're looking for in this role: Customer First: You prioritize real customer problems, use research and data to guide decisions, and connect product improvements to meaningful customer and business outcomes. Take Ownership: You take responsibility for product decisions and results, independently driving initiatives from identifying opportunities through delivery and iteration. Enable Autonomy: You create clarity around priorities, decisions, and tradeoffs so cross-functional teams can move forward confidently and independently. Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, communicate openly with stakeholders, and consistently deliver measurable value. Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You embrace AI, automation, and experimentation to improve how products are built, reduce unnecessary work, and deliver meaningful improvements faster. About the Team Endear's product organization works across three product areas: AI, IRL (in real life), and Core Flows. You'll collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering while working across the business to understand customer needs, identify opportunities, and drive product outcomes. You'll partner most closely with: Product Leadership: Align on broader product vision, strategic priorities, and business goals while independently owning decisions within your product initiatives. Design Team: Collaborate on discovery, problem definition, prototyping, and delivering intuitive product experiences. Engineering Team: Evaluate technical feasibility, navigate tradeoffs, and turn product decisions into shipped solutions. title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Full-Stack)
description: At Dscout , we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us. At Dscout, we're building the human-grounded layer that teaches AI to work in the real world and proves it stays aligned there. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us. Dscout AI Training & Evals builds human data and evals that show whether AI works for real people. For ten years Dscout has captured how people behave in real context, with consent and scientific rigor. Dscout AI Training & Evals points that engine at AI: consented human behavior and judgment, turned into the training data, evals, and benchmarks AI teams trust. Models ace benchmarks and still surprise people in the wild. A benchmark says how capable a model is. It does not say whether the model works for the person using it, across weeks, in the mess of real life. That gap is where we work. We serve AI researchers, the product builders who ship alongside them, and the research teams who partner with both. We are a new unit inside an established company: live customers, a mature platform (React, Elixir, Python, Swift, Kotlin; SOC 2 and HITRUST certified), a small senior team, and room to build. We work AI-native. Agents write code, evals gate changes, and we aim to do in months what used to take years. A note from our Chief AI Officer & GM. The hardest AI problems show up when a model meets real people, with their tools, their interruptions, and their goals. Our customers need a partner who can design the answer, build it, and ship it fast. Ground Truth sits where deployment meets research: what we learn in the field shapes the science, and the science shapes what we ship. Come build it with us. Why this seat Work directly with AI labs and AI product teams on problems that have no playbook yet. Build on a platform that already works, so your time goes into the hard part, not the plumbing. Own technical decisions on your programs, and see your builds become a product. Join a small senior team with direct access to the GM, our Principal Engineers, and the Head of AI Research. Our Strategic Project Leads run customer programs from first scoping call to final data delivery. You are their technical partner and builder. Customers ask for things that have not been built before: weeks of real-world AI use, captured in context, delivered as data a lab can train or evaluate on. You work out how. Some of it our platform already does, some needs configuring, and some has to be built. Knowing which is the job. Programs you will work on Long-horizon, real-world use of AI products, captured over days and weeks. Side-by-side model comparisons judged by people who match a specific profile. Human judgment and preference data, delivered in formats a training pipeline can ingest. Feedback loops that connect real user behavior to model and product decisions. What you will do Scope and shape programs Turn a fuzzy customer brief into a technical plan in days, alongside the Project Lead. Decide what to reuse, extend, or build, and prove the gap before you write code. Write the scope down: what we will deliver, how it works, what could go wrong. Build and ship Build capture flows, task logic, data pipelines, and delivery across web, mobile, and backend. Ship production code with real participants on the other end. Use coding agents and evals as part of how you build, and teach the habit to others. Build trust into the data Own redaction, validation, provenance, and clean delivery. Design quality checks and human-review paths, and measure whether they work. Work with our research team so the data you ship carries evidence that it is good. Turn the field into product Work with core engineering to move repeat builds into the platform. Tell us what customers keep asking for, and help decide what we build next. Latitude. These areas are the core, not the whole list. You will have real room to propose new program types and platform capabilities as the market moves. A good first year Several customer programs scoped and shipped, with you named by the customer. Signed scope to first data gets noticeably faster. Two or more custom builds absorbed into the core platform. Project Leads stop asking "can we do this?" and start asking "how fast?" How we will hire: a conversation with the GM; a scoping exercise on a real, anonymized brief (what would you reuse, what would you build); a technical deep dive with core engineers; a conversation with the Project Leads and the Head of AI Research. title: Mentor, Claude Corps
description: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI. We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work. We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it. About the Role Location: Remote, United States Role-Type: Full-Time, W2 Employee Reports To: AI Practice Lead, Claude Corps Compensation: $110,000 to $124,500 per year Start Date: No later than February 8th, ahead of the March 8th cohort launch Together with Anthropic, CodePath launched Claude Corps in June 2026, a national fellowship program with a $150 million commitment to place 1,000 AI-trained fellows at nonprofits across America. As a CodePath Mentor, you are the full-time coach and guide for a portfolio of roughly ten pods: about 20 fellows across 8–12 host organizations, from pre-Basecamp through the final day of the program. Your job is to help each fellow succeed not only in building with AI, but in navigating the organization around the work: understanding the problem, identifying the right stakeholders, communicating ideas clearly, building buy-in, and turning an AI-enabled solution into something people will actually use. The host organization directs the fellow's day-to-day work, the curriculum team owns what they learn, and your Sr. Manager of AI Practice is the manager of record who holds the performance bar. You carry the throughline across the fellow experience: you know your pods end to end, spot patterns and roadblocks early, coach fellows through ambiguity, and bring in deeper technical expertise when needed. The work combines asynchronous coaching and feedback with regular 1:1s, office hours, milestone reviews, roadmap and project feedback, and synchronous coaching when a fellow needs more than text. Fellows may be building technical integrations, designing AI-enabled workflows, educating an organization on AI, or helping a nonprofit adopt an entirely new way of working. You do not need to be the deepest software engineer in the room. You do need enough technical fluency to understand what fellows are building, learn unfamiliar technologies quickly, and help them reason through AI-enabled solutions. Just as importantly, you need the judgment and coaching ability to help an early-career fellow navigate the people, communication, and organizational challenges that determine whether their work succeeds. This role is built for someone who gets energy from helping other people succeed. You may come from engineering, consulting, implementation, technical program management, AI enablement, education, or another client-facing technical environment. What matters most is that you have personally navigated ambiguity, helped people or organizations adopt technology, and can coach fellows through doing the same. Key Responsibilities Coach your pods Carry roughly 20 pods (up to 40 fellows across 16 to 24 host organizations) full-time from pre-Basecamp through final day, calibrating your time across the portfolio rather than sinking into one pod Facilitate weekly 1:1s with all Fellows who report to you and document their progress, challenges, and successes using the tooling Claude Corps operates on Coach fellows through ambiguous projects, helping them clarify the problem, understand organizational context, identify stakeholders, and determine the right next step Give structured feedback on fellows' real work, including project plans, roadmap drafts, architecture proposals, presentations, technical implementations, and QBR deliverables Help fellows strengthen the professional skills required to succeed inside their host organizations, including communication, stakeholder management, presentations, prioritization, and navigating feedback Lead each fellow's Day 30/90/180/270 milestone review; own the fellow-level synthesis and hand it up to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice, who owns the roll-up and performance call Deliver the curriculum in your pods Deliver the just-in-time modules the curriculum team designs; author lane- or pod-specific content when they commission it because you have seen the gap from closer in Coach fellows on applying AI tools and workflows to real organizational problems rather than simply completing technical exercises Frame and debrief the cohort-wide all-hands your Sr. Manager of AI Practice runs, and the sessions where the curriculum team or a guest teaches your fellows directly Co-lead the Basecamp practical assessment alongside Anthropic's instructors; it is your first calibration on each cohort Help fellows navigate organizations Coach fellows through stakeholder discovery, requirements gathering, presentations, organizational buy-in, and change management Help fellows translate between technical possibilities and the business or mission needs of their host organizations Guide fellows through situations where the technical solution is only part of the challenge and adoption, communication, or organizational alignment is the real blocker Model how to work effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, particularly in organizations that may be early in their AI adoption journey Keep the program honest When the same problem shows up across three fellows, raise it to the right owner: the Claude Corps leadership team for program efficacy, the curriculum team for curriculum, partner experts for technical depth, host-org managers for a host issue, or your Sr. Manager of AI Practice for a delivery or performance issue Be the first stop when a fellow's work is at risk, whether the roadblock is technical, organizational, or professional; surface significant risks to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice, who owns the escalation Work AI-natively: Claude and other modern AI tools should be core to how you research, build, coach, problem-solve, identify patterns, and provide feedback at scale Help fellows develop the judgment to use AI effectively, not simply the ability to operate a particular tool Key Success Metrics Fellows can point to concrete examples of how your coaching improved their technical judgment, communication, or ability to navigate their host organization 100% of host-org managers you've worked with in the last 30 days can produce one concrete example of your impact You consistently identify recurring technical, professional, and organizational patterns across your pods and surface them to the right program owner Every Day 30 review is done and documented, handed up to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice, with a plan for any fellow whose work is at risk or ready for the next challenge Qualifications Required 2–5 years of previous professional experience in software engineering, IT, data, technical program management, implementation, solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, technical consulting, AI operations, or another technically adjacent role Hands-on, current experience using modern AI tools and workflows. You should be able to speak concretely about how you use tools such as Claude, AI agents, LLM-based applications, automation, or similar technologies to solve real problems Real coaching, mentorship, people-development, or management experience with concrete examples of helping someone navigate a challenge and become more successful Experience working across stakeholders to understand a problem, clarify needs, recommend or implement a solution, and help people adopt a new way of working Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to facilitate discussions, coach someone through an important presentation, and provide thoughtful asynchronous feedback Comfortable operating as a technical generalist: you can learn quickly, ask the right questions, understand unfamiliar systems, and bring in deeper expertise when needed Comfortable coaching early-career professionals through ambiguity, feedback, organizational dynamics, and the expectations of working in a professional environment Comfortable with remote, synchronous obligations across U.S. time zones and about two evenings a month for cohort sessions and milestone reviews Preferred Client-facing consulting or implementation experience, particularly working with small businesses, nonprofits, education organizations, or teams adopting new technology Experience helping an organization adopt AI, automation, new software, or another significant change in how work gets done TA, bootcamp coach, fellowship mentor, instructor, manager, career coach, or other experience developing early-career technical talent Experience facilitating workshops, presentations, professional learning, or technical training Experience in a small or scrappy organization where understanding the business context was as important as delivering the technical solution Compensation CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position's level, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring for an Individual Contributor level position at an annual salary of $110,000 to $124,500. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process. Full-Time Employee Benefits This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program Financial Security : 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection Work-Life Balance : Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2) Professional Growth : $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support Student Loan Forgiveness : CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt Additional Perks : Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings Pay range $110,000—$124,500 USD

title: Recruiting Systems Administrator
description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. THE ROLE Recruiting Systems Administrator We are looking for a Recruiting Systems Administrator to own the day-to-day administration and optimization of our talent acquisition tech stack. You will be the go-to expert for Greenhouse (ATS), ModernLoop (interview scheduling) and adjacent recruiting tools, including systems built in-house. You will keep these systems configured, connected, and running cleanly so recruiters and coordinators can move fast and hiring teams have a seamless experience. You will also help shape and maintain the talent tooling we build in-house. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves solving problems, tightening processes, and finding opportunities to automate repetitive work as we scale hiring across the business. Responsibilities Administer and configure Greenhouse, ModernLoop, and adjacent recruiting tools, including job templates, interview plans, scorecards, approval chains, and permissions. Manage user access, roles, and permission groups across the TA stack, ensuring the right people have the right level of access and offboarding is timely. Build and maintain recruiting workflows and automations that reduce manual steps for recruiters and coordinators. Own data hygiene in the ATS, including deduplication, field standardization, and routine audits to keep reporting reliable. Support integrations between recruiting tools and downstream systems, and partner with the Systems Engineers on troubleshooting data feeds. Serve as tier-one support for recruiter and coordinator system questions, triaging issues and resolving them or escalating with clear context. Coordinate with vendors on support tickets, release management, new feature rollouts, and configuration changes. Document system configurations, standard operating procedures, and training materials so knowledge does not live in one person's head. Identify and implement opportunities to automate recruiting operations, applying AI-enabled tooling to improve speed and accuracy. Qualifications 5+ years of experience administering recruiting or HR systems, with hands-on Greenhouse or comparable ATS administration. Strong working knowledge of interview scheduling tools such as ModernLoop and their configuration. Demonstrated experience managing user access, permissions, and workflow configuration in SaaS platforms. A track record of improving data hygiene and building reporting-ready processes. Experience supporting integrations between systems and coordinating with vendors on troubleshooting. An automation mindset and comfort using AI-enabled tools to streamline repetitive operational work. Excellent problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail, with the ability to translate recruiter needs into system solutions. Clear written communication and a habit of documenting processes for a scaling team. Experience with SQL and APIs a plus All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles. Pay Range $126,000—$172,000 USD WHY QUINCE? Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form . We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
description: About the Opportunity Our recruiting team is a core strategic driver of OKX 's success. We build the foundation of our future by hiring extraordinary talent who share our mission of building an inclusive future of finance. We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to partner with our core business teams as we expand our footprint across EMEA and globally. In this role, you will act as a strategic talent partner and operational leader—building and cultivating executive and specialized talent pipelines, navigating nuanced regional markets, and optimizing end-to-end recruitment delivery. You will have the opportunity to architect hiring processes from scratch, drive proactive sourcing strategies prioritizing diversity, and help shape the next evolution of OKX. This role reports to the Head of Talent Acquisition. What You’ll Be Doing Strategic Talent Leadership: Define, design, and lead end-to-end talent acquisition strategies across corporate governance, legal, compliance, risk, and operational business functions as organizational priorities scale. Proactive Sourcing & Pipeline Architecture: Build and execute targeted sourcing campaigns to engage and close high-caliber passive talent across global and EMEA talent hubs. Regional Market Navigation: Navigate complex EMEA hiring dynamics, proactively managing regional notice periods, candidate expectations, and competitive talent pools to maintain velocity and operational efficiency. Talent Intelligence & Advisory: Conduct competitor mapping and gather market intelligence across fintech, traditional banking, and crypto to advise leadership on talent trends, salary benchmarks, and organizational design. Employer Value Proposition: Articulate OKX’s vision to bridge traditional corporate and financial services talent into Web3 and decentralized finance. Complex Negotiations & Closing: Direct senior-level offer formulations, equity/token incentive structuring, and complex negotiations, partnering closely with People Operations for seamless onboarding. Hiring Manager Coaching & Governance: Act as an expert advisor, upskilling hiring managers and interview panels on structured assessment frameworks, interview best practices, and high-touch candidate experience. What We Look For In You Experience: 6+ years of full-lifecycle talent acquisition experience within a fast-paced corporate environment, high-growth fintech/financial services firm, or executive search firm, with demonstrated experience leading strategic hiring initiatives. Sourcing & Closing: Proven track record of identifying, engaging, and closing senior passive talent across competitive finance, banking, or fintech ecosystems. EMEA Labor Knowledge: In-depth understanding of cross-border EMEA hiring practices, regional employment regulations, statutory notice periods, and hiring frameworks (FTE vs. contractor, local entities vs. EOR). Strategic Influence & Data Fluency: Strong business acumen with hands-on experience leveraging recruitment metrics, funnel analytics, and market intelligence to guide executive decision-making. Agility & Ownership: High degree of comfort operating in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments with changing business priorities. Stakeholder Management: Exceptional consultative communication, executive presence, and stakeholder management skills. Nice to Haves Deep familiarity with EMEA fintech, traditional banking, and digital asset/Web3 ecosystems. Working knowledge of regional regulatory environments affecting financial talent hiring (e.g., MiCA, AML frameworks, PSD2/PSD3, FCA, BaFin, DASP). Experience recruiting within a globally distributed, multilingual organization. Genuine interest or personal background in blockchain technology, crypto, and decentralized finance. Perks & Benefits Competitive total compensation package Various team-building programs and company events Wellness and meal allowances Comprehensive healthcare coverage for employees and dependents Additional regional benefits and perks shared throughout the interview process Notice: All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website. Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice .

title: Senior Product Designer, Foundations
description: Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 . What you'll bring 8+ years as a product designer, including experience working on B2B products. You can do the product thinking: edge cases, shipping work that has to hold up in a real product. Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave. Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook .

description: Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. title: Senior Fraud Investigator, Prevent
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍UK Remote | 💰£31,100 - £39,350 + Incentive awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>✨</p> <p>Shift pattern: 37.5 hours per week - Monday to Friday 9am to 6pm, working 1 in 5 weekends and 1 week of 11:30am - 8pm every 4 weeks. Please note you may be required to work bank holidays, including Christmas Day, Boxing Day and New Years Day.</p> <h4>Start date - Monday 18th Jan 2027</h4> <p><strong>⭐ About our Financial Crime & Fraud Team:</strong></p> <p>Our Mission in the Financial Crime & Fraud Collective is to earn and keep our customers’ trust, support Monzo’s safe growth, and contribute to building a safer society. Our Senior Fraud Investigators are crucial to the success of this mission.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Fraud Investigator, you will be part of the Prevent pillar which provides vital intervention and education to Monzo customers who are experiencing potential active fraud attempts on their funds across two main channels:</p> <ul> <li>Authorised card payment fraud</li> <li>Authorised faster payment fraud</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your day to day; </strong></p> <p>Senior Fraud Investigators in our Prevent pillar support the quality of performance and knowledge across the pillar by answering escalations, supporting operational changes, and speaking to our customers who are at potential risk of the most complex scams. We’re looking for investigators with in-depth knowledge of cryptocurrency and understanding of how this can be used by fraudsters across a range of typologies as we continue to develop and optimise our controls. This means you can complete a complex investigation from start to finish for our customers and provide clear feedback to our teams as we work together to become the most trusted bank in the UK. </p> <p>Specific responsibilities include: </p> <ul> <li>Gathering evidence from flagged transaction data </li> <li>Use of Monzo’s values to investigate the nature of suspicious transactions with empathy and attention to detail.</li> <li>Use of Monzo’s values to reassure and support customers through the process of identifying active fraud.</li> <li>Independently making decisions on cases and releasing or blocking flagged transactions up to a case value of £59,999.00.</li> <li>Submitting accounts for closure where first party concerns are held following investigation (in line with relevant guidance).</li> <li>Triaging cases with a value of more than £59,999.00 for upwards escalation</li> <li>Safeguarding compromised accounts and taking appropriate remedial action to ensure customers can resume safe usage of their Monzo account.</li> <li>Providing advice and support to victims of fraud on how they can protect themselves in the future.</li> <li>Handling non-FOS complaints and feeding back to Investigators and their managers where required as part of our continuous improvement feedback loop.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>A strong understanding of regulatory requirements in fraud and/or financial crime</li> <li>A strong knowledge of cryptocurrency and how this is used in fraud typologies </li> <li>Excellent English written & verbal communication skills and experience speaking to victims of potential fraud</li> <li>Ability to be persuasive and empathetic</li> <li>Strong expertise in investigating, problem solving and decision making</li> <li>Ability to work well independently & be collaborative with the wider team</li> <li>Ability to work to deadlines</li> <li>Values driven approach in line with Monzo’s core values</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £31,100 - £39,350 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of<a href="https://monzo.com/careers"> benefits</a></p> <p><strong>🌈 The Interview Process:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Some initial application questions (please take your time, we read these carefully!)</li> <li>A short call with a Recruiter</li> <li>A remote interview, lasting approximately 1 hour with two team members from the Fraud Team.</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>Linkedin Tags:  #LI-REMOTE #LI-SK2</p> <section class=""></section> <div id="ember214" class="ember-view messaging-side-panel__overlay"></div> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

As Escalation Manager, you'll own complex, executive, and commercial escalations where customer trust and the relationship are at stake, alongside or independently of a technical issue.</p> <p>In this functional role, you'll advocate for customers inside GitLab, coordinate teams toward resolution, and lead relationship repair after the event.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own complex, executive, and commercial escalations end-to-end, as defined in GitLab's IM/EM engagement model.</li> <li>Advocate for customers internally and coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales toward resolution, tracking commitments and holding owning teams accountable to agreed dates and deliverables.</li> <li>Maintain a written, customer-facing resolution plan from engagement through confirmed resolution, updating it at each communication milestone.</li> <li>Coordinate with Incident Managers during concurrent technical incidents to maintain a single, coherent narrative for the customer.</li> <li>Own external escalation communications using GitLab's approved templates and cadence, and represent GitLab in high-stakes customer conversations where clarity and ownership influence retention.</li> <li>Engage Sales, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders as needed, including executive-to-executive communication for Severity 1 and 2 events. Brief GitLab leadership with concise summaries that distinguish what's known, what's unknown, and next steps.</li> <li>Lead post-escalation reviews and relationship repair plans, contribute corrective actions with named owners and due dates to postmortems, and hand the relationship back to the account's Customer Success Manager at resolution.</li> <li>Partner with the Head of IM/EM to develop playbooks, communication templates, and process improvements based on patterns from escalations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in enterprise technical support, customer success, or incident and escalation management at a business-to-business software-as-a-service or enterprise software company.</li> <li>A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder escalations end-to-end, including executive customer engagements and structured resolution or account plans.</li> <li>Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail into plain-language updates for customers and GitLab leadership.</li> <li>The ability to coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales under pressure without formal authority over those teams.</li> <li>Calm, structured decision-making with incomplete information and the ability to provide a steadying presence in high-stress customer situations.</li> <li>Proficiency with support and coordination tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, and PagerDuty, or equivalent platforms.</li> <li>Availability for on-call coverage supporting executive escalations as part of a globally distributed team.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Nice to have:  </strong>Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation or equivalent certification; customer-facing experience with GitLab, development, security, and operations (DevSecOps), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), or cloud-native products; experience with formal escalation or incident command frameworks; or AI-assisted support tools for triage, sentiment analysis, or resolution drafting.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Incident & Escalation Management function sits within Support Engineering in GitLab's Enterprise Technology & AI (ETA) division. We operate a follow-the-sun model anchored in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Asia-Pacific, providing year-round, 24-hour coverage for enterprise customers. Our Escalation Managers work globally rather than within a single region, partnering with Incident Managers, Communications Leads, and regional Support Engineering leadership. You'll help shape our playbooks, templates, and standards as we scale.</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages.</p> <p>CRAs join us, love their jobs, and stay because of the amazing people and enjoyable quality of life. Most meaningfully - your voice will be heard. Working in a smaller CRO allows you to have influence and impact when it matters most and support from direct line management.</p> <p><strong>We are hiring a Clinical Research Associate II/ Senior Clinical Research Associate, this position will be fully home based working in the UK or Northern Ireland.  </strong></p> <p><strong>About you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are calm, thoughtful, and responsive when things don’t go as planned.</li> <li>You are well-prepared, whether it be for an investigator meeting, site visit or project team update, always staying two steps ahead of the game.</li> <li>You find quick and creative ways of overcoming difficulties.</li> <li>You have an impeccable eye for detail.</li> <li>You identify potential study risks and propose solutions on how to mitigate them.</li> <li>You take responsibility in the quality and outcomes of your work.</li> <li>You are adept at handling conflict by using tried and true resolution strategies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How we will keep you busy and support your growth:</strong></p> <p>You will monitor and own the progress of clinical studies at investigative sites and ensure that clinical studies are conducted, recorded, and reported per protocol, SOPs, ICH-GCP, and all applicable regulations and standards. You will coordinate all necessary activities required to set up and monitor a study (i.e., identify investigators; helping prepare regulatory submissions, conducting pre-study and initiation visits, etc.).</p> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <p>Minimum Required:</p> <ul> <li>4-year college degree or equivalent experience</li> </ul> <p>Other Required:</p> <ul> <li>Candidates should ideally have more than 1 years CRA experience within the CRO or pharmaceutical industry.</li> <li>Oncology experience essential</li> <li>Phase I experience desirable although not essential</li> <li>First-In-Human (FIH) desirable although not essential</li> <li>Availability for domestic travel including overnight stays, which may constitute up to approximately 50-60% travel commitment (international travel may be required for some senior level positions)</li> <li>Fluency in English</li> </ul> <p>Precision’s uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology.</p> <p>Precision medicine is revolutionizing the attack on cancer—and we are passionate about helping you harness its power. Ultimately, we deliver robust insights that inform real-time decisions—and optimize the oncology development pathway.</p> <p>We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving our clients that are researching groundbreaking cancer therapies.
