title: Intermediate Fullstack Engineer, Subscription Lifecycle
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h1>Intermediate Fullstack Engineer, Subscription Lifecycle (Monetization)</h1> <p>Remote, AMEA</p> <h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an Intermediate Fullstack Engineer on GitLab's Subscription Lifecycle team within Monetization, you'll build the frontend experiences and backend services customers use to view and manage subscriptions, renew products, configure auto-renewal, and manage billing accounts. Your work will span renewals, overages and reconciliations, subscription visibility, and budget and reservation management, keeping subscription, billing, and account data accurate and reliable. Because these workflows directly affect revenue, customer access, and financial information, you'll use technical judgment, safe and iterative rollouts, and a high bar for reliability and correctness.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Building a clear, reliable subscription view across the Customers Portal and related surfaces</li> <li value="2">Improving manual renewal and auto-renewal flows, including supporting emails, banners, and account experiences</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design and build fullstack features across the post-purchase subscription journey.</li> <li value="2">Contribute to the technical design and implementation of new subscription lifecycle capabilities.</li> <li value="3">Partner with Product and Design to translate renewal, billing account, and customer experience requirements into resilient, well-tested solutions.</li> <li value="4">Integrate subscription lifecycle workflows safely with billing, customer account, and internal admin systems.</li> <li value="5">Write maintainable, well-tested code and follow engineering practices for rollout safety and monitoring.</li> <li value="6">Participate in code reviews and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback.</li> <li value="7">Identify and reduce technical debt and architectural risk in the subscription lifecycle.</li> <li value="8">Participate in incident response for subscription and renewal issues, given their potential impact on revenue and customer access.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience as a fullstack engineer and confidence working across frontend and backend code. Our purchase applications use Ruby on Rails and Vue.js.</li> <li value="2">Experience owning technical direction for a product area, including proposing, discussing, and driving thorough, iterative solutions.</li> <li value="3">Experience building or maintaining transactional or checkout-style flows, ideally in a billing, ecommerce, or subscription context.</li> <li value="4">Familiarity integrating with third-party billing or customer relationship management systems, such as Zuora, Salesforce, or Stripe, is a plus, not a requirement.</li> <li value="5">A focus on safe, incremental delivery given the revenue and customer impact of this work.</li> <li value="6">The ability to communicate clearly and concisely about complex technical, architectural, and organizational problems and propose thorough, iterative solutions.</li> <li value="7">Written and spoken English proficiency sufficient to collaborate in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.</li> <li value="8">Alignment with GitLab's values and a commitment to working in accordance with them.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Subscription Lifecycle team is part of GitLab's Monetization section and owns the post-purchase subscription experience. You'll partner with Sales, Finance, Information Technology, and Support on secure, reliable purchasing, billing, provisioning, and utilization workflows, and report to the Engineering Manager, Purchase. The team works asynchronously, with regular planning and retrospectives and shared expectations for deployments, incident management, testing, and rollout safety. GitLab's mission is to enable everyone to contribute and co-create the software that powers our world. The Purchase team's mission is to make it as easy as possible for anyone to buy, add on to, or upgrade GitLab through a single, trustworthy, unified purchase experience. title: Technical Engineering Manager

title: Head of Engineering | xpate
description: Role: Head of Engineering Company: xpate Location: London or remote Job Type: Full-time About xpate xpate has been a card acquirer since 2019. It combines acquiring and banking for B2B clients only, with €100M+ in annual revenue. About 100 people work there, around 15 of them in engineering. HQ is in London, and the team is spread across Latvia, Cyprus, Serbia and Singapore. The business is changing. xpate is moving from direct sales to distribution through platforms and partners: embedded finance and Payfac-as-a-Service. The platform has to change with it. Tooling, data flow, processes and the release cycle all need a rebuild, and much of the workflow is still tracked by hand. xpate also wants to become AI-native. Guardrails go around the core – the data layer and financial data – so it can’t be lost, rewritten or broken. Everything else runs through an agentic harness on top, so non-engineering teams can build their own tools by prompting agents. What you will do Lead the platform and organizational transformation from the inside, together with the current team. Own the whole technical picture: infrastructure, architecture and vendors. Replace the traditional PM → engineer handoff. Test the idea that engineering and product can work as one, with engineers talking directly to the business and domain experts. Move code writing to LLMs with automated QA. Start where mistakes are cheap and reach the critical financial components later. Hire engineers who talk to people and ask questions, not only write code. You can bring in 1–2 people who share the vision. Focus on internal efficiency. The business sets the direction – the job is not to set a product or market vision of your own. First 6 months Months 1–3: bring all data flow – customer, financial and manual – into one clear perimeter. Months 4–6: build the harness on top, so non-engineering teams can prompt agents, create their own tools and run their workflows. What you need to succeed You have built financial systems: ledger, reconciliation, processing, gateway, double-entry accounting. Ideally you wrote them yourself, and you know what a few cents of error cost at scale. You have a strong data architecture background. You can hold the full technical picture: infrastructure, architecture and vendors. You are a senior engineer with proven results. Team size doesn’t matter – leading 4–5 people is fine. You know code quality and review still matter, and you are ready to change how the work gets done. You think and talk like a business person. You are a mature operator: collaborative, transparent, no “I know best”. You change things carefully and still make bold calls. Payments or acquiring background is not required – any financial systems experience works. Nice to have: you have rebuilt or transformed a team before. Nice to have: you are based in London. What you get A new role with a clear mission: transform the platform and the way the company works. Direct work with the founders, reporting to the CEO. A team of about 15 engineers to inherit and reshape. A profitable company moving into Payfac-as-a-Service and embedded distribution. An AI-native setup where non-engineers build their own tools. Year 1 is fixed pay. From year 2, shadow equity tied to P&L performance, with a path to real equity. Details to be agreed. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Consultant Pain Management PAYE
description: An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short. We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team. About the role You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK. You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care. What you will be doing: Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment. Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management. Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices. Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards. Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists. Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs). What you need: Full GMC Registration Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification On the GMC Specialist Register for Pain Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting Why join us? Highly Competitive Salary: £190,000 - £275,000 FTE, pro rata for part time roles Flexible Working: Full time or part time options available Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu will cover all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us Private Healthcare Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on call requirements Cutting Edge Training: Access to CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders Collaborative Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals Personal Growth: Be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK Training & Development: Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians (sponsored by Montu) Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant). Ongoing support and training on clinical protocols, prescribing practices, and Montu’s system usage Working arrangements: Remote Role: Flexible working hours and days Session Structure: Standard session length: 4 hours Appointment duration: 15 minutes (new and existing patients) Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks. If you are passionate about innovative patient care, thrive in a dynamic environment, and are looking to make a real impact in the field of medical cannabis, we would love to hear from you! Sessions: Each standard session consists of 4 hours of patient consultations. Clinicians can choose their preferred working days and hours, with sessions spread flexibly if needed. To support onboarding, clinicians are required to commit to a minimum of 2 sessions per week/ 8 hours initially, to ensure they become proficient with Montu’s platform. Appointment Durations: Appointments are 15 minutes in length for new and existing patients as Montu operates a multidisciplinary approach, leveraging a clinical skills mix where nurses and pharmacists handle pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks allowing Consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care. About MONTU Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and offering an exceptional standard of care. Our dynamic and supportive work environment is the perfect place for you to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives. title: (Senior) Full Stack Engineer (m/f/x) - Based in Germany
description: Cara Care, a digital health company backed by Bayer AG, is on a mission to improve people’s digestive health through technology. As we expand our product portfolio and modernize our platform, we’re looking for a versatile, pragmatic, and forward-thinking (Senior) Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/x) to help shape the future of digital therapeutics. Your Role You’ll join a cross-functional product team with high ownership, lean processes, and a clear focus: deliver real impact to patients. We’re looking for someone who thrives on solving real-world problems with code, is technology-open, and knows when to build fast and when to build right. Your main focus will be building and improving our backend services, while also contributing to our React Native apps. You’ll also help us use AI tools and coding agents thoughtfully in day-to-day engineering, turning emerging capabilities into reliable workflows that improve how we design, build, test, and operate patient-facing products. Your Responsibilities Design, build, and operate reliable backend services and APIs , primarily using Python, Django, and PostgreSQL, and contribute targeted changes to our React Native applications with TypeScript. Use AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and generate tests. Define clear tasks and constraints, provide relevant context, Provide clear context and constraints, and validate changes through code review, automated tests, and application-level checks. Take an end-to-end view of features : understand how mobile clients, APIs, data models, and infrastructure interact, and make pragmatic technical decisions across these boundaries. Own backend delivery from architecture and implementation to automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration, and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines. Improve the performance and reliability of our backend services, APIs, and databases. Connect AI-assisted development to engineering and design tools via MCP, for example to automate repetitive coding tasks or check frontend changes against Figma designs. Keep patient data, credentials, and other sensitive information out of unapproved tools and workflows. Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Medical to explore, define, and deliver patient-centric features across our platform, supporting regulated digital health products for IBS, GERD, and upcoming indications. Uphold technical excellence in architecture, code quality, and security , including applicable requirements under IEC 62304, BSI TR-03161, and the MDR. Mentor other developers and help raise the technical bar across the team. Requirements Your Profile Must haves 5+ years of professional software engineering experience , with a strong backend focus and an understanding of how complete applications work from user interface to infrastructure. Strong backend development skills in an established language such as Python, TypeScript, Java, or PHP. Our current stack includes Python, Django, and PostgreSQL. Working knowledge of React Native and TypeScript , with the ability to implement and test changes in an existing mobile application. Solid understanding of relational databases, API design, distributed systems and services . Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for backend services and APIs , including unit and integration tests. Solid understanding of backend security and privacy , including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and secure handling of personal and patient data. Strong practical knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architecture , with experience using GCP or another major cloud provider such as AWS or Azure. Hands-on experience using AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and write automated tests, including connecting agents to engineering tools via MCP . You can explain how you scoped the work, verified the results, and handled tool permissions and sensitive data. A pragmatic product mindset : you collaborate effectively with non-technical stakeholders, understand the impact of technical decisions on patients and UX, and continuously improve both product and platform. Nice-to-have Strong Linux administration skills , including setting up, operating, and securing self-managed cloud instances; familiarity with monitoring and observability concepts. Experience with Prometheus, Loki, and Grafana ; GitOps using ArgoCD or FluxCD; or configuration management using Ansible or similar tools. Networking knowledge and experience with mobile CI/CD, release automation, or application monitoring tools such as Sentry. Experience in regulated industries, healthcare, or other security-conscious environments . 💡 Please note : Cara Care is a remote-first company with a fully distributed team. All team members are based in Germany so candidates must reside in Germany to join us . Benefits 💸 Fair compensation: We offer fair pay, regular salary reviews, and the equipment you need to do your best work. 🫶 Great team spirit: Join a vibrant, interdisciplinary team and enjoy a friendly, supportive working atmosphere, with regular in-person team events. 👨‍💻 Remote-first working: Prefer working from home? No problem. Want to join us at our Berlin office? That works too. Our remote-first approach gives you the flexibility to work where it suits you best. 🏝️ 30 days off per year: Rest matters. You’ll get 26 vacation days plus 4 additional company-wide mental health days each year to take a breather and recharge. 🦉 Flexible working hours: Whether you’re an early bird or prefer a later start, you can shape your working day around what works for you. 🏋️ Urban Sports Club (USC): Enjoy access to a wide range of sports, fitness, and wellness activities at discounted rates. 🧠 OpenUp: Access a variety of resources and services to support your mental health and personal wellbeing. 🛍️ Corporate Benefits: Get attractive discounts and exclusive offers from a wide range of well-known brands and providers. 🚀 Make a real impact: Be involved, contribute your ideas, and help shape what comes next. Your voice matters, and you can make a real difference. About Cara Care Cara Care is a digital health company on a mission to improve the lives of people with digestive health conditions through holistic, science-based digital therapies. Our established IBS therapy, Cara Care für Reizdarm, provides personalised content, practical exercises, and symptom tracking to help people better understand and manage their condition. It is listed in the German Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices’ (BfArM) directory of digital health applications (DiGA) and is covered by statutory health insurance in Germany. We are expanding our product portfolio and evolving our technology platform to bring digital therapies to more people across a broader range of conditions. Backed by Bayer We’re proud to share that Cara Care has recently joined the Bayer Group, a move that strengthens our mission and enables us to scale our impact even further. With Bayer’s global healthcare expertise and our innovative digital approach, we’re poised to redefine care for digestive health. What It’s Like to Work With Us At Cara Care, you’ll be part of an interdisciplinary team of doctors, designers, engineers, and creatives who are deeply passionate about improving lives. title: Senior CX Platform Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior CX Platform Engineer, you'll help GitLab's Customer Experience (CX) teams hand real work to artificial intelligence (AI). You'll use Claude Code and GitLab Duo Agent Platform as your default development tools, designing agentic workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with production testing, security, and shared ownership. This is a software engineering role, not ticket-taking internal IT, AI evangelism disconnected from shipped code, or customer-billable Professional Services delivery.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Use Claude Code, GitLab Duo, and other coding agents as your primary development environment for planning, implementation, refactoring, testing, reviews, and documentation. Run multiple agents in parallel on well-scoped tasks, critically review their output, and own every line that reaches production.</li> <li>Build and maintain the team's agent harness, including shared AGENTS.md conventions, skills, slash commands, hooks, subagent definitions, and continuous integration checks. Measure and share what works, publish reusable patterns, and retire those that don't.</li> <li>Ship agents and multi-step workflows for account research, success planning, scoping, status reporting, and customer onboarding. Package them as skills and plugins for non-engineers using Claude, Claude in Slack, and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.</li> <li>Build MCP servers and connectors for governed access to GitLab, Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, Thought Industries, Gong, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems. Add evaluations, tracing, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints to keep internal and customer-facing agents measurable, auditable, and safe with customer data.</li> <li>Evolve the CX Application Platform's gateway, Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, including Elastic Container Service (ECS), Relational Database Service (RDS), and Lambda, Terraform configuration, application scaffold, and deployment path. Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.</li> <li>Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.</li> <li>Prototype with Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training in days, not quarters. Help CX team members bring their own applications to production, and turn field learning into reusable reference implementations, development paths, and enablement.</li> <li>Contribute upstream to GitLab and share product feedback with Product and Engineering. Mentor engineers and non-engineers on agentic development and raise the team's code review bar.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building and operating production software, owning multi-quarter work from ambiguity to production, choosing reusable platform solutions over one-off customization where appropriate, and designing for handoff.</li> <li>Daily, hands-on use of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitLab Duo, or similar on production work. You can show how they've changed what you ship and how you maintain quality.</li> <li>Experience building with large language models (LLMs) beyond chat, including tool use, MCP servers, agent loops, context and retrieval design, prompt and workflow design, and evaluations.</li> <li>Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Flask and TypeScript skills with Vue or React, including application programming interface (API) design, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer and business data.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta.</li> <li>Experience integrating enterprise systems through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL APIs, and fluency with Git, merge requests, and CI/CD.</li> <li>Experience translating non-engineering stakeholders' workflows into technical plans and writing clear asynchronous design documents, decision records, and enablement materials. You align with GitLab's values and are willing to use GitLab for your own work.</li> <li>Optional experience includes agent harness customization; the GitLab Development Kit, Duo Agent Platform custom agents and flows, or AI Catalog publishing; enterprise agent governance and data controls; customer success, professional services, or learning platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, or Thought Industries; professional services economics and customer success metrics; Snowflake or similar warehouses; and technical writing, talks, or open source contributions on agentic development.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; you don't need to meet every nice-to-have to apply.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>CX Platform Engineering builds and runs CX Applications for Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training. We own the CX Application Platform's gateway and infrastructure alongside our application portfolio: GitLab University, the Foundational Onboarding Agent in GitLab Duo Agent Platform, Congregate, PS Compass, and Customer Wins. We build the first version with the people doing the work, turn what we learn into a reusable pattern, then hand it off so it runs without us. We reward leverage, not heroics, and don't leave tools dependent on one person.</p> <h4><br><br></h4><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Product Support Specialist, Eastern/Central Time
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels. Location & work mode Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. What you’ll do - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through all communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations What we're looking for - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users. - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile). - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. title: Commercial Lead
location: London or remote within the UK
description: About Griffin Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences. We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more. We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies. Learn more about what we do Our culture We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible. We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life. We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified. Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers. Learn more about our culture. The team We’re the Connect team, what most companies call Sales. We strive to bring the best in technology, user experience and banking to the embedded finance space and be the bank for fintechs and corporates to build on. We’re 10 people across Commercial, Customers Success and Marketing, led by Phoebe, our Chief Revenue Officer and we’re currently focused on winning new businesses and selecting the right customers to partner with for long term mutual success. The opportunity You’ll take Griffin’s licensed bank and banking-as-a-service proposition to mid-market and enterprise companies in payments, lending, proptech, vertical SaaS, insurtech and digital assets. You’ll own each deal from first lead to signed commercial terms. You’ll show their engineering, product, risk and compliance teams how it all works, from API architecture and safeguarding to ledger flows, and talk with confidence to their CFO, COO or CTO. You’ll build your own pipeline, shape pricing for complex accounts with RevOps and Finance, and work with Legal, Compliance and Product on bespoke client needs. Think solutions architect who closes. What success looks like Within 12 months, you’ll have built a pipeline you sourced yourself, with deals that are bigger and more structured as you go. Prospects’ CFOs and CTOs will trust you to explain how it all works, and Legal, Compliance and Product will bring you in early on every non-standard deal. To do this you’ll own Your pipeline, from first lead to signed commercial terms, including sourcing your own leads alongside whatever SDRs and marketing bring in Whiteboard sessions on account structures, and the technical proposal content, which you’ll write yourself Pricing and commercial structures for complex accounts, such as consumption-based or bundled models, tiered volume and transfer pricing, built with RevOps and Finance Regulatory and compliance questions, answered before they turn into objections Commercial and technical arrangements for non-standard client requirements, shaped with Legal, Compliance and Product Your background To ensure this, we’re looking for people who have: Built and closed their own pipeline, and get their energy from chasing and winning new business A strong grasp of payments and banking infrastructure (settlement, safeguarding, ledgers, APIs, card and account issuing) and enough regulatory knowledge (EMI versus bank licence, Consumer Duty, safeguarding rules) to hold a credible conversation with a compliance team Sold complex deals with long cycles and several buying committees, and negotiated beyond simple discounting, including pricing models, volume commitments and contractual carve-outs A low ego and high curiosity, with a real appetite for understanding how the plumbing works The resilience for long, technical sales cycles, and the confidence to work without a fixed script while our products and structures evolve A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write ) Nice to haves Ideally, you would also: Have worked at a BaaS provider, EMI or challenger bank, including in an SMCR-regulated environment Have a structuring background, such as transaction structuring, treasury or Big 4 financial services advisory What can we offer you? We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future. Salary: Up to £100,000 + commission Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK. However, for this role you will need to be comfortable with regular travel to London, often at short notice. Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year) Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment. How long will the process take? We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other. Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience. Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements. Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin. Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview. Step 5 : Pitch the Founder and CRevO Step 6: Culture interview: Learn more about this here . As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks How do I apply? Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next. Under representation At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance Griffin Bank Ltd request that recruitment agencies do not speculatively submit CVs to any employee or associate of our company unless explicitly asked to do so by a member of our Talent team. Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: We run Camunda on Camunda. Our Enterprise Agentic Automation Team (EAAT) builds production-grade agentic orchestration using Camunda's platform for Camunda's own operations, from Finance to Support to Go-to-Market. As Senior Architect, you own delivery on our EAAT-led initiatives end to end. You partner with process owners to uncover where the biggest value lies, redesign how the work should flow, decide where agents, rules or people handle each step, and shape it into scope our engineers can build from directly. Then you lead technical delivery management with our engineers, steering increments, dependencies and decisions until you get it live and prove the value. You won't design and hand over: you stay until it works in production, and keep evolving it. What You Will Do: Own delivery of our use cases end to end, business and technical, from discovery to production and value realization Run discovery with process owners: as-is baseline, target process, and where agents, rules or humans handle each step Turn target processes into epics engineers can build from directly: scenarios, acceptance criteria, increments Design solutions within our reference architecture, and bring new patterns based on lessons learned Lead technical delivery on your initiatives: plan increments with the engineers, manage dependencies and risks, and keep process owners and sponsors aligned on progress and decisions Define and track value per initiative and increment, and keep business decisions moving Feed delivery learnings back into the reference architecture, our delivery method and Camunda's product What you bring: Ability and/or willingness to use our product . description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As Lead Legal Counsel, Corporate, you'll own securities, public company reporting, and corporate governance work for GitLab, a growing public technology company. You'll join the Legal & Corporate Affairs (LACA) team as a senior individual contributor, reporting to the Senior Director, Associate General Counsel, Corporate & Compliance.</p> <p>You'll bring a strong securities law foundation and a broad corporate perspective to a small team. Your work will span quarterly reporting and earnings, the annual proxy statement and stockholders meeting, board and committee matters, equity plans, and subsidiary governance. You'll also support mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and other strategic initiatives. You'll work closely with Accounting, Corporate Development, Finance, Investor Relations, People, Product, Stock Administration, Tax, and Treasury. You'll translate complex legal issues into clear recommendations, build trust across functions, and balance legal risk with business objectives. </p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This is a remote role open to candidates anywhere in the United States. We have a preference for candidates based in the San Francisco Bay Area, but we welcome applications from all US locations.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Own securities and public company reporting matters, working with internal stakeholders and external auditors on Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filings, quarterly reports, earnings releases, the annual proxy statement, investor presentations, and other public disclosures.</li> <li>Advise on corporate governance, including board and committee processes, the annual stockholders meeting, corporate approvals, equity plan matters, executive compensation, and related compliance requirements.</li> <li>Provide legal guidance on complex entity matters across jurisdictions, including formation, maintenance, reorganizations, intercompany agreements, and wind-downs.</li> <li>Support M&A and other strategic transactions, contributing to diligence, documentation, approvals, signing, closing, and post-closing integration.</li> <li>Engage and manage outside counsel across jurisdictions, coordinating work and ensuring practical, high-quality, and cost-effective advice.</li> <li>Identify legal and business risks, present clear options to senior stakeholders, and monitor legal developments to keep policies, processes, and controls current.</li> <li>Build and improve playbooks, checklists, templates, and workflows for recurring corporate legal work. Train junior legal team members and cross-functional partners to use these resources.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of demonstrated relevant legal experience, including law firm experience advising US-listed public companies on securities law, corporate governance, and public company reporting. Prior in-house experience is a plus.</li> <li>A Juris Doctor (JD) degree and active admission to a US state bar.</li> <li>The ability to independently manage complex legal matters and cross-functional projects, prioritize competing needs, and drive work to completion with limited direction.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical legal issues to non-lawyers and senior leaders and build trusted working relationships.</li> <li>The ability to investigate unfamiliar legal questions, weigh risks against business objectives, and turn recommendations into action.</li> <li>Experience improving legal processes, templates, policies, or other scalable resources.</li> <li>The ability to collaborate in a remote, globally distributed team across time zones and cultures, and willingness to use GitLab in your day-to-day work.</li> <li>Helpful but not required: in-house work at a public software-as-a-service (SaaS), software, or open core company; M&A; cross-border corporate matters; outside counsel management; or legal technology that helps scale legal work.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Corporate & Compliance team supports principled corporate governance and GitLab's culture of compliance. We work with leaders and subject matter experts across LACA and the broader company to provide practical, timely legal guidance. LACA is a globally distributed team that supports GitLab's growth through legal expertise, business partnership, and continuous process improvement. We work transparently, collaborate across functions and time zones, and use GitLab's own tools and AI-enabled workflows to make legal support more efficient and accessible.<br><br></p> <h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" target="_blank">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/paid-time-off/" target="_blank">Flexible Paid Time Off</a> </li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging." target="_blank">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/" target="_blank">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/" target="_blank">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave" target="_blank">Parental leave</a> </li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#equipment" target="_blank">Home office</a> support</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Head of IT
description: Unternehmen Die PolymerCycle Gruppe ist ein integriertes Kunststoffrecycling-Unternehmen und vereint die Best Plastic Management GmbH, PB Solutions GmbH, ATP Service & Consulting GmbH und Hoffmann+Voss GmbH. Gemeinsam machen wir aus Kunststoffabfällen hochwertige Rezyklate, die Neuware in anspruchsvollen Anwendungen ersetzen – etwa in der Automobil-, Elektro- oder Verpackungsindustrie. Dabei decken unsere Gesellschaften jeden Schritt des Recyclingkreislaufs ab: vom Handel mit Sekundärrohstoffen und PCR-/PIR-Stoffströmen über die Trennung komplexer Kunststoffgemische mit innovativen Dichtetrennverfahren und die Regranulierung in großen Mengen bis hin zu maßgeschneiderten Recompounds für technische Kunststoffe. Damit zählt PolymerCycle zu den wenigen Anbietern, die den gesamten Recyclingkreislauf vom Kunststoffabfall bis zum fertig spezifizierten Compound aus einer Hand abbilden – und ist optimal aufgestellt für die wachsende europäische Nachfrage nach hochwertigen Rezyklaten. Digitale Geschäftsprozesse verbinden bei uns alle Bereiche: vom Vertrieb über die Steuerung der Stoffströme und die Produktion bis zur kaufmännischen Abwicklung. Diese vernetzte Systemlandschaft wollen wir gezielt weiterentwickeln. Als Head of IT (m/w/d) der PolymerCycle Gruppe verantwortest Du den zuverlässigen Betrieb dieser Systeme und bringst neue Technologien aktiv und pragmatisch ein, immer mit Blick auf den Nutzen für das Geschäft. Position Head of IT Anstellung in der PolymerCycle Gruppe mit übergreifender Verantwortung für die IT aller Gesellschaften Aufgaben & Verantwortung Gesamtverantwortung für IT und Digitalisierung der Unternehmensgruppe mit klarem Fokus auf Standardisierung, Skalierbarkeit und Wertsteigerung im Private-Equity-Umfeld Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer gruppenweiten IT- und Digitalisierungsstrategie inklusive Roadmap, Budgetverantwortung und Priorisierung in enger Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung und Gesellschaftern Harmonisierung und Weiterentwicklung der ERP- und Applikationslandschaft über alle Gesellschaften hinweg, inklusive der IT-seitigen Integration neu erworbener Unternehmen Verantwortung für einen stabilen, sicheren und skalierbaren IT-Betrieb an allen Standorten – von Infrastruktur, Netzwerken und Cloud-Services bis hin zur Produktions-IT Sicherstellung und Weiterentwicklung von IT-Security, Business Continuity und Compliance inklusive Richtlinien, Notfallkonzepten und Awareness in der Organisation Führung und Weiterentwicklung der IT-Funktionen in den Gesellschaften sowie Steuerung externer Dienstleister und Partner inklusive Vertrags-, Kosten- und Leistungscontrolling Zentrale Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen den Fachbereichen, den Gesellschaften, der Geschäftsführung und dem Private-Equity-Investor als Sparringspartner für Digitalisierungs- und Automatisierungsinitiativen Qualifikationen Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, der Ingenieurwissenschaften, der Betriebswirtschaft mit IT-Schwerpunkt oder vergleichbare title: Senior Business Analyst

Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">The Senior Business Analyst plays a key role in shaping the growth and success of Moniepoint’s payment products. You'll design, test, and implement strategies that improve user acquisition, boost retention, and elevate product engagement. This role blends deep quantitative analysis with collaborative, strategic thinking. You'll partner with teams across the business to ensure our payment solutions meet real market demands and grow efficiently as we scale. Ultimately, you'll make sure our products not only attract users but also scale sustainably to create financial happiness for everyone.</p> <p><em>Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work?</em><a href="https://moniepoint.com/blog"><em> </em><em>Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.</em></a></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner closely with product managers, business development, and data engineering teams to help our growth team uncover problems and make product metrics highly visible.</li> <li>Translate complex product and business questions into simple, actionable insights.</li> <li>Build, maintain, and scale self-service dashboards and custom visualisation tools.</li> <li>Cultivate trusted relationships across teams, acting as a collaborative link between technology, business, and product.</li> <li>Apply advanced mathematical and statistical modelling techniques (including A/B tests, multivariate testing, clustering, and supervised learning) to solve practical business problems that drive high-impact results.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> advanced analytics to deliver practical, product-shaping insights.</li> <li>Strong skills in statistical programming (Python) and familiarity with tools like Pandas, SciPy, and Jupyter notebooks.</li> title: Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools
description: <p><strong>Who we are</strong></p> <p>Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. </p> <p>As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.</p> <p><strong>Why the UK</strong></p> <p>The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based, with team members joining us from companies like Tide, Klarna, Revolut, Capital One, Teya, Wise, Starling, Monzo, and many others! Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.</p> <p>So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools, to join us in UK.</p> <p><strong>About The Role</strong></p> <p>Sales Management Tools owns MonieCRM, the operating system for Moniepoint's 50,000-strong sales network. This is not a CRM we bought — it is a workforce operations platform built entirely in-house for a multi-level field sales hierarchy, and it is how those teams run their day to day: the portfolio of businesses they manage, their own teams, their goals and performance, the physical and digital resources they need in the field, and an emerging AI-assisted support layer. Sixteen capabilities span onboarding and network management, pipeline and portfolio, performance and goals, compensation, and sales experience and support.</p> <p>A significant part of the domain moves money. The platform owns wallets, commission calculation and attribution, cashout and welfare funds for a network that drives the overwhelming majority of company revenue — which makes financial correctness, not just availability, a core engineering requirement of the role.</p> <p>Alongside that, the domain covers partner management, a rewards and retention platform serving tens of millions of users, and our marketing technology stack, including the engineering and customisation of Braze, the platform we use for customer engagement. The mandate is modernisation and reliability: re-architecting systems that have grown very quickly and making them dependable at a scale of more than 20 million users. This is a platform engineering and legacy modernisation challenge first and foremost, and prior CRM or SalesTech experience is genuinely not required.</p> <p><strong>Who You Are </strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.</li> <li>5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.</li> <li>At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.</li> <li>You have proven platform engineering experience at scale — building and running complex distributed systems, not feature delivery alone.</li> <li>You have navigated legacy migrations and re-architecture projects at 20M+ user scale.</li> <li>You have strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, data-intensive distributed systems, and are proficient in Java and Spring Boot.</li> <li>You have managed and developed large engineering teams of 20 or more members.</li> <li>Experience building systems where financial correctness matters — commissions, payouts, wallets, ledgers or equivalent — is a strong advantage.</li> <li>A fintech or payments background is strongly preferred. CRM or SalesTech domain experience is nice to have and explicitly not required.</li> <li>Exposure to customer engagement or marketing automation platforms such as Braze is a plus, but not a requirement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cultural Alignment</strong></p> <p>As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.</p> <ul> <li>Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.</li> <li>Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.</li> <li>Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.</li> <li>Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.</li> <li>Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.</li> <li>No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.</li> <li>Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.</li> <li>Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like In The Role</strong></p> <ul> <li>Legacy systems modernised and re-architected, with measurable improvement in reliability and performance.</li> <li>Commissions and earnings calculated, attributed and paid accurately and on time, at network scale.</li> <li>A sales and marketing platform that scales with a rapidly growing agent network across multiple markets.</li> <li>Commercial teams able to move faster because the tooling beneath them is dependable.</li> <li>A high-performing engineering team with a strong bench of managers and senior engineers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Join Us</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the platform behind the commercial engine of one of Africa's largest digital banks — the system 50,000 people rely on to do their jobs and to get paid.</li> <li>A genuine platform modernisation mandate with the autonomy and backing to see it through.</li> <li>Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What To Expect In The Hiring Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.</li> <li>60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.</li> <li>60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.</li> <li>60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.</span></p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) – Finance & Beratung (unternehmerisch, leistungsbasiert)

title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
description: Über DrAnsay DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert. Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit. Warum es diese Rolle gibt DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält. Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering. Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um. Was du konkret machst Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren Das brauchst du Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. title: Data Scientist, Enterprise Analytics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll apply statistical, experimentation, and machine learning methods to forecast outcomes, explain what drives activation, conversion, expansion, and retention, and size opportunities. You’ll also support the company-level reporting and GTM performance views that executives use to run the business, covering consumption, ARR, and first orders.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Embed yourself with business teams to become a trusted partner supporting insight generation and strategic decision making across GTM.</li> <li>Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover behavioral trends, long-term patterns, and the key drivers and levers behind business performance, and communicate their impact clearly to non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Build and productionize machine learning models - such as propensity, product-qualified lead (PQL) scoring, churn, and expansion models - including training, validation, testing, and feature engineering, using MLOps practices and tooling (CI/CD for ML pipelines, model registries, automated retraining, and monitoring) to move work reliably from notebook to production</li> <li>Design, run, and evaluate growth experiments (A/B tests and quasi-experiments) on onboarding, pricing and packaging, and upgrade flows, and measure their impact on activation, conversion, and retention</li> <li>Build and operationalize agentic workflows for analysis, modeling, and pipeline automation, with evaluation and monitoring that keep agent-generated insights accurate, traceable, and trustworthy.</li> <li>Contribute to GitLab’s Semantic Layer enabling stakeholders and agents to self-serve metrics using trusts and tested sources.</li> <li>Write production-grade Python and SQL that meets internal standards for style, maintainability, and performance in a high-scale database environment; maintain and advocate for these standards through code review</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>3-5 years of professional experience in GTM analytics, data science, or a similar technical role</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear, measurable questions and communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience with experimentation and causal inference (A/B testing, power analysis, quasi-experimental methods) and with statistical and machine learning methods such as regression, classification, clustering, and survival analysis</li> <li>Deep, hands-on understanding of SQL in cloud data warehouses (like Snowflake SQL), including working with product usage and event data, and in business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar)</li> <li>Experience using Python for statistical modeling, machine learning, and production data science. With hands-on experience in pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter, and related libraries such as LightGBM and XGBoost</li> <li>Hands-on experience building agentic workflows with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode, or similar), including connecting agents to the right context, tools, and platforms such as MLflow, and evaluating their output for accuracy and reliability.</li> <li>Experience working in a B2C company working with motions and metrics, including Consumption, CRR, ARR, and Churn & Contraction</li> <li>Self-motivated and self-managing, with strong organizational skills</li> <li>Ability to use GitLab and to thrive in a fully remote organization</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>The Enterprise Analytics team builds the trusted data products and insights behind GitLab’s Company wide sales, revenue, and finance reporting. title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer (m/w/d)- Beratung und Umsetzung im Mittelstand
description: Du verstehst KI-Systeme bis ins Detail. Und Du kannst sie einem Geschäftsführer so erklären, dass er die richtige Entscheidung trifft. Wir wollen die KI-Expert:innen im Mittelstand sein. Nicht die, die am lautesten über KI reden, sondern die, die wissen, warum ein RAG-System schlechte Antworten liefert, welches Modell lokal betrieben werden kann und welcher Use Case in drei Monaten Wirkung zeigt. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die beides mitbringen: echte technische Tiefe und Erfahrung darin, Kunden durch Projekte zu führen. Als Senior AI Solutions Engineer bei Neurawork verantwortest Du Kundenprojekte von der ersten Analyse bis zum Go-live. Du nimmst Prozesse und Datenlage auf, bewertest Use Cases auf Machbarkeit und Wirkung, entwirfst die Architektur und setzt die Lösung selbst um, auf Basis unserer standardisierten Produkte und bis zur vollständigen Integration in die Systemlandschaft des Kunden. Der Kunde vertraut Dir, weil Du technisch weißt, wovon Du sprichst. Wir arbeiten nach unserem eigenen Operational-AI-Vorgehensmodell. Wir sind keine Automation-Agentur und keine Custom-Softwareentwickler: Standardisierte Produkte sind unser Hebel, und wir passen sie bis zur vollständigen Integration an. Wir schaffen echten, messbaren Mehrwert und stehen dafür ein. Aufgaben Was Du bei uns machst Projekte verantworten: Kundenprojekte im Mittelstand führen, vom Kick-off bis zur Übergabe in den Betrieb Bewerten: Prozesse und Daten beim Kunden verstehen, Use Cases auf Machbarkeit, Kosten und Grenzen prüfen und nach Wirkung priorisieren Selbst bauen: Architektur entwerfen, unsere Produkte konfigurieren und erweitern, Retrieval und Prompting optimieren, Qualität messbar machen Integrieren: Schnittstellen, Datenanbindung, Sicherheit und Betrieb gemeinsam mit der Kunden-IT umsetzen Beraten mit Substanz: Fachabteilung, IT und Geschäftsführung fundiert begleiten, Erwartungen klar steuern, Roadmaps entwickeln, die technisch tragen Menschen mitnehmen: Workshops moderieren und Teilnehmende befähigen, damit die Lösung im Alltag ankommt Weitergeben: Erkenntnisse in unsere Frameworks und Produkte zurückspielen; Live-Sessions in unserer KI-Ausbildung mit TÜV Süd Zertifikat und im KI-Business-Coaching Nicht passend für Dich, wenn... Nicht passend für Dich, wenn … Du KI-Projekte bisher gesteuert oder begleitet, aber nicht selbst technisch umgesetzt hast, Deine KI-Systeme ausschließlich mit No-Code-Tools entstanden sind, Du am liebsten nur im Code bleibst und Kundentermine, Workshops oder Gespräche mit der Geschäftsführung lieber anderen überlässt Qualifikation Was Du mitbringst Technisches Fundament: Abgeschlossenes Studium im MINT-Bereich (z. B. Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Data Science). Alternativ mehrere Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung. Zertifikatskurse und Weiterbildungen ersetzen das nicht. Mindestens ein KI-System, das Du selbst konzipiert und umgesetzt hast und zeigen kannst, z. B. eine RAG-Pipeline, einen produktiven Agenten oder eine technisch verantwortete Automatisierung Du programmierst sicher (z. B. Python) und arbeitest mit APIs, Datenbanken und Deployment. Reine No-Code- oder Low-Code-Erfahrung reicht für diese Rolle nicht. Du kannst technische Entscheidungen begründen, z. B. warum Du ein Modell, eine Chunking-Strategie oder einen Cloud- statt lokalen Betrieb gewählt hast und wo deren Grenzen liegen Beratungserfahrung: 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mindestens 2 Jahre mit direktem Kundenkontakt in technischen Projekten, z. B. als Technical Consultant, Solutions Engineer, Solution Architect, Data-/AI-Consultant, technische Projektleitung oder Freelancer mit eigenen Kunden. Interne Fachbereiche als Kunden zählen auch. Du hast Anforderungen aufgenommen, Workshops moderiert und Entscheidungen bei Stakeholdern herbeigeführt, auch auf Geschäftsführungsebene Du kannst einem Kunden sagen, dass sein Wunsch-Use-Case keinen Sinn ergibt, und ihm eine bessere Alternative zeigen Außerdem wichtig: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) in Wort und Schrift Gutes Englisch, Wohnsitz in Deutschland und Bereitschaft zu Kundenterminen vor Ort Was wir bieten Projektverantwortung ab dem ersten Mandat, ohne Layer über Dir; direkter Draht zum Founding-Team Beide Welten in einer Rolle: selbst bauen und selbst beraten, ohne Übergaben zwischen Beratung und Entwicklung Ein Team, das technisch auf Augenhöhe diskutiert: Austausch mit der KI-Elite in Deutschland Framework-driven statt ad hoc, und Du gestaltest die Frameworks mit Wert statt Stunden: Uns zählen Ergebnisse, nicht Tagessätze Moderner Tech-Stack und Raum zum Experimentieren Sichtbarkeit als Expertise über unsere KI-Business-Coaching-Community und die TÜV-SÜD-Kooperation Voll-remote möglich; Teamtage und Kundenworkshops vor Ort, üblicherweise 2–4 Tage im Monat im DACH-Raum Bewerbung: Bring Dein Projekt mit! Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte kurz zwei Fragen: Dein Projekt (3–5 Sätze): Welches KI-System würdest Du uns im Zweitgespräch zeigen? Was löst es, wie ist es aufgebaut, welchen Teil hast Du selbst umgesetzt, und welche technische Entscheidung hast Du dabei bewusst getroffen? Ein Link zu GitHub, einem Demo-Video o.
