title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
description: <p>Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning. </p> <p>Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge.</p> <p>Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success.</p> <h1>Your responsibilities will include:</h1> <ul> <li>Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning.</li> <li>Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system.</li> <li>Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization.</li> <li>Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking.</li> <li>Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda.</li> <li>Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture.</li> </ul> <h1>We expect you to have:</h1> <ul> <li>A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead.</li> <li>At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI.</li> <li>A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine-tuning approaches.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with:</li> <ul> <li>Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation.</li> <li>Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent.</li> <li>Vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.</li> <li>Deploying and scaling LLM-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open-source models.</li> </ul> <li>Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.</li> <li>Proficiency in English, both written and verbal. </li> </ul> <h1>Our ideal candidate would have:</h1> <ul> <li>Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph-based reasoning.</li> <li>Experience in early-stage startups – you enjoy the zero-to-one phase.</li> <li>The ability to think strategically about product-led AI, beyond just training models in isolation.</li> <li>A background in code analysis, developer tools, or software engineering research.</li> <li>Experience with multi-agent systems or complex agentic workflows.</li> <li>Actively contributed to relevant open-source projects or publications.</li> </ul> <h1>What we offer</h1> <ul> <li>A competitive salary and JetBrains benefits.</li> <li>A generous runway and corporate resources with startup autonomy.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-KP1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. The manager also owns key client relationships and serves as the first-line escalation point for client issues, with a defined handoff path for anything beyond their resolution. Manage capacity and workload distribution across the division as well as assigning clients. Contribute to pricing and fixed-fee scoping, and monitor engagement profitability. This role focuses on new logo acquisition and aligns closely with our new business team in India. We are looking for someone with the range and seniority to credibly own strategic partner relationships across all of these partner types, and to help grow our business through these partners.</p> <p>This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who has already built a career scaling partner-sourced and influenced revenue in India — someone who knows the hyperscaler ecosystem (AWS & GCP), has deep, credible relationships with India's major SIs, and understands how to engage newer-generation cloud-native and AI partners as they become an increasingly important part of the go-to-market.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build and scale GitLab's partner-sourced and influence business in India across hyperscalers, large India-centric SIs, and pipeline contribution, and progress against strategic-partner milestones.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in channel/alliance/partner management or ecosystem sales, ideally within enterprise software, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure.</li> <li>Extensive, well-rounded experience scaling a business through partners across hyperscalers, partner-sourced pipeline and bookings against quota.</li> <li>Credible input into finalizing the India Ecosystem coverage model, grounded in on-the-ground partner relationships.</li> </ul><div title: Freelance Copywriter
description: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate Application Process Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

title: Billing Support Specialist
description: ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Billing Support Specialist to play a critical role in shaping our billing experience. You’ll take ownership of customer billing inquiries across EMEA, partnering directly with customers and working cross-functionally with our Billing Engineering team. Beyond resolving issues, you’ll help identify patterns, improve workflows, and contribute to product enhancements that scale. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about helping millions of customers. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR In this role, you’ll: - Provide initial and timely responses to all support cases for a variety of topics, from billing or pre-sales requests to usage optimization or disputes - Debug/Identify user-specific issues such as failed payments, unsettled invoices, payment extensions - Triage support cases including directing users to previous answers, code examples, documentation, or escalating to specific technical or business team members. - Identify where internal tooling might be developed or obtained to improve support efficiency. - Reproduce issues, create test cases and improve test coverage, if you have experience with testing. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Experienced in customer support, with 2+ years of experience providing billing support to technical customers. - Excellent communication skills and fluency in English. - Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences - Have experience in async or globally distributed teams - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly - Being proficient in SQL is a bonus WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

description: Software Engineer, Infrastructure Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits Â About Sodalis Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). Â The Opportunity Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own. We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live. We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range. You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture. What you'll do Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between. Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy. Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site. Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range. Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture. What we're looking for 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering. You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded. You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them. You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity. You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required. How we work We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk. title: Senior Full Stack Developer - Deepdesk
description: About Deepdesk Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider. The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside. At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks. You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets. We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go. We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving. What You’ll Be Doing • Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work. • Keep our databases fast and reliable. • Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. • Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go. • Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required. • Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics. • Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code. • Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering. • Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed. Our Stack • Backend: Python (Django REST framework, FastAPI and Celery) and Go. • Voice: Go for our real-time voice AI service, with WebSockets, speech to text, language models, text to speech and the OpenAI Realtime API. • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch. • Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build. • Front end: TypeScript and React. • Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape. What We’re Looking For • Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus. • Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL. • Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus. • Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, enough to build and fix front-end features. It does not need to be your strength. • A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery. • Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment. • Interest in voice and real-time systems, and willingness to also work in the other language. Our voice AI service and our integration tests are written in Go, and most of the backend is in Python. • A plus: experience with Celery, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, serving machine learning models, or real-time audio. Why Join Us? • Based in the Netherlands, with flexibility over how you organise your time. [HR: confirm office and hybrid details] • A small team working with major enterprise clients. • Start-up culture combined with enterprise demands and production scale. • Full autonomy and full ownership of your work. • High standards, trust and plenty of humour. • The opportunity to shape real-time AI experiences used in enterprise contact centres. • Full-time (40 hours), permanent contract. Information Security Responsibilities All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation’s information security standards. This includes: • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times. • Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss. • Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner. • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team. • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required. • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in line with company policies and legal requirements. Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Influencer Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
description: About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship. Role Overview As Influencer Marketing Manager, you will develop and run Hilo’s influencer marketing program across our key markets. You will find creators whose voices and audiences fit our brand, negotiate effective partnerships, and shape content that makes Hilo relevant and credible. The role combines brand and performance: you will use data to estimate the potential of each partnership before we invest, measure its results, and apply what you learn to future campaigns. Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required. Core Responsibilities Identify, assess, and recruit creators across relevant platforms and markets. Develop campaign concepts that balance Hilo’s brand goals with measurable commercial outcomes. Forecast likely reach, engagement, traffic, and acquisition outcomes to guide creator selection and budgets. Negotiate fees, deliverables, timelines, and content usage rights, including rights to use creator content in paid campaigns. Manage partnerships end to end, from briefing and content review through publication and reporting. Build and nurture long-term relationships with creators and brand ambassadors to drive sustained awareness, trust, and advocacy. Collaborate with paid media teams to amplify high-performing creator content across paid social and other relevant channels. Set clear goals, track brand and performance metrics, and compare results with initial estimates. Use campaign data and audience insights to improve creator selection, content formats, and investment decisions. Work across marketing and product to align campaigns with Hilo’s priorities and approved health claims. Build repeatable processes that support growth across the US, UK, Germany, and other markets. Requirements Background & Experience At least 2 years of hands-on influencer or creator marketing experience, including managing partnerships from start to finish. A data-driven mindset: you can estimate campaign outcomes, assess performance, and turn findings into better decisions. Strong creative judgment and an understanding of how creator content builds both brand trust and customer demand. Strong negotiation skills and confidence working with creators and their representatives. Excellent communication, organization, and attention to detail. Fluency in English; German is a plus. Experience in health tech, wellness, medical devices, or another category where trust and accurate claims matter is welcome. Benefits What Makes You A Great Fit At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results. Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools. Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success. Why Join Us? Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story. Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale. Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company. Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team. Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location). Ready to Move the Needle? If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. You’ll work closely with the Platform, SRE, Auth, Billing and Edge Functions teams, and with the engineers on the AI Tooling team who build the product surfaces. The AI Tooling team runs its own services in production and carries its own on-call. Traffic from AI clients and agents behaves differently from traffic from people: hundreds of calls a minute, retry loops, and no reading of deprecation warnings. This role makes sure the services they use are reliable, correctly authorized and observable. It is a systems and infrastructure role rather than a product AI role, and it is not an SRE role. You will build and operate these systems, not only advise on them. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments, owns what they ship in production, and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR In this role, you’ll: - Build and operate the production backend services behind Supabase’s AI products, including the MCP server: deployment, scaling, configuration and release. - Take ownership of how those services are structured, including splitting or reshaping a service when that makes it safer to run and easier to change. - Define, measure and meet reliability targets for the services the team runs. Set SLOs with the SRE team, track error budgets, and use them to decide what to fix first. - Participate in the AI Tooling team on-call rotation, and be a first responder for incidents in those services. Investigate, fix, coordinate with other teams during incidents, and write the follow-ups and runbooks. - Work the AI Tooling team support queue alongside on-call, and turn recurring issues into fixes rather than repeated manual answers. - Own authentication and authorization for AI and agent clients: OAuth apps, scoped tokens, and permissions that make sense for agents as well as humans, including how we change or deprecate a permission without breaking existing integrations. - Own observability for the services the team runs: metrics, traces, logs, dashboards and alerts, so we find problems before customers do. - Handle capacity and abuse for agent traffic: rate limits, cost and safety controls, and behavior under load or when a dependency degrades. - Improve the architecture of the services the team owns as they grow, including splitting or reshaping a service when that makes it safer to run and easier to change. - Work with the Platform team on shared code, review ownership and release process, and with the SRE team on infrastructure, alerting and incident practice. - Contribute to the code of the AI Tooling team’s tools, such as the MCP server, where it affects reliability and security, in partnership with the engineers who own the product surface. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU Must have: - Have 5+ years of experience building and running backend services in production, and have carried on-call for them. - Write strong TypeScript or Go, and are comfortable working in the other. - Have designed and operated APIs with real consumers: versioning, error handling, rate limiting, and backwards-compatible change. - Know OAuth, OIDC, JWT and API authorization well enough to debug them in production and to explain where implementations commonly deviate from the spec. - Have a good understanding of PostgreSQL and relational databases. - Are comfortable with CI/CD, Docker and containerized deployments, and with infrastructure as code. Any tool is fine. - Can debug across services: follow a slow or failing request through several systems using metrics, traces and logs. - Communicate clearly in writing, work with a wide range of stakeholders, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams. - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly. Pick your centre of gravity. We expect you to be deep in at least one of these, and to tell us which: - APIs and auth: You have designed permission models, token scopes or OAuth flows for third-party or machine clients, and you have migrated them without breaking users. - Operations: You have run production services yourself: carried the pager, written alerts and runbooks, used SLOs or similar to decide what to fix, and made shared systems less risky over time. - Gateways and distributed systems: You have built or run proxies or gateways, or debugged hard failures across services (retries, partial failures, upstream outages, fail-open vs fail-closed decisions), and you can reason about load and degradation. Nice to have: - Experience with agent tooling (MCP or similar), or serving traffic from AI agents and LLM clients. - Experience moving a service out of a larger codebase while keeping existing clients working. - Experience with Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Logflare or a similar observability stack, and real SLO work. - Open-source contributions, especially to Node.js, Go, TypeScript or API tooling. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Scientific Account Executive
description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. Weâre growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the role This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers â from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs. The day-to-day: Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results Working with the biology team to troubleshoot when a customer's experiment doesn't go as expected Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts â new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns You won't be handed a script. You'll need to understand the science well enough to earn trust from PhD-level protein engineers and CSOs, while also being commercially sharp enough to close deals and grow accounts. Responsibilities Own the full customer lifecycle: prospecting, technical sales conversations, deal closing, onboarding, and ongoing account management. Serve as the technical point of contact for customers. Understand their protein engineering goals and recommend the right experiments (binding, expression, thermostability, enzyme activity). Understand and explain our assay capabilities in depth: BLI, SPR, cell-free expression, and emerging assay types. Know when each is appropriate and what the data means. Work closely with the biology team to ensure experiments are designed correctly and results are communicated clearly. Build and maintain a pipeline of commercial opportunities across customer segments: AI-driven protein design companies, biotech startups, pharma R&D teams, and academic labs. Develop proposals and quotes tailored to customer needs, from small pilot experiments to large-scale data generation campaigns. Represent Adaptyv at conferences and industry events. Be able to have deep technical conversations at the booth, not just hand out brochures. Feed customer insights back to the product and biology teams: what assays are people asking for, what's missing, where are we losing deals. What we're looking for Scientific background in protein engineering, biochemistry, biophysics, or a related field. You should be comfortable discussing binding kinetics (KD, kon, koff), expression systems, and assay design without needing to look things up. Experience in a customer-facing technical role: field application scientist, technical sales, scientific account management, or similar. CRO or biotech vendor experience is a strong plus. Commercially driven. You care about revenue, pipeline, and closing deals, not just having interesting scientific conversations. Strong communicator who can adapt to the audience: detailed and technical with a scientist, concise and business-focused with a VP. Self-starter who can manage their own pipeline and priorities without heavy oversight. Genuine interest in AI-driven protein design and the companies working in this space. You follow what's happening in the field. Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with GitLab or description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong><strong class="textBold">An overview of this role</strong></strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Compensation Manager at GitLab, you'll lead the design, planning, and execution of compensation programs that help us attract, retain, and reward team members. You'll own recurring programs, including the annual focal merit cycle, and provide guidance and oversight for promotion cycles, quarterly equity grant cycles, and semi-annual bonus programs. Working closely with Total Rewards leadership and partners across People, Finance, and Legal, you'll turn program objectives into clear deliverables, establish processes and controls, and see complex cycles through from planning to closeout. Your work will help ensure accurate, timely delivery and a clear experience for leaders, People teams, and team members.</p> <p>You'll be based in the United States. We prefer a West Coast location to support collaboration with stakeholders across time zones.</p> <h2><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll do</strong></strong></h2> <ul> <li value="1">Lead compensation programs from design and readiness through approvals, processing, communication, and post-cycle review, including ownership of the annual focal merit cycle and oversight of promotion, quarterly equity, and semi-annual bonus cycles.</li> <li value="2">Define program calendars, decision points, responsibilities, controls, and success measures. Coordinate dependencies and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and decisions.</li> <li value="3">Ensure compliance with eligibility rules and develop process documentation, manager resources, and communications. Advise People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, and leaders on program application and exceptions, escalating policy and governance decisions when needed.</li> <li value="4">Analyze compensation data and program outcomes, develop recommendations for Total Rewards leadership, and partner with Finance on budgeting, cost modeling, and reconciliation.</li> <li value="5">Partner with People Technology and IT systems stakeholders to improve workflows, reporting, and usability.</li> <li value="6">Validate inputs and outputs, ensure timely processing, maintain audit and control documentation, and protect confidential compensation information.</li> <li value="7">Oversee the annual refresh of global compensation and equity ranges to ensure accuracy, and support compensation partners with program delivery and analysis.</li> <li value="8">Lead improvements that reduce program risks and friction, strengthen consistency and transparency, and improve the team member experience. Use clear documentation and asynchronous communication to coordinate work across time zones.</li> </ul> <h2><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience designing and operating compensation programs, with expertise in corporate compensation and public company equity and a record of delivering complex merit, equity, bonus, or promotion cycles accurately from planning through closeout.</li> <li value="2">Strong analytical and spreadsheet skills, including interpreting compensation data, building scenarios, checking assumptions, and explaining findings to decision-makers.</li> <li value="3">An understanding of compensation governance, data integrity, and controls, with discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential information and sensitive decisions.</li> <li value="4">The ability to translate policy and strategy into operating procedures, system requirements, and stakeholder guidance, plus experience with human resources information systems and compensation planning tools such as Pave and Workday, and comfort working on a Mac.</li> <li value="5">Attention to detail, practical problem-solving skills, and the persistence to work through complex issues and deliver accurate outcomes. You can learn unfamiliar programs, systems, and business contexts quickly.</li> <li value="6">The ability to build trusted partnerships, advise leaders and People teams, resolve ambiguity, and move decisions forward without relying on formal authority.</li> <li value="7">Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to coordinate with global partners across time zones using asynchronous practices.</li> <li value="8">Helpful, but not required: experience supporting a global, distributed workforce, including partners in India or other locations outside the United States; compensation-cycle communications; and experience in a software or technology company.</li> </ul> <h2><strong><strong class="textBold">About the team</strong></strong></h2> <p>The current Compensation team consists of 2 Global Compensation Partners and a Lead Total Rewards Program Manager that collaborates with the Compensation and Benefits teams. We provide compensation programs for 40+ countries globally. Our compensation work brings together People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, People Operations, and People Technology. title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
description: As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect , you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices. What you'll be doing: Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization. Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints. Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel. Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally. Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders. Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America. Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents. Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty. Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice. Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism. Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking. Help shape our technical offerings and accelerators in line with market and AWS trends. What you bring: 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and delivering on AWS. A proven track record of leading at least two large-scale cloud migrations end to end. Hands-on database migration experience with MSSQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL. AWS Certified Solutions Architect â Professional. In-depth knowledge of core AWS services, including: Compute and containers: EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS Storage and databases: S3, RDS, EFS, EBS Networking and integration: VPC, API Gateway, CloudFront, SNS, SQS Security: IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, AWS Private CA Operations and migration: CloudWatch, AWS Application Migration Service Strong Infrastructure as Code skills. Terraform is preferred; CloudFormation, AWS CDK or Ansible are also welcome. Hands-on experience building and running CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Bitbucket or similar. Experience running containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes or EKS. Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls and VPN, plus AWS networking services such as VPC, Route 53, ELB and CloudFront. Strong security knowledge: IAM, least privilege, access control, endpoint security and data encryption. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. You are confident with executives and engineering teams alike. Comfort working in a distributed team, with a few hours of daily overlap with Central European Time. A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience. Nice to have: Hands-on experience with AWS MAP phases: Assess, Mobilize, and Migrate & Modernize. Migrations from VMware, on-premises data centers, Azure or GCP. Experience with AI-assisted migration and modernization tooling, such as AWS Transform. title: Go-To-Market Lead (Germany)
description: About us Hey there! We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses. We enable European companies to integrate AI agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations. We help the most strategic European industries – manufacturing, logistics, and wholesale – automate the messy, manual processes that most tools can’t handle. We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions for 2027 and beyond. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board! About the role We're looking for a Go-To-Market Lead to open and lead the German market for Lleverage. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role: you set the strategy for Germany, build the first pipeline yourself, close our first German customers and own the German number. You'll work directly with our founding team, including our CCO, and you'll be the face of Lleverage in Germany. As the market grows, you'll lead a small German pod. A Go-To-Market Associate will join you to run revops and German-language outreach and calling, and a Forward Deployed Engineer will join once the first deals are signed, to deliver for those customers. Responsibilities Open and lead the German market: build pipeline from scratch and close our first German customers, focused on mid-size and larger manufacturing, logistics and wholesale companies Own the German number: set targets with the founding team and be accountable for pipeline and revenue in Germany Own the full sales cycle: from first contact to signed contract, including C-level conversations and complex, multi-stakeholder deals Build the German playbook: ICP, German-language messaging, channels and partners Lead the pod: coach the Go-To-Market Associate on pipeline and work with the Forward Deployed Engineer on first deliveries Represent Lleverage: with German customers, partners and at industry events Work directly with the founding team: on strategy, targets, approach and customer feedback Bring insights: from German customers back into product development What we’re looking for Around 10 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex deals and hitting targets You have opened a market or built a sales territory from scratch before, and you have taken ownership of a number A senior seller who still loves running deals yourself and is ready to lead a small team as it grows, not a sales executive who manages from a distance You're an excellent relationship builder. You win trust fast, communicate with confidence at all levels, and genuinely enjoy the process of turning a cold conversation into a long-term partnership. You're commercially sharp and consultative. You understand that the best outcomes come from genuinely understanding someone's pain, not pitching a product. You listen well and use data to shape your priorities. You're energised by ambiguity. A new market with no playbook excites you rather than stops you. Native-level German and fluent English Based in Germany, or in the Netherlands Nice to haves A network in the German Mittelstand. Experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development. Background in SaaS, AI, or Consultancy. Networks in manufacturing, wholesale, distribution or the PE industry. Previous entrepreneurial experience is a big plus, built something, ran something, grew something. 50% of our team are former founders, that tells you something. Why Lleverage? Change the world, literally. Traditional industries are sitting on a massive AI opportunity and most of them haven't been reached yet. You'll be the one opening those doors. Work, learn, have fun. We're building one of the strongest commercial teams in Europe. You'll work directly with the founding team, surrounded by exceptional talent, and genuinely enjoy the people around you. Build a unique network. Lleverage is a global top AI brand. You'll connect with industry leaders and some of the most important operators in tech and traditional industry. Get autonomy and ownership. You design the approach, build the relationships, own the results, and grow with the company. Compensation. Competitive salary depending on experience, strong bonus structure (fi we win you win), and an excellent share package that makes this genuinely worth betting on. complex opportunities while maintaining accurate forecasting and consistent alignment with GitLab values and goals.</li> </ul> <p>The Professional Services Engagement Management team at GitLab is title: Informationssicherheitsberater
description: Für die Informationssicherheit eines kantonalen Departements in der öffentlichen Verwaltung suchen wir einen externen Berater für Informationssicherheit. Du unterstützt die informationssicherheitsbeauftragte Person fachlich und sorgst dafür, dass Sicherheitsanforderungen in Projekten und Fachbereichen systematisch geprüft, dokumentiert und umgesetzt werden. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit rund 60 Applikationsverantwortlichen zusammen und trägst dazu bei, sensible Informationen vor Verlust, Manipulation und unbefugtem Zugriff zu schützen. Aufgaben Begleitung und Schulung von Applikationsverantwortlichen bei der Erstellung von Schutzbedarfsanalysen und ISDS-Konzepten (Informationssicherheit und Datenschutz) Beratung von Applikationsverantwortlichen zur Erreichung eines definierten Informationssicherheits-Levels sowie formelle und inhaltliche Prüfung von ISDS-Konzepten Prüfung und Einforderung angemessener Informationssicherheits-Klauseln in Verträgen sowie Kontakt mit Lieferanten bei Lieferantenauswahl, Vertragserarbeitung und Pentests Einforderung und Nachverfolgung von Massnahmen zu identifizierten Schwachstellen aus Pentests und Audits Überprüfung der Notwendigkeit von Berechtigungen anhand von Systemauszügen inkl. Sensibilisierung der betroffenen Personen Sicherstellung einer einheitlichen, zentralen Ablage der Sicherheitsdokumentation sowie Erstellung und Pflege von Übersichten und Cockpits zu Dokumentationen, Schulungen, Verträgen und Sicherheitslücken Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Tickets inkl. Aufteilung komplexer Tickets in Teilaufgaben Prüfung der Umsetzung von Richtlinien und Vorgaben zur Informationssicherheit Langjährige Erfahrung in Informationssicherheit und Risikomanagement, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung mit Audits Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in Softwareentwicklung, Softwarebeschaffung oder einer vergleichbaren Tätigkeit mit starkem IT-Bezug Abgeschlossener Master im Bereich Engineering (FH oder Universität) oder Abschluss in einem verwandten Gebiet mit vertieften technischen Kenntnissen Aus- oder Weiterbildung in Business Analyse, Anforderungsmanagement, agilen Entwicklungsprojekten und IT-Service-Management Fundierte Kenntnisse zu Web- und Desktop-Applikationen (Web und API, Datenbanken, Netzwerkgrundlagen) sowie praktisches Verständnis technischer und organisatorischer Informationssicherheit Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in Authentifizierung und Autorisierung (SSO, OpenID Connect, MFA, RBAC), Cloud/SaaS, Backup & Recovery, Audit-Logs, DevSecOps/Container, OT/SCADA, Mobile und IoT Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse von ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, IKT-Minimalstandards oder NIST CSF sowie von kryptographischen Verfahren, BCM und GRC-Tools Fähigkeit, Sicherheitsanforderungen adressatengerecht zu erklären und konstruktiv mit Zielkonflikten wie Termindruck vs. Sicherheit umzugehen Verantwortungsbewusste, strukturierte und selbständige Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Generelle Rahmenbedingungen Start: 01.01.2027 Dauer: bis 31.12.2027 Pensum: 60 % Remote: Vollständig remote möglich (wöchentliches Meeting vor Ort) Sprache: Deutsch Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Country Manager Canada
description: Hello. Weâre Polaroid. An iconic brand, built by passionate people Polaroid was founded in 1937 by one of the 20th centuryâs most influential innovators, Edwin Land, whose philosophy was: âDonât undertake a project unless it is manifestly important and nearly impossible.â In 2008, Polaroid produced its last pack of instant film. But a group of passionate fans refused to let instant photography disappear. What started as The Impossible Project grew into a mission to preserve and reinvent analogue photography for a new generation. More than a decade later, that same startup acquired the Polaroid brand and continues to shape its future today. At Polaroid, we create products and experiences that spark emotion, fuel creativity, and bring people closer together. At the intersection of art and technology, we believe in the power of analogue moments and genuine human connection in an increasingly digital world. The Role As the Country Manager, Canada - you will play a pivotal role in managing and expanding our footprint with National Retailers and Independents alike. We are looking for an experienced account manager that has excellent business and execution skills to deliver profitable customer plans and market share growth. In addition to channel and operational management responsibilities, this role will also collaborate with internal stakeholders from sales operations, finance, demand planning, product management, and marketing. Key Responsibilities: Canada Market Leadership: Serve as the commercial lead for Polaroid in Canada, owning the Canadian wholesale plan and accountability for revenue and market growth. Be the in-market face of the business and the primary point of leadership for the Canadian commercial team and stakeholders. National Account Ownership: Act as the strategic lead for all national wholesale accounts, ensuring long-term scalability, commercial profitability, and a premium Polaroid brand presence across every brick-and-mortar and digital retail touchpoint. Account Partnership: Build and hold trusted relationships with the most senior buyers, merchants, and decision-makers across national accounts. Lead joint business planning and negotiate mutually beneficial terms that create sustainable, multi-year growth. Team & Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead and coordinate the Canadian commercial plan, including setting priorities and coaching supporting team members. Partner closely with US-based planning, finance, retail marketing, and product teams. Forecasting, Demand Planning & SKU Transition: Translate market data into actionable inventory strategies. Lead seasonal forecasting and rolling monthly projections and manage SKU EOL transitions to protect sell-through. Track consumer trends and identify opportunities to capitalize or course-correct. Sell-Through & Brand Activation: Shift the focus from sell-in to sell-through. Partner with retail marketing and activation teams to execute high-impact programs, elevate in-store positioning and shelf execution, and consistently use retail assets to drive account performance. Brand Ambassador & Product Evangelism: Act as the face of Polaroid by demonstrating our world-class products at trade shows, training events, and major national account meetings. What You'll Need to Succeed Experience: Demonstrable progressive, high-impact sales and account management experience within a consumer goods, consumer electronics, or premium hardware retail environment, including experience leading a market, a team, or a portfolio with meaningful autonomy. A proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar national retail portfolios is essential. Canadian Retailer Depth: Deep familiarity with the Canadian retail landscape and established senior-level relationships across major national chains. Commercial & Analytical Literacy: Strong command of retail math, inventory pipelines, pricing elasticity, and promotional mechanics. Comfortable evaluating complex financial models and partnering closely with finance and operations leaders. Strategic Influence: Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a proven track record of influencing external executive leadership and aligning internal cross-functional teams around a shared growth vision. Self-Directed Leadership: Able to operate as the senior Polaroid presence in-market: setting direction and making decisions while staying tightly connected to the North American strategy. title: Senior FP&A Expert - Financial Task Design and Evaluation
description: Lightly AG is a Zurich-based AI company and ETH/HSG spin-off, backed by Y Combinator and top-tier investors. Our machine learning and computer vision technology is trusted by global leaders in autonomous driving, medical imaging, and visual inspection. We’re looking for experienced Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) professionals with strong financial modeling and analytical backgrounds to support an advanced AI evaluation project. You'll design realistic financial planning and business decision-making tasks, develop reference solutions, and evaluate AI-generated financial outputs for accuracy, completeness, and practical business relevance. This is a remote, project-based contractor opportunity with flexible working hours. Compensation: $400 USD per accepted task . Each task is estimated to take approximately 5–6 hours to complete, equivalent to an indicative hourly rate of $67–$80/hour. Actual earnings per hour will vary depending on the time spent completing each task. Compensation is based on successfully completed and accepted tasks, not on hours worked. Tasks What you'll be doing Design realistic FP&A tasks and business scenarios that reflect complex, real-world financial planning, forecasting, and decision-making workflows Develop financial models and reference solutions using Excel, including traceable formulas, documented assumptions, scenario analysis, and consistency checks Create tasks involving core FP&A processes , such as annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, variance analysis, headcount planning, and investment decisions Build and evaluate integrated financial analyses , incorporating income statements, balance sheets, cash flow forecasts, working capital, and liquidity considerations Develop scenarios involving multiple sources of financial and business information , including spreadsheets, contracts, emails, and management presentations Evaluate AI-generated financial models, analyses, and recommendations for technical accuracy, financial consistency, completeness, and sound business judgment Identify material errors, unsupported assumptions, inconsistencies, and weaknesses in financial models or conclusions Define clear evaluation criteria and acceptable outcomes , accounting for valid alternative financial approaches and reasonable assumptions Write precise task instructions, reference answers, and concise executive-level explanations that accurately reflect the underlying financial analysis Apply structured evaluation guidelines consistently , providing clear, evidence-based rationales for your assessments The project focuses on developing and evaluating realistic financial tasks to assess how effectively advanced AI systems can perform complex FP&A workflows. Your role is to bring practical financial expertise to the design of challenging business scenarios and the evaluation of AI-generated outputs against professional standards. Requirements You're a strong candidate if you: Have 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), corporate finance, finance business partnering, or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrated expertise Have advanced Excel and financial modeling skills , including building, reviewing, and auditing complex financial models with transparent formulas and well-documented assumptions Have hands-on experience owning or supporting financial planning processes , including operating budgets, rolling forecasts, variance analysis, headcount planning, and investment evaluations Have a strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles , including the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, liquidity, and debt covenants Are comfortable building scenario-based financial models , evaluating different business assumptions, and assessing their impact on financial performance Can independently reconcile complex or conflicting financial information across spreadsheets, contracts, business documents, and management reports Have strong analytical judgment and can identify material financial errors, flawed assumptions, inconsistencies, and unsupported conclusions Can assess the quality and correctness of financial analyses , including recognizing valid alternative methodologies and defining clear acceptance criteria Have excellent written English communication skills and can produce precise instructions, structured financial explanations, and concise executive memos Have strong attention to detail and can consistently apply detailed evaluation guidelines while exercising independent professional judgment Preferred qualifications: Experience in software, technology, or SaaS businesses , including ARR, retention, gross margin analysis, and subscription-based financial planning Experience with financial model auditing, quality assurance, or reviewing financial deliverables prepared by others Previous exposure to AI evaluation, benchmark development, or designing structured analytical assessments Experience presenting financial analyses and recommendations to senior management or executive stakeholders Benefits and Compensation $400 USD per accepted task , with an estimated completion time of 5–6 hours Fully remote and flexible — work from anywhere Part-time contractor role with flexible hours Work on the evaluation of cutting-edge AI systems tackling complex financial and business decision-making tasks Send us your CV along with a brief note about your FP&A background, financial modeling experience, and areas of expertise. Please highlight your experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and any relevant software or SaaS industry exposure. If applicable, we'd also love to know about your experience building complex financial models, reviewing financial deliverables, or designing financial assessments and business cases. We look forward to hearing from you! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior AWS Platform Engineer
description: At Luscii, we are creating space for care by building digital health applications that help people manage their health. Applications such as the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with healthcare professionals around the world, we build technology that helps users receive the right care in the right place. Millions of people rely on our products every month, and behind every reliable healthcare experience is a cloud platform that simply works. As engineer working on our apps, you will play a vital role in modernising the cloud platform that powers the platform, creating a more reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide. OMRON Connect is one of the largest digital health platforms in our ecosystem, connecting millions of users with their healthcare data through OMRON devices. Much of the platform has grown over many years and was partly built by external partners. Today, we're investing heavily in bringing that knowledge, ownership and technical excellence in-house. This is not about replacing everything overnight. It is about making thoughtful engineering decisions, modernising step by step, and building a cloud platform that gives our engineering teams the foundations, tooling and confidence they need to deliver safely and independently. Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of a platform serving several million monthly active users across the world. You will help shape our cloud and engineering standards, introduce modern practices where they genuinely add value, and make Infrastructure as Code, observability and safe continuous delivery the default rather than the exception. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Along the way, you will collaborate with engineers, influence technical direction and leave the platform in a significantly better state than you found it. Your role You will become one of the technical driving forces behind the cloud platforms that power our digital health applications. Working closely with fellow engineers, product teams and colleagues across countries, you will help shape and improve our cloud infrastructure, strengthen the developer experience and ensure reliability, security and scalability are built into the foundations of our technology. Your exact focus will evolve with the needs of our teams and the opportunities you identify to make a lasting impact. This is a role for someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems without chasing complexity for complexity's sake. You will help us balance innovation with pragmatism, modernising a live healthcare platform while maintaining the stability that patients and healthcare professionals depend on every day. What you will be doing, among others: Design, build and evolve our AWS platform using Terraform as the single source of truth, while driving the gradual modernisation of our cloud landscape; Build reusable infrastructure, deployment pipelines and platform tooling that enable engineering teams to ship independently and safely; Introduce pragmatic cloud-native and event-driven solutions where they genuinely improve scalability, reliability and maintainability; Make observability a default through standardised monitoring, logging, dashboards and alerting across the platform; Improve deployment practices with automated CI/CD, progressive delivery and reliable rollback strategies; Embed security, compliance and cost optimisation into the platform through automated guardrails and best practices; Coach fellow engineers, review infrastructure and application code, and raise the overall cloud engineering bar through collaboration and example. The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH ; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better. Most important benefits Salary : Naturally, this depends on your background, experience, and relevant expertise. You may think of a maximum salary of approximately €86.000,- to €94.000,- per year for this position. Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii . Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least 6 years of experience building and operating large-scale cloud platforms, with deep hands-on AWS expertise and including the same amount of experience in senior-level ownership of modern cloud architectures; You have extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and treat infrastructure with the same rigour as application code; You have a strong understanding of cloud-native, serverless and event-driven architectures, and the judgement to apply them pragmatically; You know how to build reliable production systems with observability, automated deployments and safe release practices built in; You enjoy modernising legacy platforms through incremental improvements rather than big-bang rewrites, while bringing others along in the process; You have strong backend engineering experience, preferably with Node.js and TypeScript; You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. Interested? Apply now! Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via What does the recruitment process look like? We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: We are seeking a Senior FP&A Analyst to lead end-to-end financial planning, reporting, and forecasting for operating expenses across the organization. In this role, you will own cost center analysis, drive forecast consolidation, manage systems integrity between TM1 and NetSuite, and serve as a strategic finance business partner to department leaders across the company. The ideal candidate brings strong financial modeling expertise, hands-on experience with corporate planning tools, and the confidence to constructively challenge operational teams on budget assumptions while translating complex numbers into actionable business narratives. Responsibilities: Own the FP&A OpEx close—analyzing variances, preparing monthly management reporting packs (P&L, dashboards, board inputs), and partnering with Accounting on accruals and prepayments. Own planning, trend analysis, and variance commentary for non-people OpEx (software, marketing, T&E, professional services). Track cost efficiency metrics and ensure accurate TM1 mapping. Lead annual OpEx budget cycles and recurring reforecasts. Build dynamic, driver-based forecasting models and support Long-Range Planning (LRP) scenario modeling. Consolidate OpEx, workforce, and revenue forecasts into a single defensible group view in TM1. Support the FP&A Director in presenting to the CFO, ELT, and Board. Act as the strategic finance partner to department heads - translating numbers into actionable insights, constructively challenging spend assumptions, and flagging risks/opportunities. Ensure TM1 remains the single source of truth vs. NetSuite actuals. Drive reporting automation, refine Google Sheets dashboards, and streamline close/budget cycles. 5-7+ years in finance with 2–3+ years in FP&A. Experience owning end-to-end close/budget cycles and partnering directly with non-finance stakeholders. Tech, SaaS, or scale-up background strongly preferred. Advanced Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills. Hands-on experience with corporate planning tools (TM1/Cognos is a strong plus; Anaplan/Adaptive) and ERP systems (NetSuite preferred). Strong grasp of core accounting concepts (accruals, prepayments, opex vs. capex). Commercial mindset, structured thinking, strong communication skills, and the confidence to challenge budget assumptions constructively. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field (ACCA/CIMA/CFA or Master's is a plus). Fluent in English (Lithuanian is an advantage).
